recipes.title: Bread Bowls
directions: In a large bowl, combine warm water and sugar
Sprinkle yeast over the top and allow it to soften
Add salt, oil, and half of the flour
Beat well and add the remaining flour
Stir well with a heavy spoon and leave the spoon in the batter. Allow the dough to rest for 10 minutes
Stir down again and repeat the process 5 times
Turn the dough onto a floured surface and knead 2 to 3 times to coat with flour
Divide the dough into 8 to 10 equal parts
Place in small foil pans and allow to rest
Bake at 400 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes
Allow it to cool before cutting

recipes.title: Classic Dinner Rolls
ingredients: Combine above ingredients and let sit until it is lukewarm.:
directions: Add enough flour to make a soft dough, about 10-12 cups
Let rise for about 1½ hours
Mold out and let rise again
Bake at 425 degrees for 15-18 minutes or until light golden brown

recipes.title: Crescent Rolls
ingredients: 3 tablespoons yeast, dissolve in ½ cup warm water
Alternate adding a little at a time:
directions: Use a hand mixer, beat on low until smooth
You may need to add the last of the flour and mix by hand
Cover and let rise until double in size, 1 to 1½ hours
Punch down and divide into four balls
Roll out each ball into a 14" circle and cut into 16 pie wedges
Roll into crescent rolls and place on a greased pan
Let rise until double in size, 1 to 1½ hours
Bake at 375 degrees for 10 to 12 minutes

recipes.title: French Bread
directions: In a large bowl, mix the hot water, butter, sugar, and salt
In a small bowl, combine the warm water and yeast, allowing it to dissolve
Add half of the flour to the large bowl mixture, then add the yeast mixture
Gradually add the remaining flour and mix well
Let the dough rise for 1 hour
After rising, knead the dough and roll it out into a rectangle
Roll the dough up and place it on a greased cookie sheet
Let the dough rise for an additional hour
Bake at 400°F for 25 minutes
Brush with butter before or after baking

recipes.title: Grilled Garlic Bread
directions: Let dough rise until double in size
Roll each piece on a lightly oiled surface into a thin tortilla (about 10 inches)
Grill one side on medium hot barbecue grill for about 45 seconds
Turn bread over, brush with butter, sprinkle with garlic salt and Parmesan cheese
Continue to grill other side for about 45 seconds
Fold bread over and place on serving plate
Serve warm with dipping sauce

recipes.title: Homemade Bread
directions: Mix the first three ingredients (warm water, sugar, and yeast) in a cup and let rise
Add 2 cups of flour to a mixing bowl
Pour in the yeast mixture and stir well
Gradually add the remaining flour, 1 cup at a time, until the dough reaches the right consistency (about 4-5 cups)
Turn the dough onto a floured surface and knead
Split the dough into 4 loaves and place them into greased loaf pans
Let the dough rise until doubled in size
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes

recipes.title: Homemade Honey Wheat Bread
directions: Stir together dry ingredients. Add wet ingredients and mix for one minute. Dough should be sticky. If dry, add more water.
Knead for 5 minutes using a bread mixer, kitchen aid or your hands.
Shape the dough and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Cover with a dish towel and let rise 25 minutes. Preheat oven to 350°F.
Make an X ¼-inch deep with a sharp knife on the top of your dough. Bake for 22-25 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oven and cool on a wire rack.

recipes.title: Lion House Dinner Rolls
directions: Combine water and instant milk and mix well
Add yeast to this mixture, then sugar, salt, butter, eggs, and 2 cups of flour
Mix on low speed until ingredients are wet
Turn to medium speed for 2 minutes
Add 2 more cups of flour and mix on low for 2 minutes, then medium for 2 minutes
Add approximately ½ cup of flour and mix again
Continue adding the rest of the flour until the dough is soft but not overly sticky or stiff. It is not necessary to use the entire amount of flour
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover with plastic, and let rise until double in size
Roll out dough and cut in desired shapes
Let rise until double in size, approximately 1½ hours
Bake at 375 degrees for 15-20 minutes

recipes.title: Magleby's Copycat Parmesan Rolls
directions: Combine melted butter and Parmesan cheese, then mix in parsley
Roll frozen rolls in the Parmesan mixture until they are completely covered
Place rolls on an ungreased baking sheet
Cover and let rise for a little over 3 hours
Preheat oven to 350°F
Bake rolls for 10-15 minutes. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Pita Bread
directions: Beat well, then add salt
Gradually add the rest of the flour and knead for 5 to 10 minutes
Let rest for 15 minutes
Roll out 8 pitas and let them sit for 40 minutes or until ¼ inch thick
Bake for 4 minutes at 500 degrees
Turn over with hand and bake for 1½ to 2 minutes longer
Do not grease the pan
Stack pitas on a cloth and cover them
Do not let them brown too much
Freeze in foil, then thaw and warm up for 10 minutes

recipes.title: Seasoned Parmesan Rolls
directions: Place rolls in melted butter
Roll in Parmesan cheese and place on a cookie sheet
Sprinkle with McCormick Salad Supreme
Cover with plastic wrap and let rise for 3-4 hours
Preheat oven to 350°F
Bake for 14-15 minutes. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Tortillas
directions: Mix flour, shortening, baking powder, and salt
Gradually stir in water until a crumbly dough forms
Work with hands until dough holds together
Shape into a ball on a floured board
Knead until smooth
Divide dough into 12 equal parts
Cover and let stand for 15 minutes
Flatten each part to approximately a 4-inch circle
Roll into an 8-inch circle with a stockinet-covered rolling pin
Cook on a hot, ungreased griddle or stove over medium heat, turning frequently until bubbles are golden brown
Stack tortillas, covering with a damp towel to keep them soft

recipes.title: Banana Bread
directions: Combine the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, and nutmeg in a large bowl
Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients and set aside
In another bowl, combine the eggs, mashed bananas, sugar, oil, and lemon rind (if using)
Add the wet mixture to the dry ingredients all at once
Stir gently until just moistened—batter should remain lumpy
Fold in the nuts, if desired
Grease the bottom of a 9x5x3-inch loaf pan and spoon the batter into the pan
Bake at 350°F for 55 to 65 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean
If necessary, cover the bread with aluminum foil for the last 15 minutes to prevent over-browning
Let cool before slicing and enjoying

recipes.title: Banana Chocolate Chip Muffins
ingredients: 1 ½ cups Kodiak Cakes Buttermilk Mix
1 serving CSE Simply Vanilla Protein Powder
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Mash the bananas in a large mixing bowl. Beat in the honey and coconut oil. Add in the applesauce, egg and vanilla; mix well and set aside.
In a separate bowl, combine the Kodiak Cakes Mix, protein powder, flaxseed meal, baking soda and sea salt. Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and whisk together until just combined.

Line a muffin tin with liners. Scoop about ¼ cup of the batter into each muffin cup and top with chocolate chips. Bake for 15-16 minutes. Transfer from the pan to the cooling rack. COMPLETE THE SNACK: 1 muffin + 3 scrambled egg whites 230 calories / 6.5F / 27.5C / 17P Scramble egg whites and sprinkle with sea salt. - OR - 1 muffin + ½ serving CSE Simply Vanilla Protein Powder 230 calories / 6F / 31C / 16P Add protein powder to 6 oz. cold water and shake until dissolved. Enjoy on the side.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Rolls
directions: Place the rolls in a bundt pan sprayed with cooking spray
Sprinkle the dry pudding mix and brown sugar over the rolls
Drizzle the melted butter over the rolls
If using a timed oven, set it to bake 8 hours later
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes
Invert immediately onto a serving plate
Alternatively: Divide the rolls in half and place them in two bundt pans
Sprinkle ½ of the pudding over each pan
Combine the butter and brown sugar, then melt
Pour ½ of the melted mixture over each pan
Bake as directed above

recipes.title: Caramel-Glazed Pumpkin Pecan Bread
ingredients: 3 ½ cups Kodiak Cakes All-Purpose Baking Mix
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Beat the honey, coconut sugar and coconut oil together in a bowl. Beat in the pumpkin, applesauce, eggs and water; set aside.
In a separate bowl, mix together Kodiak Cakes, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg and sea salt. Add wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until just combined.

Pour the batter evenly into two greased, 9x5 inch, glass loaf pans and then sprinkle ¼ cup of the chopped pecans over the top of each loaf. Bake for 45 minutes or until golden on top and fully cooked through. Let cool for 20 minutes, then transfer to a plate or cooling rack.

Make the caramel sauce by adding all the caramel ingredients to a small saucepan over low heat. Stir constantly until completely melted and pourable. Drizzle the caramel sauce evenly over the two loaves and then let cool. Slice and enjoy!

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Banana Bread Squares
ingredients: 1 ½ cups Kodiak Cakes Buttermilk Mix
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Mash the bananas in a large bowl. Beat in the applesauce, coconut oil and honey. Add the egg and vanilla; mix well.
In a seperate bowl, combine the Kodiak Cakes Mix, baking soda, cinnamon and sea salt. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until just combined.
Pour the mixture into a greased, 8x8 baking pan. Sprinkle the chocolate chips on top. Bake for 40 minutes, then let cool. Cut into 16 squares. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Cinnamon Rolls
directions: Bread Machine: Add the ingredients in the order listed into the bread machine. Set to the dough cycle. Once the cycle is done, turn the dough onto a floured surface and let it rest for 10 minutes
Roll the dough into a rectangle about 16" wide and 21" long, with a thickness of about ¼ inch
Filling: In a bowl, combine the brown sugar and cinnamon. Spread the softened butter over the dough using a spatula, then sprinkle the cinnamon-sugar mixture evenly over it
Roll the dough up jelly-roll style along the 16" side. Cut the rolled dough into 12 slices. Place the slices in a greased 9x13 baking pan
Bake at 400°F for approximately 15 minutes, or until the rolls are light brown. Remove from the oven and allow them to cool
Cream Cheese Icing: In a mixer, combine the softened butter, cream cheese, powdered sugar, vanilla, and salt. Whip until blended and smooth
Frost the cinnamon rolls while they're still in the pan. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Corn Bread
directions: Bake at 350 degrees for 30-40 minutes in a greased pan

recipes.title: Double Chocolate Banana Bread
ingredients: 1 serving CSE Brownie Batter protein powder
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Mash the bananas in a large bowl. Beat in the applesauce, honey and melted coconut oil. Add the egg and vanilla; mix well.
In a seperate bowl combine the Kodiak Cakes, protein powder, cocoa powder, baking soda and sea salt. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients. Mix until just combined.

Pour into a greased, 9x5 inch, glass loaf pan and sprinkle with the chocolate chips. Bake for 50-55 minutes, then let cool. Remove from the pan and drizzle with extra melted chocolate, if desired. Enjoy!!

recipes.title: Egg Muffins
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.
Beat eggs and egg whites in a large bowl then stir in chopped sausage, veggies and seasonings until well combined.
Grease 12 muffin tins and scoop about 1/3 cup of mixture into each one. Bake for 30 minutes. Top with fresh salsa when ready to eat. PB

recipes.title: Monkey Bread
directions: Put butter, brown sugar, water, and cinnamon in a glass pie dish and cook in the microwave for 1½ minutes to melt the butter
Stir ingredients together
Cut refrigerator biscuits into fourths
Place a glass in the middle of the pie dish
Arrange the cut-up biscuits around the glass
Bake in the microwave oven for 3 minutes, or preheat the oven to 350 degrees and bake for 30 minutes

recipes.title: Orange Rolls
directions: In the bowl of a stand mixer, combine warm milk, orange juice, yeast, sugar, salt, butter, and eggs
Add in flour. Using a dough hook, turn the mixer on to a low speed

Once the flour starts to incorporate into the dough, increase the speed to medium. Add more flour as necessary so that the dough pulls away from the sides of the bowl. The dough should be soft and tacky, but not stick to your hands. Add more or less flour until the dough reaches the desired consistency
Transfer the dough to a lightly greased mixing bowl. Cover with a towel and let rise until double in size, about 1 hour
Lightly grease a 9x13 pan
On a clean surface, roll the dough into a 12-inch by 18-inch rectangle
In a small mixing bowl, combine the butter, sugar, and orange zest. Spread in an even layer on top of the dough, leaving 1/2 inch on the top edge
Roll up tightly lengthwise so you have one long roll. Use a sharp serrated knife to cut the dough into 12 even slices
Place the slices into a lightly greased 9x13 pan. Cover and let rise for 30 to 45 minutes
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Bake the rolls for about 20-25 minutes, until just kissed with brown on top
While the rolls are baking, make the cream cheese glaze by using a hand mixer to whip together the cream cheese and butter in a bowl until light and fluffy
Whip in powdered sugar and orange extract. Add enough orange juice to achieve a soft, easily spreadable consistency
Frost the rolls while still warm. Serve immediately or cool and store. They stay good for 4 to 5 days

recipes.title: Orange-Glazed Chia Seed Bread
ingredients: 1 serving CSE Simply Vanilla protein powder
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Mix the the flour, protein powder, sea salt and baking powder in a bowl; set aside.

In a separate bowl beat the egg, honey, almond milk, applesauce, coconut oil, butter, vanilla extract and almond extract. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix on low until just combined.
Pour into a greased, 9x5 inch, glass loaf pan. Bake for 40-45 minutes or until golden on the top and cooked through. Let cool.
Beat together all the glaze ingredients until smooth. Once the bread is cooled, drizzle the glaze over the top of the bread and store in the fridge. Slice and enjoy!

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Muffins
directions: For the glaze:
In a small saucepan, heat the orange juice and sugar over medium heat, stirring until the sugar dissolves. Remove from heat and stir in the almond and vanilla extracts
Spoon the glaze over the cooled bread or muffins
For the bread or muffins:
Cream together the eggs, sugar, and oil in a large mixing bowl
Sift together the flour, salt, and baking powder in a separate bowl
Gradually combine the sifted dry ingredients with the egg mixture
Add the milk, almond extract, butter flavoring, vanilla extract, and poppyseeds. Mix until well combined
Pour the batter into a greased loaf pan for bread or muffin tin for muffins
Bake at 350°F:
For bread, bake for 1 hour
For muffins, bake for 20 minutes

recipes.title: Pumpkin Chocolate Chip Bread
ingredients: ½ cup nonfat, plain Greek yogurt
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Beat the pumpkin, eggs, honey, coconut sugar, applesauce, Greek yogurt, orange juice, molasses and vanilla together in a large bowl. Mix until well combined; set aside.

In a separate bowl, stir the flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves, baking powder, baking soda and sea salt together. Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined. Stir in 2 / cup of the 3 chocolate chips.
Grease two, 9x5 inch, glass loaf pans. Pour the batter evenly into the two pans then sprinkle the remaining 1/3 cup chocolate chips over the top.
Bake for 40 minutes. Remove from the oven and cover loosely with foil. Bake an additional 10 minutes and let cool. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Scones
directions: Sprinkle yeast and sugar on top of water
Let rise for 5 minutes until bubbly
Add flour gradually and mix for about 7 minutes until dough leaves sides of the bowl
Remove dough from bowl and clean out the bowl
Spray bowl and hands with cooking spray and replace mounded dough in the bowl
Let rise until doubled in bulk, approximately 40 minutes
Deep fry in oil

recipes.title: Simple Banana Bread
ingredients: 6 Tbs. softened butter or coconut oil
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Mash the bananas in a bowl. Beat in the butter/coconut oil, applesauce, honey and coconut sugar. Add eggs and vanilla. Beat on high until well combined.
In a separate bowl, combine the Kodiak Cakes Mix, baking soda, cinnamon and sea salt. Add the dry mixture to the wet mixture. Stir slowly until just combined.

Grease two, 9x5 inch loaf pans. Pour mixture evenly into both pans and bake for 50 minutes. Check the bread at 30 minutes. If the bread is getting too dark on the top, lightly place a sheet of foil over the top for the remaining time. Let cool. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Sweet Honey Cinnamon Rolls
ingredients: 1 cup cooked, peeled & mashed sweet potatoes
directions: Beat eggs in a small bowl; set aside. In a seperate bowl, dissolve yeast into warm water. Once dissolved, pour eggs into water with yeast; set aside. Remove the skins from the cooked sweet potatoes and beat with hand mixers until smooth; set aside.

Heat almond milk in a pot over high heat until small bubbles form around the edges. Remove from heat. Add the cold butter, honey, salt and sweet potatoes. Stir until all the butter is melted and the mixture is smooth.
Place in a bread or Kitchen Aid mixer. Add the egg mixture and the flour. Knead for 10 minutes. Cover and let rise in the fridge for 2 hours.

Split the dough in half. Place the dough on a floured surface and roll both pieces into large, thin rectangles. Mix the filling ingredients together and then spread evenly all over dough. Slice each rectangle into 12 strips and roll up. Place on a greased baking sheet; 12 rolls per sheet. Cover with a dish towel and let rise for 5+ hours or overnight.
Bake at 375 degrees for 12 minutes or until lightly browned. Beat icing ingredients together and drizzle over the top. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Zesty Orange Sweet Rolls
ingredients: 1 cup cooked, peeled & mashed sweet potatoes
directions: Beat eggs in a small bowl; set aside. In a seperate bowl, dissolve yeast into warm water. Once dissolved, pour eggs into water with yeast; set aside. Remove the skins from the sweet potatoes and beat with hand mixers until smooth; set aside.

Heat almond milk in a pot over high heat until small bubbles form around the edges. Remove from heat. Add the cold butter, honey, salt and sweet potatoes. Stir until all the butter is melted and the mixture is smooth.
Place in a bread or Kitchen Aid mixer. Add the egg mixture and the flour. Knead for 10 minutes. Cover and let rise in the fridge for 2 hours.

Split the dough in half. Place the dough on a floured surface and roll both pieces into large, thin rectangles. Mix the filling ingredients together and then spread evenly all over dough. Slice each rectangle into 12 strips and roll up. Place on a greased baking sheet; 12 rolls per sheet. Cover with a dish towel and let rise for 5+ hours or overnight.
Bake at 375 degrees for 12 minutes or until lightly browned. Beat glaze ingredients together and drizzle over the top. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
directions: Cream together the eggs and sugar, then add the oil
Mix in the remaining ingredients, except the zucchini, flour, and nuts
Gradually add the zucchini and flour, alternating until fully combined
Stir in the nuts or chocolate chips
Bake at 350°F for 1 hour (for a loaf)
If baking in muffin tins, bake for 20-25 minutes
For a small bread loaf, bake for 40-45 minutes. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Bacon & Egg Scramble
directions: Heat frying pan to medium heat. Grease pan with cooking spray. Chop bacon and add it to the pan. Cook 3 minutes, flipping occasionally. Add veggies and potatoes to the pan. Sauté for 5 minutes.
Add egg whites to the pan and scramble all together until the eggs are cooked through. Transfer to a plate and season with sea salt and pepper. Top with cheese and avocado.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 375
Brown sausage
Add onion and pepper
Whisk eggs and milk
Layer hashbrowns, sausage mix
Pour eggs over
Add cheese
Bake 35 to 40 minutes

recipes.title: Breakfast Sandwiches By the Dozen
ingredients: ¾ cup low-fat, shredded mozzarella cheese
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Beat eggs and egg whites with water. Spray a 9x13 pan with cooking spray. Pour the egg mixture into the pan and bake for 20 minutes. Slice into 12 equal portions.
Lay the English muffins out. Place one egg portion on the top of each one. Top with 1 oz. deli turkey and 1 Tbs. of cheese. Sandwich with the other half of the muffin.
Wrap sandwiches in foil, place in a Ziploc freezer bag and store in the fridge or freezer.
Transfer to the fridge the night before eating to let thaw. When ready to eat, pop in the oven at 375 degrees for 20 minutes. If frozen, reheat in the oven for an extra 15 minutes. Enjoy warm.

recipes.title: Breakfast Sweet Potato
ingredients: Sea salt and pepper, to taste
directions: Bake the sweet potato in the oven or microwave according to the directions in the Food Prep Guide.
Chop the bacon. Spray a sauté pan and heat to medium/ high. Add the bacon and cook until crispy. Remove from the pan. Spray the pan again and add the egg, egg whites and spinach.
Place the sweet potato on a plate and mash with a fork. Top with eggs, spinach, cheese, bacon and avocado; salt and pepper to taste. Enjoy warm.

recipes.title: Breakfast Tacos
directions: Scramble the eggs and egg whites together with spinach and cheese. Remove from pan.
Divide the egg mixture evenly between four tortillas and top each taco with ½ Tbs. salsa. Enjoy two tacos per serving and one orange on the side.

recipes.title: Butternut Squash Scramble
ingredients: ¾ cup butternut squash, diced and roasted
½ cup broccoli, diced and roasted
Sea salt and pepper, to taste
directions: Roast the butternut squash and broccoli according to the directions in the Food Prep Guide.
Scramble the egg and egg white in a frying pan over medium heat. Add the roasted veggies to the pan and combine. Sprinkle with sea salt and pepper then top with cheese. Enjoy warm.

recipes.title: Denver Omelet
ingredients: Sea salt and pepper, to taste
directions: Heat a frying pan over medium heat. Spray pan and add the veggies and turkey. Sauté until veggies are tender. Remove from pan.
Beat the egg, egg white and water together in a bowl. Spray the pan again and add the egg mixture. Sprinkle with sea salt and pepper. Once the bottom is cooked, flip over.
Add the veggies and cheese to center and fold half of the fried eggs over the top creating an omelet. Once the cheese is melted, remove from pan. Enjoy warm with oranges on the side.

recipes.title: Egg White Omelet
directions: Heat frying pan over medium heat.

Place shredded sweet potatoes on a plate. Spray with cooking spray and microwave for 2 minutes. Spray a frying pan with cooking spray and add asparagus and sweet potatoes. Sauté with seasonings of choice for 5 minutes, then transfer to a plate.

Beat egg whites and water together in a bowl, then add to a greased frying pan and sprinkle with sea salt. Cover and cook for 3 minutes; Flip. Add asparagus, sweet potatoes and cheese to one side of the fried egg and fold over the other side. Top with avocado and salsa. 3399

recipes.title: Egg White, Pepper Jack & Avocado Sandwich
directions: Heat a frying pan over med/high heat. Spray pan with cooking spray. Add egg whites and season with salt and pepper. Cover with a lid and heat until fully cooked through. Fold in half and then in half again, then top with cheese. Transfer to a plate. Add the deli meat to the pan and brown on both sides. Remove from heat.
Slice muffin in half and toast in the toaster. Smash avocado onto the bottom of the muffin and sandwich the spinach, egg whites, cheese and chicken in the middle. PB

recipes.title: Mountain Man Breakfast
ingredients: 1 pound mild pork sausage (such as Jimmy Dean®)
1 (2-pound) package frozen shredded hash brown potatoes
directions: Build a campfire and allow it to burn down until a bed of coals forms. Place a grate over the fire.
Place a 12-inch cast iron Dutch oven onto the grate. Add sausage, onion, and garlic; cook and stir until the sausage is browned and crumbly and the onion is translucent, about 5 to 7 minutes.
Stir in the hash browns and bell peppers until well mixed. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the hash browns are hot and the peppers are tender, about 15 minutes.

Pour the beaten eggs into the Dutch oven, allowing them to seep down to the bottom. Cover the Dutch oven and place it directly onto 5 to 10 hot coals. Place another 12 to 18 hot coals on top of the lid. Let cook until the eggs are firm, about 40 minutes.
Open the lid, sprinkle with Cheddar cheese, cover, and continue cooking until the cheese has melted, about 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Potato Pancakes
directions: Mix egg, mashed potatoes, flour, and seasoning salt
Fry slowly in an oil/butter mixture until golden brown on each side

recipes.title: Aebleskivers
directions: In a medium bowl, beat the egg yolks.
Add sugar, salt, and milk to the yolks and mix well.
Sift the flour and baking powder into the bowl, stirring to combine.
In a separate bowl, beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form, then gently fold them into the batter.
Spray an aebleskiver pan with cooking spray and place it over medium heat.
Once the pan is hot, fill each well about 2/3 full with batter.
Cook until the batter becomes bubbly, then carefully turn each aebleskiver with a fork to cook the other side until golden.
Serve warm and enjoy!

recipes.title: Almond Joy Oatmeal
ingredients: ½ Tbs. natural almond butter - OR -
Offbeat Butters Midnight Almond Coconut nut butter
¾ serving (24g) CSE Brownie Batter protein powder
directions: Place the oats, water and egg whites in a microwave safe bowl. Whisk until the egg whites are well combined. Microwave for 1-2 minutes.
Stir in the almond butter and then let cool slightly. Stir in the protein powder and top with the coconut flakes and chocolate chips.

recipes.title: Apple Cinnamon Parfait
ingredients: ¾ cup non-fat, plain Greek yogurt
directions: 5 Tbs. sliced almonds or pecans Liquid Vanilla Stevia drops Dash of cinnamon Mix yogurt and stevia drops together in a bowl. Add chopped apples. Top with almonds and cinnamon. try heating the apples in a saucepan with cinnamon first and then serve warm over yogurt.

recipes.title: Baked French Toast Casserole
directions: Streusel
In a bowl, combine all streusel ingredients, mixing until the texture resembles chunky, damp sand.
Cover and refrigerate.
Casserole
Preheat oven to 350°F.
Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish with butter on the bottom and sides, then add the bread cubes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, sugar, salt, and vanilla.
Pour the egg mixture evenly over the bread cubes, gently tossing to coat. Add more bread if needed to absorb any excess liquid.
Sprinkle the chilled streusel evenly over the top of the casserole.
Bake for 45-60 minutes, or until the top is browned and bubbly. If it begins to brown too much at the 45-minute mark, cover loosely with foil and continue baking as needed.
Let cool for 10-15 minutes before serving with warm syrup.

recipes.title: Banana Macadamia Nut Pancakes
ingredients: 1-½ cups Buttermilk Kodiak Power Cakes Mix
½ cup finely chopped macadamia nuts
¼ cup Walden Farms Pancake Syrup
directions: Heat griddle to medium heat. Place water, egg whites, cottage cheese, banana and Kodiak Cakes in a blender. Blend on high until smooth. Stir in macadamia nuts. Pour slowly onto griddle. Once small bubbles form on top of the pancakes, flip. Weigh all the pancakes and divide the weight by 4 to get the amount needed to fill one serving.
Whisk plain Greek yogurt, syrup and coconut extract together in a bowl. Divide into 4 equal portions and use as the syrup for the pancakes.
Top warm pancakes with coconut cream syrup. Use extra pancake syrup if needed. Enjoy! PB

recipes.title: Buttermilk Pancakes
directions: In a bowl, mix together the flour, baking powder, sugar, baking soda, and salt.
Add the buttermilk, egg, and oil to the dry ingredients.
Beat the mixture until combined.
Pour batter onto a hot griddle and cook until golden brown on each side.
Serve warm with your favorite toppings.

recipes.title: Chocolate Glazed Banana Crepes
ingredients: 2 Tbs. natural peanut butter or almond butter
1 serving CSE Brownie Batter protein powder
directions: Heat a frying pan over medium heat. Add the egg whites, banana, Kodiak Cakes, milk, sea salt and stevia together in a high-powered blender. Blend on low for 30 seconds, scrape down the sides and blend for another 30 seconds.

Spray the pan with cooking spray and pour ¼ cup of the batter into the pan. Swirl the batter around the sides to make a thin crepe. Once the edges start to peel away from the pan, carefully flip the crepe. Cook for one more minute and then transfer to a plate. Repeat with the rest of the batter. It should make about 12 crepes.
Whisk together all of the chocolate glaze ingredients. Weigh the glaze and divide by four to get the amount needed to fill one serving.
Roll the banana crepes up and drizzle the chocolate glaze over the top. Enjoy warm.

recipes.title: Chocolate Lover’s Acai Bowl
ingredients: 355 1 calories frozen unsweetened / 12F / 37C / 25P Sambazon Acai pack
¼ cup unsweetened Almond Coconut milk
1/4 4-6 cup ice unsweetened cubes Almond-Coconut milk
1 serving Toppings: CSE Brownie Batter Protein
20g 1 Tbs. sliced Love banana Crunch granola
directions: Place frozen acai in a blender and pulse until 1 Tbs. Love Crunch granola broken up. Scrape down the sides of the blender and add the almond coconut milk, frozen banan-

as, Place protein frozen powder, acai in cocoa a blender powder and pulse and ice. Blend until until broken smooth up. and Scrape thick. down the sides of the blender and add the almond-coconut milk, frozen bananas, protein powder, cocoa powder
Pour into a bowl and top with bananas, and ice. Blend until smooth and thick. strawberries, almonds and granola.
Pour into a bowl and top with bananas, strawberries, almonds and granola. 54 PB

recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Cup Oatmeal
ingredients: ½ serving CSE Brownie Batter protein powder
directions: Mix the oats, water and powdered peanut butter together in a bowl. Microwave for 1-2 minutes.
Stir in the peanut butter and let cool slightly. Stir in the protein powder and top with dark chocolate chips.

recipes.title: Chocolate Power Waffles
ingredients: 1 cup Kodiak Buttermilk Power Cakes Mix
directions: Heat waffle iron to medium heat.

Place Kodiak Cakes mix, water, eggs, cottage cheese and cocoa powder in a blender; blend until smooth. Once waffle iron is hot, spray with cooking spray and pour batter inside. Weigh all waffles and divide the total weight by 4 to get the amount needed to fill one serving.
For topping, stir together powdered peanut butter, water, peanut butter and honey. Weigh the mixture and divide evenly between servings. Pour over hot waffles and top with berries. 63 PB

recipes.title: Chocolate Waffles
ingredients: 1 serving CSE Brownie Batter protein powder
directions: Preheat waffle iron.

In a medium sized bowl, stir together Kodiak Cakes, protein powder, cocoa powder, water and egg whites. Spray waffle iron with cooking spray. Pour batter into the waffle iron. Repeat with remaining batter. Divide the total number of waffles made by four to get the amount needed to fill one serving.
Top each serving with peanut butter, whipped cream and syrup; enjoy warm.

recipes.title: Chunky Monkey Bowl
directions: Combine the cottage cheese and stevia in a bowl. Top with bananas, strawberries, granola, peanut butter and chocolate chips.

recipes.title: Creamy Cinnamon Sugar Apple Bowl
directions: Combine the cottage cheese and stevia in a bowl; set aside.
In a frying pan over medium heat, sauté the apples in coconut oil, coconut sugar and cinnamon. Cook until fragrant.
Pour the apples over the cottage cheese and sprinkle granola over the top.

recipes.title: Crepes
directions: In a bowl, mix together all of the ingredients until smooth.
Heat a skillet over medium heat and lightly grease it if needed.
Pour 1/4 cup of the batter into the skillet, tilting to spread the batter evenly.
Cook on each side until golden in color.

recipes.title: German Pancakes
directions: Preheat oven to 400°F and place a 9-inch glass baking dish in the oven until hot.
In a bowl, mix together the eggs, flour, milk, and salt. Beat until smooth, approximately 10 minutes.
Carefully remove the hot glass dish from the oven and add the butter, rotating the dish until the butter is melted and coats the bottom.
Immediately pour the batter into the hot dish and place it on the lowest oven shelf.
Bake for 15 minutes or until the edges are golden brown.

recipes.title: Gingerbread Cookie Oatmeal
ingredients: ½ serving CSE Simply Vanilla protein powder
directions: Mix oats, egg whites and water together in a bowl.
Microwave for 1-2 minutes.
Stir in the almond butter and molasses first. Then add in the spices and protein powder. Top with Reddi Wip; enjoy warm.

recipes.title: Green Machine Pancakes
ingredients: 2 Tbs. natural almond butter or peanut butter
directions: Heat griddle to medium heat. Place eggs, egg whites, cottage cheese, oats, bananas and spinach in a blender. Blend until smooth. Slowly pour batter onto griddle, making about 24 pancakes. Once the edges start to bubble, flip. These burn easily, so watch them carefully. Weigh the pancakes and divide the weight by 4 to get the amount needed to fill one serving.
Top each serving with ½ Tbs. nut butter, syrup and cinnamon. 67 PB

recipes.title: Lemon Chia Pancakes
ingredients: 1 ½ cups Kodiak Cakes Buttermilk Mix
1 tsp. coconut oil or grass-fed butter
directions: Heat a skillet to medium heat.
In a large bowl whisk Kodiak Cakes Mix, water, yogurt, eggs and stevia together. Once combined, stir in the chia seeds and lemon zest.
Pour ¼ cup of the mixture onto the skillet. When small bubbles begin to form on the top, flip the pancakes over. Repeat for the remaining batter.

Stir the Greek yogurt and syrup together in a small bowl. Divide the amount of pancakes made by four to get the amount needed to fill one serving. Top each serving with one teaspoon coconut oil or butter, then drizzle the yogurt/syrup mixture over the top.

recipes.title: Loaded Breakfast Burrito Bowl
ingredients: ¼ cup sliced green bell peppers
directions: Heat oven to 400 degrees. Place potatoes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Spray tops with cooking spray and sprinkle with sea salt, paprika and garlic powder. Bake for 20 minutes. Flip potatoes and add sliced peppers and onions to the pan. Bake for another 20 minutes.
While baking, add chopped bacon to a frying pan. Cook until crispy. Remove from pan. Add egg whites with sea salt and pepper to the pan. Scramble. Add bacon and beans to the pan until heated through.
Place potatoes, peppers, onions, egg whites, beans and turkey bacon in a bowl. Top with cheese, avocado, green chilies, salsa and hot sauce. Enjoy! 65 PB

recipes.title: Mango & Coconut Cream
ingredients: ¾ cup non-fat, plain Greek yogurt
directions: Mix yogurt, stevia and coconut extract together in a bowl. Top yogurt with mango cubes and shredded coconut . 42 PB

recipes.title: Orange French Toast
directions: In a shallow bowl, combine all ingredients
Dip both sides of the bread into the egg mixture and let soak for 5 minutes
Place the soaked bread in a greased 15" x 10" x 1" baking pan, cover, and refrigerate overnight
Uncover and drizzle with ¼ cup butter
Bake at 325°F for 35-40 minutes or until golden brown

recipes.title: PB&J Oats
ingredients: ¾ serving (24g) CSE Simply Vanilla Protein
directions: Add oats, water and powdered peanut butter to a microwave safe bowl. Microwave for 1.5 minutes.
Stir in peanut butter. Let cool a couple minutes. Add protein powder and top with or stir in raspberries. Enjoy! 56 PB

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler Overnight Oats
ingredients: ½ serving CSE Simply Vanilla Protein
directions: Stir oats, milk, yogurt, protein powder, chia seeds, cinnamon and nutmeg together in a jar or container. Cover and store in the fridge overnight.
In the morning, top overnight oats with peaches, sweetened yogurt, chopped pecans and a drizzle of honey. Enjoy cold; no cooking necessary. Store in the fridge up to 5 days. 66 PB

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Overnight Oats
ingredients: ½ serving CSE Brownie Batter Protein
directions: Add all ingredients (except for the toppings) to a jar or container and stir until well combined. Cover and store in the fridge overnight.
In the morning, top with bananas, chocolate chips and peanut butter then enjoy cold. No cooking necessary. Stores well in the fridge up to 5 days. 60 PB

recipes.title: Raspberry Almond Oats
ingredients: ¼ cup nonfat, plain Greek yogurt
½ serving CSE Simply Vanilla protein powder
directions: Mix oats, egg whites and water together in a bowl.
Microwave for 1-2 minutes.
Stir in almond butter, almond extract, stevia and Greek yogurt.
Stir in protein powder.
Top with raspberries and sliced almonds.

recipes.title: Savory Stuffed Waffles
directions: Heat a waffle iron. Chop the bacon and cook in a frying pan over medium-high heat until crispy. Remove from pan.
Whisk the Kodiak Cakes Mix and water together in a bowl until well combined. Fold in the bacon, chopped spinach, cheese and chives. Spray the waffle iron with cooking spray and pour in ¼ of the mix.
While the waffles are cooking, heat the frying pan over medium heat and cook eggs over-easy. Top each waffle with one egg and syrup, if desired.

recipes.title: Silver Dollar Gingerbread Pancakes
ingredients: ½ serving CSE Simply Vanilla protein powder
Offbeat Butters Salted Caramel nut butter
directions: Heat a griddle over medium heat.

Whisk together the Kodiak Cakes Mix, water, molasses, egg and spices. Drop by the tablespoon onto the griddle making mini pancakes. Divide the total number of pancakes by four to get the amount needed to fill one serving.
Whisk the topping ingredients together in a small bowl. Top each serving of pancakes with 25g of the caramel topping.
Cook the eggs to your liking and serve on the side.

recipes.title: Sour Cream Pancakes
ingredients: For birthday pancakes: Replace some of the flour with yellow cake mix & add sprinkles
directions: In a medium bowl, combine all wet ingredients and whisk until blended.
Add the dry ingredients to the bowl. Stir with a large spoon just until the ingredients are incorporated; do not overmix. The batter should have lumps.
Heat a griddle to 350°F and spray with cooking spray.
Using a 1/3 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter onto the griddle.
Cook both sides until golden brown.
Serve immediately with fresh fruit and syrup.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cream French Toast
ingredients: 6 slices Harper’s Bran or Ezekiel Bread
directions: Heat a frying pan or griddle over medium heat. Mix yogurt with jam and set aside.
Beat eggs, egg whites, milk and cinnamon together. Grease pan. Dip both sides of bread in the egg mixture and place onto the pan. Cook about 3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
1-½ slices of French toast per serving. Top each serving with strawberry cream yogurt, almonds and syrup. Enjoy! 59 PB

recipes.title: Vanilla Blueberry Yogurt Parfait
ingredients: 2/3 cup plain Greek yogurt or FF cottage cheese
directions: Stir yogurt and stevia drops together. Top with almond butter, blueberries and granola. 43 PB

recipes.title: Waffled Omelet
directions: Heat waffle iron. In a medium sized bowl, beat eggs, egg whites and seasonings together. Set aside. In a separate bowl, mix sweet potato and veggies together.

Spray waffle iron REALLY well with cooking spray. Spread ¼ of the veggie mixture all over the waffle iron. Then pour ¼ of the egg mixture over the top. Close iron and cook until done. Repeat for remaining eggs and veggies. Makes 4 waffles.
Top waffles with cheese and fresh salsa. PB

recipes.title: Almond Bars
ingredients: Garnish with sliced almonds or pecans
directions: Sift together sugar, flour, baking soda, and salt
In a saucepan, bring 2 squares margarine and water to a boil. Pour the hot mixture over the sifted dry ingredients and mix until moist
In another bowl, combine 1/2 cup buttermilk, 2 eggs, and 1.5 tsp almond extract. Beat on medium speed for 2 minutes, then add to the other ingredients and mix
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes
Let it set overnight with a dish towel over it to make it easier to cut
Frosting:
Heat butter and buttermilk until barely boiling around the edges
Put powdered sugar in a bowl and add the butter mixture to it. Beat well and add almond extract
Frost the cake and garnish with sliced almonds or pecans

recipes.title: Almond Coconut Brownie Bites
ingredients: 1 serving CSE Brownie Batter protein powder
¼ cup unsweetened finely shredded coconut
directions: Mix almond butter, honey, coconut oil, almond extract, cocoa powder and protein powder in a bowl. Add oat flour and mix well.
Chill in the fridge for at least 30 minutes. Using a small cookie scoop, scoop into balls and roll in shredded coconut. Store in the fridge or freezer. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Blueberry Crumble Bars
ingredients: 3 cups Kodiak Cakes All-Purpose Baking Mix
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.

Stir together the xylitol, coconut sugar, Kodiak Cakes Mix, sea salt and lemon zest in a bowl. Add the butter, flaxseed meal and egg. Stir together until the mixture begins to ball. Split the mixture in half and press one half of it into the bottom of a greased 9x13 baking pan.

Make the filling: In a small bowl, dissolve the cornstarch or arrowroot powder into the water. Add that mixture to a sauce pan over low heat with the xylitol and honey; whisk until smooth. Add the blueberries to the pan. Turn the heat up to high and bring to a boil, stirring constantly with a rubber spatula. Remove from heat and continue to stir as the sauce thickens. Pour the blueberry mixture evenly over the top of the crust and then sprinkle the remaining crumble mixture over the top and press down to cover the blueberry filling.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the top is golden brown. Let cool completely and then cut into bars. Enjoy as is or topped with whipping cream or ice cream. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Brownie Batter Buddies
ingredients: 1 serving CSE Brownie Batter protein powder
directions: In a small saucepan melt together the honey, peanut butter and vanilla over low heat. Stir until melted together and smooth then remove from heat. Stir in the protein powder and cocoa powder.
Place Chex cereal into a large bowl. Pour the hot mixture over the top and gently stir until the cereal is well-coated.

Pour the chocolate Chex mixture into a large Ziploc bag, then dump the powdered peanut butter over the top. Seal the bag and shake until the cereal is well-coated. Pour out onto wax or parchment paper to cool. Store leftovers in the fridge. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Brownies
directions: Melt the shortening and unsweetened chocolate in a double boiler. Allow it to cool slightly.
In a separate bowl, beat the eggs until frothy and light in color. Add sugar and vanilla, mixing well.
Stir in the cooled chocolate mixture and mix thoroughly.
In another bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, and salt. Gradually add this dry mixture to the wet ingredients and blend well.
Fold in the nuts (if using).
Pour the batter into a well-greased 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan and bake at 350°F for 25-30 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Allow the brownies to cool completely before cutting.
Frost with your favorite chocolate frosting (optional).

recipes.title: Buckeye Brownies
ingredients: ¼ cup light tasting olive oil
½ cup coconut oil or grass-fed butter
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Beat the honey, applesauce, olive oil, egg whites and vanilla together in a bowl; set aside.

In a separate bowl, combine the cocoa powder, flour, sea salt, baking soda and baking powder together. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until just combined. Pour the batter into a greased 9x13 baking dish and bake for 25 minutes. Place in the fridge on a heating pad to cool.

Make the peanut butter cream: Beat the butter or coconut oil together with the peanut butter. Slowly beat in the Swerve sweetener until well combined. Mix in the vanilla, coconut milk and sea salt. Spread over the cooled brownies and place in the fridge for 30 minutes before adding the chocolate topping.

Place the chocolate chips in a bowl and melt in the microwave. Heat 30 seconds at a time until melted and smooth, stirring in between. Drizzle the melted chocolate over the top of the brownies and spread evenly.
Let sit in the fridge for one hour before serving. Cut into 20 brownies. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Caramel Apple Bars
ingredients: 1 ¾ cup Kodiak Cakes Cinnamon Oat Mix
directions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.
Beat the butter, flaxseed meal, coconut sugar, egg and vanilla together in a large bowl. Add the Kodiak Cakes Mix, rolled oats, sea salt and baking soda; mix well. Split the crumble mixture in half.
Press one half of the crumble into the bottom of a greased 9x13 baking pan; set aside.

Make the filling: In a sauce pan, melt the butter over low heat. Stir the chopped apples into the melted butter and sauté for 1-2 minutes. Add in the almond butter and honey. Mix until completely melted and apples are well coated. Pour the apple mixture evenly over the crust. Sprinkle the caramel chips over the apples and then top with the remaining crumble mixture.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until the top is lightly browned. Let cool, then cut into bars. Enjoy as is or top with whipping cream or ice cream.

recipes.title: Chocolate Peanutbutter Bars
directions: Prepare the Base:
In a large saucepan, heat the corn syrup and sugar over medium heat until the sugar dissolves and the mixture is smooth.
Remove from heat and stir in the peanut butter until well blended.
Add Rice Krispies cereal and mix until fully coated.
Assemble the Bars:
Press the mixture evenly into a greased 9x13-inch pan.
Prepare the Topping:
In a separate saucepan, melt the chocolate chips and butterscotch chips together over low heat, stirring until smooth.
Finish the Bars:
Spread the melted chocolate and butterscotch mixture over the Rice Krispies base.
Allow to cool, then cut into squares and serve.

recipes.title: Chovocado Brownies
ingredients: 1 serving CSE Brownie Batter protein powder
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Heat the honey in the microwave for 45 seconds. Stir the cocoa powder into the honey until completely dissolved; set aside.

In a separate bowl, beat the applesauce, vanilla, olive oil and egg together. Add the chocolate/honey mixture to the bowl; mix well. Add the flour, flaxseed meal, baking soda, baking powder and sea salt to the bowl and mix until just combined.
Pour the batter into a greased 8x8 baking dish. Sprinkle the chocolate chips over the top. Bake for 25 minutes, then let cool.
Beat all of the frosting ingredients together in a bowl. Once the brownies are cooled off, spread the frosting over the top and slice into 12 servings. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Cocoa Peanut Butter Bars
ingredients: 1 serving CSE Brownie Batter protein powder
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.
Beat the peanut butter, honey, eggs and applesauce together in a bowl; set aside.
Add the remaining dry ingredients to a seperate bowl. Stir until well combined. Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients. Mix until just combined.
Pour the batter into a greased 9x13 pan. Bake for 15-20 minutes. Let cool and then cut into 18 squares. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Brownies
ingredients: 1 (4 oz) package Baker’s German Sweet Chocolate
directions: Melt the German sweet chocolate with 3 tablespoons of butter over low heat, stirring constantly. Cool slightly.
Cream the remaining butter with the cream cheese. Gradually add ¼ cup sugar, creaming well after each addition. Blend in 1 egg, 1 tablespoon flour, and ½ tsp vanilla extract. Set aside.
Beat the 2 remaining eggs until thick and light in color. Gradually add ¾ cup sugar, beating until thickened.
Add the baking powder, salt, and ½ cup flour to the egg mixture. Blend in the cooled chocolate mixture, chopped nuts, 1 tsp vanilla extract, and almond extract.

Spread half of the chocolate mixture in a greased 8-inch or 9-inch square pan. Spread the cream cheese mixture over the top. Spoon the remaining chocolate batter on top and use a spatula to marble the two batters.
Bake at 350°F for 35 to 40 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Let the brownies cool before cutting into 16 to 20 pieces.

recipes.title: Lemon Bars
directions: Crust Directions:
Mix the crust ingredients until the dough is moist but crumbly
Press the mixture into the bottom of a 9x13'' pan
Bake at 350°F for 13-15 minutes, or until browned around the edges
Filling Directions:
Mix the filling ingredients together and pour over the baked crust
Bake again at 350°F for 15-20 minutes
Sprinkle with powdered sugar and serve

recipes.title: Lemon Macadamia Bars
ingredients: ½ cup Kodiak Cakes All-Purpose Baking Mix
½ cup macadamia nuts, finely chopped
¼ cup CSE Simply Vanilla protein powder
½ cup softened coconut butter or coconut manna
¼ cup Kodiak Cakes All-Purpose Baking Mix
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Combine all the crust ingredients together and press into the bottom of a greased 9x13 baking pan. Bake for 15 minutes. Remove from the oven and let cool.

In a large bowl, beat the eggs and eggs whites together. Add the Kodiak Cakes Mix, baking powder, honey, lemon juice and lemon zest. Pour over the top of the crust. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the edges are golden brown and the mixture is set.
Let the bars cool, then cut into squares. Sprinkle powdered sugar over the top and serve. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Blondie Cookies
ingredients: 1 serving CSE Simply Vanilla protein powder
½ cup vanilla milk chocolate or white chocolate chips
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Beat the peanut butter, honey and butter together in a bowl. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract; set aside.
In a separate bowl, add the oats, protein powder, baking soda and sea salt and mix. Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Fold in the chocolate chips.
Using a small cookie scoop, scoop dough onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper (makes 24 cookies). Bake for 8-10 minutes. Let cool 2 minutes, then transfer to a cooling rack. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Peanut Squares
directions: Preheat oven to 350°F.
In a large bowl, cream together the butter, sugar, and brown sugar.
Blend in the peanut butter, egg, and vanilla to the creamed mixture.
In a separate bowl, combine the flour, salt, baking soda, and oats. Stir the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients and mix well.
Spread the batter into a greased 8x13-inch pan and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Remove from the oven and allow to cool.
For the Peanut Butter Frosting:
In a bowl, mix the powdered sugar, peanut butter, and vanilla. Add milk as needed to reach spreading consistency. Frost the cooled bars with the peanut butter frosting.
For the Chocolate Frosting:
In a separate bowl, mix the powdered sugar, cocoa, butter, and vanilla. Add milk as needed to achieve a smooth, spreadable consistency. Frost the bars over the peanut butter frosting.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Bars
directions: Make the Pumpkin Bars:
Preheat your oven to 350°F.
In a large bowl, beat together sugar, oil, pumpkin, and eggs until smooth and well combined.
Stir in Bisquick and cinnamon, mixing until just combined.
If desired, add chopped nuts and raisins and mix them in.
Pour the batter onto a greased cookie sheet (or a 9x13-inch pan) and spread evenly.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Let the bars cool completely before frosting.
Make the Frosting:
In a medium bowl, beat together cream cheese, butter, milk, and vanilla until smooth.
Gradually add powdered sugar, beating until the frosting is creamy and spreadable.
Assemble:
Once the bars are cool, spread the frosting evenly over the top.
Cut into squares and serve!

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie No-Bake Bars
ingredients: 1 serving CSE Simply Vanilla protein powder
directions: Pulse the almonds and salt in a high-powered blender until finely chopped. Pour into a bowl and set aside. Add the dates and almond milk to the blender. Pulse until it turns into a paste. Pour into the bowl with the almonds and mix well.
Press the mixture into a greased 9x13 pan and place in the freezer. Let harden until finished with the next step.
Beat the honey, coconut sugar and melted coconut oil together in a bowl. Add the pumpkin, vanilla extract, pumpkin pie spice, rolled oats, flaxseed meal and protein powder. Mix until well combined.
Pour the pumpkin mixture into the 9x13 pan over the crust. Freeze 4+ hours. Cut into 18 bars and serve cold. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Pumpkin-Spiced Apple Crisp
ingredients: 1 cup Kodiak Cakes Cinnamon Oat Mix
directions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.
In a large bowl stir together the rolled oats, Kodiak Cakes Mix, coconut sugar, chopped pecans, pumpkin pie spice and sea salt; set aside.
Beat six tablespoons of the butter and the canned pumpkin together. Stir into the dry mix until it becomes crumbly; set aside.

Peel and thinly slice the apples. Add the remaining tablespoon of butter to a large saute pan and melt over low/medium heat. Once melted, add the apples and cinnamon. Stir together and cook for three minutes. Pour into a greased 9x13 baking dish, then sprinkle the crumble mixture over the top.
Bake for 40-45 minutes, then let cool. Enjoy warm topped with ice cream or whipped cream.

recipes.title: Rice Krispie Treats
ingredients: 4 cups miniature marshmallows (or 1 package regular marshmallows)
directions: Melt the Marshmallow Mixture:
In a large saucepan, melt margarine over low heat. Add marshmallows, stirring until completely melted.
Remove from heat.
Combine with Cereal:
Add Rice Krispies cereal to the marshmallow mixture, stirring until the cereal is evenly coated.
Press into Pan:
Using a buttered spatula or waxed paper, press the mixture into a 9x13-inch pan coated with cooking spray.
Cut and Serve:
Allow to cool, then cut into 2 x 2-inch squares and enjoy!

recipes.title: Scotcharoo Bars
ingredients: 1 serving CSE Simply Vanilla protein powder
directions: Mix the peanut butter, powdered peanut butter, honey, flaxseed meal, almond milk, vanilla extract, sea salt and protein powder together in a bowl. Melt ¼ cup of the butterscotch chips and mix in. Add the Rice Krispies cereal last and gently mix until well combined. Press into a 9x13 pan; set aside.

Place the chocolate chips in a bowl and microwave 30 seconds at a time until completely melted and smooth, stirring in between. Drizzle over the top of the bars and spread out smooth. Melt the remaining ¼ cup of butterscotch chips and drizzle over the top of the chocolate.
Store in the fridge for 1 hour to allow the chocolate to harden. Cut into 18 bars. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Scotcharoos
ingredients: 1 tablespoon unsalted butter, or as needed
directions: Prepare the Pan:
Generously butter a 9x13-inch baking pan and set aside.
Make the Peanut Butter Mixture:
In a large pot, mix together the peanut butter, corn syrup, and sugar.
Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the peanut butter melts and the mixture begins to boil.
Remove from heat.
Add Rice Cereal:
Stir in the rice cereal until it is well combined with the peanut butter mixture.
Press into Pan:
Transfer the mixture into the prepared pan and use buttered hands to press it down evenly.
Melt the Topping:
In a medium saucepan, melt the semisweet chocolate chips and butterscotch chips over medium-low heat.
Stir until smooth and fully melted.
Spread the Topping:
Spread the melted chocolate and butterscotch mixture evenly over the pressed cereal mixture in the pan.
Cool and Serve:
Let the bars cool completely, about 20 minutes, before cutting them into 24 squares. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Thin Mint Chocolate Brownies
ingredients: 1 serving CSE Brownie Batter protein powder
1 cup Thin Mint Cocoa Bar in a Jar (microwave jar for 30 seconds)
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Stir the dry ingredients together in a small bowl; set aside.
In a separate bowl, beat the butter and honey together. Add the eggs, egg whites, applesauce and vanilla; mix well. Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until just combined.
Pour into a greased 8x8 glass baking dish. Bake for 20-25 minutes, then let cool.
Once the brownies are cool, pour softened Thin Mint Cocoa Bar in a Jar over the top and spread out evenly. Place in the freezer until the chocolate has set.

Place the butter and chocolate chips in a bowl. Microwave 30 seconds at a time until melted and smooth, stirring in between. Pour over the brownies and spread out smooth. Return to the fridge or freezer for about 1 hour or until the chocolate has set. Allow brownies to sit out at room temperature for about 5-10 minutes before slicing. Slice into 36 brownie bites and enjoy!

recipes.title: Triple Chip Blondies
ingredients: 2 cups Kodiak Cakes All-Purpose Baking Mix
¼ cup white or vanilla chocolate chips
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Beat the butter, xylitol and coconut sugar together in a bowl. Add the eggs and vanilla and beat until well combined; set aside.
In a separate bowl, stir together the Kodiak Cakes Mix, sea salt and baking powder. Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Fold in all the chips.
Press the dough into a greased 9x13 baking pan and bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown. Let cool, then slice into 18 bars. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Two-Bite Brownies
ingredients: ½ serving CSE Brownie Batter protein powder
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Beat the egg, honey, almond butter and almond milk together in a bowl. Add the cocoa powder, protein powder, sea salt and mini chocolate chips; mix well.
Place mini muffin liners in a mini muffin pan. Spray liners with cooking spray and add brownie batter to the muffin liners. Fill each liner ¾ full with batter.
Bake for 8-10 minutes; they should still be gooey in the middle. Press one raspberry on the top of each brownie bite. Store in the fridge or freezer. Enjoy hot or cold!

recipes.title: Zucchini Brownies
directions: Cream together the butter, sugar, and oil in a large bowl.
Add eggs and vanilla to the creamed mixture and mix well.
In a separate bowl, combine the flour, baking soda, cocoa, salt, and buttermilk. Stir until combined.
Add the grated zucchini to the flour mixture and stir to combine.
Pour the batter into a floured and greased cookie sheet.
Sprinkle the top with brown sugar, chocolate chips, and nuts (if using).
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Allow the brownies to cool before cutting. These brownies are moist enough to enjoy without frosting, but feel free to add frosting if desired!

recipes.title: Almond Sheet Cake
ingredients: Sliced almonds or pecans for garnish
directions: Preheat the oven to 375°F.
Sift together the sugar, flour, baking soda, and salt in a large mixing bowl.
In a saucepan, bring the margarine and water to a boil.
Pour the boiling mixture over the dry ingredients and stir until moist.
In a separate bowl, combine the buttermilk, almond extract, and eggs.
Beat on medium speed for 2 minutes, then add to the dry ingredients mixture.
Mix well and pour into a greased sheet pan.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.
Let the cake cool, and it will be easier to cut if left overnight. Cover with a dish towel to keep it fresh.
For the Frosting:
In a saucepan, heat the butter or margarine and buttermilk until barely boiling around the edges.
Place the powdered sugar in a bowl and pour the hot mixture over it.
Beat well and stir in the almond extract.
Spread the frosting over the cooled cake.
Garnish with sliced almonds or pecans for a decorative touch.

recipes.title: Apple Coffee Cake
ingredients: ½ c Greek yogurt, nonfat plain
½ c Truvia cane sugar blend
1 c apples, diced (118 g, about 1 medium apple)
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
In a small bowl, combine the egg whites, applesauce, Greek yogurt, and vanilla.
In a separate medium bowl, mix together the flour, protein powder, Truvia, baking powder, and cinnamon. Stir the diced apples into the dry ingredients.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and fold together until combined. Spray an 8x8 baking dish with nonstick spray and pour in the batter.
For the crumble topping, stir together the Truvia, flour, and cinnamon. Pour in the melted butter and stir until it comes together. Break the mixture up evenly over the batter.
Bake 30–35 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean. Cut into 6 servings.

recipes.title: Autumn Spiced Carrot Cake Loaf
ingredients: 1⅓ c finely shredded carrots (blend them in a blender or food processor)
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. In a small dish, mix together the chai spice.
In a medium mixing bowl, whisk together the cake flour, all-purpose flour, 2 tsp chai spice, baking soda, baking powder, and salt.
In a stand mixer or with a hand mixer, mix together the oil, Truvia, sugar, eggs, vanilla, and yogurt.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet and mix until just combined. Fold in the carrots.
Pour the batter into a parchment-lined loaf pan and bake for 40 minutes. If the top browns before the loaf is cooked through, tent it with foil.
For the frosting, whip together the butter, cream cheese, vanilla, powdered sugar, and protein powder until smooth.
Cool the cake completely before frosting. Spread the frosting evenly over the top and dust with chai spice. Cut into 10 even slices.

recipes.title: Better Than Junk Food Cake
ingredients: ½ cup Cashew Coconut Caramel Sauce (recipe below)
¼ cup Cashew Coconut Caramel Sauce
directions: Place your coconut milk in the fridge (do not shake) to firm up for 1+ hours.
Make the CSE Devil’s Food Cake recipe. Poke holes all over, halfway down into the cake. Let cool slightly while making the caramel sauce filling.

Make the caramel sauce filling by placing ½ cup of the Cashew Coconut Caramel Sauce and ¼ cup caramel chips in a saucepan over low heat. Stir continuously until well combined and melted. Pour immediately over the top of the warm cake and let it drain down through the holes. Let cool.

Make the coconut cream by adding 2 cups of the cream portion of the coconut milk to a bowl. Beat with hand mixers on high for five minutes. Add in the Swerve sweetener and vanilla extract and mix until well combined. Once the cake has cooled completely, spread the coconut cream over the top and sprinkle with mini chocolate chips. Store in the fridge until ready to eat.

When ready to eat, make a batch of caramel sauce topping using ¼ cup of the Cashew Coconut Caramel Sauce and ¼ cup caramel chips with the same directions above in step number 3. Drizzle the warm caramel sauce over the cake and slice into 18 servings. Enjoy! CASHEW COCONUT CARAMEL SAUCE ¾ cup salted cashews ¾ cup raw honey ½ cup softened coconut butter 2-3 Tbs. water ½ tsp. caramel or vanilla extract
Soak cashews in water for one hour. Drain and place in a high-powered blender with the rest of the ingredients and blend until smooth. Store in the fridge until ready to use.
When ready to use, place the caramel sauce in a saucepan over low heat and stir until warm and melted.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
In a large bowl, mix together the sugar and salad oil.
Add the eggs and beat well.
In a separate bowl, combine the dry ingredients: flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients.
Stir in the grated carrots and chopped nuts.
Pour the batter into a greased baking pan and bake at 350°F for 50 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Allow the cake to cool before frosting.
For the Cream Cheese Icing:
In a mixing bowl, combine the butter and cream cheese.
Add the powdered sugar and vanilla, and beat until smooth.
If the icing is too thick, add a little milk to reach the desired consistency.
Spread the icing over the cooled cake.
Garnish with additional chopped nuts if desired.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake Cupcakes with Cream Cheese Frosting
ingredients: ½ tsp salt, 2 tsp cinnamon, ¼ tsp nutmeg, ¼ tsp ginger powder, ¼ tsp allspice
⅔ c plain Greek yogurt, fat free
½ c Truvia brown sugar blend
4 oz cream cheese, ⅓ reduced fat
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Line 2 muffin pans with 16 cupcake liners.
In a food processor or blender, blend the shredded carrots into very small pieces.
In a small mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, ginger, and allspice.
In a stand mixer or large mixing bowl, mix together the Greek yogurt, vegetable oil, sugar, and Truvia. Add the eggs and vanilla and mix.
Add the carrots and mix until combined. Gradually add the dry ingredients, mixing until just combined.
Scoop the batter into the 16 liners. Bake for 18 minutes.
Let the cupcakes cool completely before frosting, about 30 minutes.
In a medium mixing bowl or stand mixer, whip the butter and cream cheese on high until light and fluffy. Add the vanilla, powdered sugar, and protein powder and whip on high until smooth.
Frost the cupcakes evenly. Serving size is one cupcake.

recipes.title: Chocolate Sheet Cake
directions: Instructions for Cake:
Preheat oven to 400°F.
Sift together the dry ingredients: sugar, flour, baking soda, cocoa, and salt.
In a separate saucepan, bring the butter, water, and cocoa to a boil, stirring occasionally.
Pour the hot mixture over the dry ingredients, and then add the buttermilk, eggs, and vanilla.
Mix on medium speed for 3 minutes until smooth.
Pour the batter into a greased baking pan (9x13-inch recommended).
Bake for 20 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Instructions for Frosting:
In a saucepan, melt the butter and then add the cocoa and buttermilk. Bring it to a barely boiling point.
Once it reaches a boil, remove from heat and mix in the powdered sugar and vanilla.
Pour the hot frosting over the cake while it's still warm.
Optionally, add nuts on top before the frosting sets.

recipes.title: Coke Cake
ingredients: 1 chocolate cake mix (substitute Coke for the water)
directions: Mix the cake mix with Coke (instead of water) and pour into a greased 9x11 cake pan
Top with 2 cups of miniature marshmallows
Bake at 350°F for 35 minutes
Frosting:
Boil ⅓ cup of Coke and ½ cup of butter
Pour over 3 ½ cups of powdered sugar and beat with a mixer
Frost the cake while it’s still warm

recipes.title: Cookies n Cream Cake
ingredients: 1 package Pillsbury Plus White Cake Mix
1 cup coarsely crushed crème-filled chocolate sandwich cookies
directions: Instructions for Cake:
Preheat the oven to 350°F.
In a large bowl, combine all the cake ingredients (except crushed cookies). Mix on low speed until moistened.
Beat at the highest speed for 2 minutes.
Gently stir in 1 cup of coarsely crushed cookies.
Pour the batter evenly into two greased 8-inch or 9-inch cake pans.
Bake for 25 to 35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean.
Cool in the pans for 10 minutes, then remove from the pans and cool completely.
Instructions for Frosting:
In a small bowl, combine ½ cup of powdered sugar, shortening, vanilla, and the 2 egg whites. Blend well.
Gradually beat in the remaining powdered sugar until the frosting is smooth and creamy.
Frost the cooled cake with the frosting, filling between the layers and covering the top.

recipes.title: Devil’s Food Cake
ingredients: ½ cup grass-fed butter or coconut oil
directions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
Add 1 ½ cups milk and lemon juice to a small bowl; set aside. Combine the pudding mix with ½ cup milk in a bowl and whisk for 2 minutes. Store in the fridge until needed.
Beat the butter and coconut sugar together. Add the vanilla, egg, egg whites and applesauce. Mix until well combined; set aside.

In a large bowl, sift the flour, cocoa powder, baking soda, baking powder and sea salt. Stir until well combined. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and the milk/lemon juice mixture up over the top. Mix on low until just combined. Fold in the prepared pudding.
Pour the batter into a greased 9x13 pan. Bake for 30-35 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean when inserted into the center. Slice into 18 servings. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Earthquake Cake
directions: Preheat your oven and grease a 9x13-inch pan.
Sprinkle the nuts and coconut evenly on the bottom of the pan.
Prepare the German chocolate cake mix as directed on the package, and pour it over the nuts and coconut in the pan.
In a separate bowl, soften the cream cheese and butter. Add the powdered sugar and mix until well combined.
Pour the cream cheese mixture over the cake batter, gently stirring with a rubber scraper or fork to create a marbled effect.
Bake the cake according to the package instructions for the German chocolate cake mix.
No frosting is needed—this cake is rich, moist, and has craters in it, hence the name "Earthquake Cake!"

recipes.title: Eclair Cake
directions: Prepare the Pastry:
Bring 1 cup of water to a boil in a saucepan, then add the margarine and stir until melted.
Remove from heat and stir in 1 cup of flour with a fork until well blended.
Add the eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each addition.
Spread the mixture onto a large, ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.
Allow the pastry to cool.
Prepare the Topping:
In a mixing bowl, combine the vanilla and coconut pudding mixes with 4½ to 5 cups of milk.
Add the cream cheese and mix until smooth and creamy.
Assemble the Cake:
Spread the pudding mixture over the cooled pastry.
Drizzle with Hershey syrup.
Top with Cool Whip.
Optional Variations:
Add toasted coconut and fresh strawberries for extra flavor.

recipes.title: Fudge Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 1 cup milk + 1 tsp vinegar (let sit for a few minutes)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Cream together the shortening and sugar until light and fluffy.
Dissolve the cocoa in the hot water and add it to the cream mixture.
Add the eggs and vanilla and mix well.
Sift together the flour, baking soda, baking powder, and salt, then add to the wet mixture.
Mix until everything is well combined.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean when inserted in the center.
Let cool before serving.

recipes.title: German Chocolate Cake
directions: Instructions for Cake:
Preheat the oven to 350°F.
In a small bowl, melt the German chocolate in the boiling water and set aside to cool.
Cream the butter and sugar together until fluffy.
Add the egg yolks, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Blend in the vanilla and the cooled chocolate mixture.
Sift together the flour, baking soda, and salt. Gradually add this to the chocolate mixture, alternating with the buttermilk, beating after each addition until smooth.
Gently fold in the stiffly beaten egg whites.
Pour the batter evenly into three 8 or 9-inch layer pans, lined with wax paper on the bottom.
Bake for 30-40 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool the layers completely before frosting.
Instructions for Frosting:
In a saucepan, combine the evaporated milk, sugar, egg yolks, butter, and vanilla.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens (about 12 minutes).
Remove from heat and add the coconut and chopped pecans.
Allow the frosting to cool until thickened enough to spread.
Spread the frosting generously between layers and over the top of the cake.
Let the cake set before serving.

recipes.title: Golden Honey Carrot Cake
ingredients: 2 Tbs. CSE Simply Vanilla protein powder
directions: Preheat oven to 350.
Stir the grated carrots, coconut sugar and raisins together in a bowl; set aside.
Beat the butter in a large bowl until smooth. Add the egg, egg whites and vanilla; mix. Beat in the honey, applesauce and drained crushed pineapple last.
In a separate bowl, stir together the flour, cinnamon, baking soda and salt. Add to the wet mixture and stir until just combined. Fold in the carrot/raisin mixture and the pecans.
Grease three, 9 inch, round cake pans. Pour the batter evenly into each pan. Bake for 20-25 minutes. Let cool for 20 minutes in the pan, then remove and transfer to a cooling rack.
Beat all the frosting ingredients together. Once the cake is cooled, frost between each layer and stack. Use the remaining frosting to frost the top of the cake. Slice into 20 servings. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Ice Cream Cake Roll
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Beat the egg whites until stiff. Gradually add ½ of the sugar, continuing to beat until glossy.
Beat the egg yolks and add the remaining sugar. Mix well.
Combine the egg yolk and egg white mixtures.
Sift together the flour, cocoa, salt, and baking powder, then fold the dry ingredients into the egg mixture using a spatula.
Line a 10x15-inch cookie sheet with wax paper (do not grease). Pour the batter onto the sheet.
Bake for 13-15 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean.
Once done, cut off the crust and place the cake onto a towel dusted with powdered sugar. Allow the cake to cool slightly.
Spread ice cream over the cooled cake, then carefully roll it up.
Wrap the rolled cake in plastic wrap and freeze.
Before serving, slice the cake into pieces, placing wax paper between each slice to keep them from sticking. Serve while frozen but not too hard.

recipes.title: Iced Vanilla Donut Cake
ingredients: 2 cups mashed, cooked and peeled sweet potatoes
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
In a large bowl stir together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg and sea salt; set aside.

In a separate bowl, beat together the melted coconut oil, honey, pure maple syrup and applesauce for three minutes. Add the mashed sweet potatoes and vanilla extract; mix well. Beat in one egg at a time. Then add the flour mixture and beat on low until just combined.
Pour the batter into a greased Bundt pan. Bake for 1 hour. Let cool 15- 20 minutes in the pan and then tip over onto a serving plate and let cool before frosting.

In a large bowl, beat the powdered sugar, egg whites and vanilla extract together until well combined. Drizzle the icing evenly over the cooled cake. Let the icing harden before serving. Slice into 16 servings. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Lemon Pound Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.
Place the milk, lemon juice and lemon zest in a small bowl; set aside.
Beat the butter, Swerve and honey together in a large bowl. Add in the eggs and applesauce; set aside.

In a seperate bowl, combine the flour, baking soda and sea salt together. Add ½ of the dry mixture to the wet mixture, then add the milk and lemon juice mixture and then add the rest of the dry mixture on top. Mix until just combined.

Pour the batter into a greased Bundt pan. Bake for 60 minutes. Let cool for 10 minutes in the pan and then transfer to a cooling rack. Place a sheet of parchament paper under the cooling rack. Combine the syrup ingredients and then slowly pour over the cake while it’s still warm. Let cool completely.

Beat the powdered sugar, egg whites, lemon juice, lemon zest and coconut butter together in a large bowl until well combined. Drizzle icing evenly over the cooled cake. Let the icing harden before serving. Slice into 16 servings. Enjoy!

recipes.title: NY Cheesecake
directions: Prepare the Crust:
Combine the graham cracker crumbs, cinnamon, sugar, and melted butter in a small bowl.
Press the mixture firmly into the bottom of a lightly greased 9-inch springform pan.
Chill briefly in the refrigerator before adding the filling.
Prepare the Filling:
Using an electric mixer, combine softened cream cheese and sugar. Mix until light and fluffy.
Add the eggs and egg yolks one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Stir in the flour and milk until fully combined.
Bake the Cheesecake:
Pour the filling into the prepared crust.
Bake at 475°F for 10 minutes, then reduce the temperature to 200°F and bake for an additional 1 hour.
Turn off the oven and leave the cake inside until it cools.
Once cooled, remove from the oven, remove from the pan, and refrigerate.
Finish and Serve:
Top the cheesecake with Danish Dessert and fresh berries before serving.

recipes.title: Poppy Seed Cake
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Grease and flour a bundt pan.
In a bowl, mix together the eggs, flour, sugar, salt, almond flavoring, vanilla, poppy seeds, oil, and milk until well combined.
Pour the batter into the prepared bundt pan.
Bake for 1 hour or until a toothpick inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean.
Once baked, turn the cake upside down and let it cool.
Once cooled, sprinkle lightly with powdered sugar before serving.

recipes.title: Pound Cake
directions: Instructions for Cake:
Cream together the sugar and softened butter. Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Mix in the flour, vanilla, dry vanilla, almond extract, and whipping cream until well combined.
Grease a Bundt pan well and pour the cake batter into it.
Place the pan into a cold oven and bake at 325°F for 1 to 1½ hours or until the top is golden brown.
Cool the cake in the pan for 30 minutes before removing it from the Bundt pan.
Instructions for Frosting:
Brown the butter by melting it over medium heat until it turns golden brown and releases a nutty aroma.
Combine the browned butter, powdered sugar, dry vanilla, and enough cream or milk to reach your desired frosting consistency.
Frost the cooled cake once it is removed from the Bundt pan.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cake Roll
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Beat together the eggs, sugar, pumpkin, and lemon juice for 5 minutes.
Add the flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, ginger, and baking powder, mixing until well combined.
Before baking, sprinkle the batter with finely chopped nuts if using.
Pour the batter onto a greased and floured 15x10" cookie sheet.
Bake for 15 minutes.
Once baked, remove from the pan, and sprinkle powdered sugar on a dish towel. Place the pumpkin roll on top and roll it up lengthwise.
Let the roll cool completely.
Once cooled, unroll and frost with the icing.
Icing Instructions:
Beat together the powdered sugar, butter, cream cheese, and vanilla until smooth.
Spread the icing over the unrolled pumpkin cake.
Roll the cake back up and refrigerate for a few hours.
Once chilled, cut into 1-inch pieces and serve.
This recipe makes 16 pieces and can be frozen for later use.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Cream Cheese Cake
ingredients: 2 ½ cups Kodiak Cakes All-Purpose Baking Mix
1 serving CSE Simply Vanilla protein powder
¼ cup Kodiak Cakes Cinnamon Oat Mix
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Combine all dry ingredients together in a large bowl; set aside.
