In a large bowl, beat the bananas, butter, honey and Swerve together until smooth. Add the pumpkin and eggs. Mix until well combined. Add the dry ingredients to the bowl and mix well.

Grease two, 9-inch, round cake pans. Pour batter evenly into both pans. Combine the crumble topping ingredients together and sprinkle over the top of each cake. Bake for 25 minutes or until golden brown and cooked through. Let cool in the pan for 10-15 minutes, then transfer to a cooling rack.
Beat the frosting ingredients together. Spread in between the two cake rounds and on the top. Slice into 16 servings. Enjoy! Store extras in the fridge.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie Energy Bites
ingredients: 2 servings CSE Simply Vanilla protein powder
directions: Soak dates for 10 minutes. Drain.
Place pecans in a food processor or high powered blender and pulse until broken up. Add the dates, coconut, pumpkin, vanilla, spices and salt. Pulse until combined.
Transfer to a bowl and stir in protein powder and oats. Store in the fridge for 30 minutes. Using a cookie scoop, roll into balls and store in the fridge or freezer. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Pumpkin Sheet Cake
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
In a medium sized bowl, mix the flour, baking powder, baking soda, sea salt, cinnamon and nutmeg; set aside.
In a separate bowl, beat together the pumpkin, honey, eggs, melted coconut oil and vanilla. Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until just combined.
Pour the batter into a greased 9x13 baking dish and bake for 25 minutes. Let cool.
While the cake is baking, beat together the frosting ingredients. Store in the fridge until ready to use.
Frost the cake once cooled. Slice into 15 servings and Enjoy! Store extras in the fridge.

recipes.title: Raspberry Angel Food Cake
directions: Preheat your oven to 350°F.
In a large bowl, sift the cake flour, ½ cup of sugar, and salt twice to ensure they are well mixed.
In a small bowl, mash the fresh raspberries and then pass them through a fine sieve to yield ¼ cup of raspberry puree. Set aside.
In a separate bowl, beat the egg whites until they become foamy. Add the cream of tartar and vanilla, then continue beating until stiff peaks form.
Gradually add the remaining 1 cup of sugar, 2 tablespoons at a time, while continuing to beat the egg whites until glossy and stiff.
Sift the flour mixture over the beaten egg whites, folding gently until just combined.

Gently transfer 1/3 of the batter into an ungreased 10-inch tube pan. Spoon 2 tablespoons of raspberry puree on top of this layer. Repeat the process with another third of the batter, adding another 2 tablespoons of raspberry puree. Top with the remaining batter.
Use a knife to gently swirl through the batter to eliminate any air pockets.
Bake in the preheated oven for 35-45 minutes, or until the cake is lightly golden.
Immediately remove the cake from the oven and invert the pan to cool by hanging it on the neck of a bottle or placing it upside down on a cooling rack.
Let the cake cool completely. Once cooled, run a knife around the edges of the pan to loosen the cake.
Serve the cake with the remaining fresh raspberries.

recipes.title: Score Cake (Better Than Sex)
directions: Prepare the Swiss cake mix according to the package directions, but replace the oil with 1½ cups of Cool-Whip
Bake as directed on the package
While the cake is still hot, poke holes and pour sweetened condensed milk over the cake
Allow the cake to cool, then spread the remaining 12 oz of Cool-Whip on top
Crush the 2 Score bars and sprinkle them on top

recipes.title: Sour Cream Banana Cake
directions: Preheat the oven to 375°F.
Cream together the butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Stir in the vanilla.
Sift together the flour, baking powder, salt, and baking soda.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the butter mixture, alternating with sour cream, beginning and ending with the dry ingredients.
Fold in the mashed bananas and chopped nuts, if using.
Pour the batter into a greased 9x13-inch baking pan (or divide into loaf pans for banana bread).
Bake at 375°F for 30 minutes (or longer if using loaf pans).
If baking in a 9x13-inch pan, let cool and frost if desired. For banana bread, enjoy without frosting.

recipes.title: Strawberry Shortcake
directions: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
In a large bowl, mix together the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
Cut in the butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Add the orange rind, heavy cream, and whole milk, and stir until combined.
Flour your surface and roll out the dough to about ½ inch thick.
Use a star-shaped cookie cutter to cut out shortcakes.
Brush the tops of the shortcakes with heavy cream and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake in the preheated oven until the shortcakes are slightly browned, about 10-12 minutes.
Let the shortcakes cool before slicing them in half.
For the Fruit Mixture:
In a bowl, combine the cut strawberries and blueberries.
Sprinkle with sugar to taste and add the orange juice. Stir to coat the fruit.
To Serve:
Slice the shortcakes in half.
Place a spoonful of whipped cream on the bottom half of each shortcake.
Add half of the shortcake, followed by the fruit mixture.
Top with the other half of the shortcake.
Optionally, add more whipped cream on top.

recipes.title: Tres Leches Cake
ingredients: 1 package Betty Crocker SuperMoist yellow cake mix
directions: Prepare the cake:
Preheat the oven to 375°F.
In a bowl, beat the cake mix, oil, flour, eggs, and water on medium speed for 2 minutes.
Pour the batter into a greased and floured 13x9-inch pan.
Bake for 35 minutes or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean.
Let the cake stand for 5 minutes after baking.
Make the milk mixture:
In a large bowl, mix together the whipping cream, whole milk, sweetened condensed milk, and rum extract.
Soak the cake:
Once the cake has cooled slightly, pierce the top every ½ inch with a fork, wiping the fork occasionally to reduce sticking.
Carefully pour the whipping cream mixture evenly over the cake.
Cover the cake and refrigerate for about 3 hours to allow the milk mixture to soak in.
Prepare the topping:
In a separate bowl, whip the heavy cream and vanilla or almond extract until soft peaks form.
Assemble the cake:
Spread the whipped cream on top of the cake.
Sprinkle with toasted coconut and chopped pecans.
Serve:
Store the cake covered in the refrigerator until ready to serve.

recipes.title: Upside Down Pumpkin Pie
ingredients: ½ serving CSE Simply Vanilla protein powder
directions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees.
Place the eggs in blender and blend until frothy. Add the milk, pumpkin, honey, protein powder, cinnamon and pumpkin pie spice to the blender. Blend on low for 2 minutes.

Spray two, 9-inch pie rounds with cooking spray or line with a round piece of parchment paper. Pour half of the mixture into each round and bake for 15 minutes. Turn the heat down to 350 degrees and bake an additional 40 minutes. Refrigerate for at least two hours.

Make the crust topping by placing the almonds and cashews into a high-powered blender; pulse until broken up. Pour into a bowl, then add the shredded coconut, rolled oats, flaxseed meal, vanilla and sea salt to the bowl. Add the pitted dates to the blender and pulse until it turns into a paste. Add it to the bowl and mix well.
Once the pie is cooled, spread half of the crust mixture over each pie. Slice into 16 servings and top each serving with whipped cream. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Vanilla Chai Pumpkin Cupcakes
ingredients: 8 oz cream cheese, ⅓ reduced fat
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Line a cupcake pan with liners.
In a small bowl, mix together the chai spice.
In a stand mixer or with a hand mixer, mix together the melted butter, Truvia, vanilla, eggs, and pumpkin until completely combined.
In a medium mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and chai spice. Add the dry ingredients to the wet and mix until combined.
Scoop the batter into the liners — there's enough for 18 cupcakes. Bake 18–20 minutes.
For the frosting, cream the butter and cream cheese until fluffy. Add the vanilla, powdered sugar, and protein powder and mix until completely smooth. Cool the cupcakes completely before frosting.

recipes.title: Almond Joy Cookie Dough Bites
ingredients: 2 servings CSE Simply Vanilla protein powder
¼ cup cocoa nibs or mini chocolate chips
directions: Mix all ingredients together, adding the oats last, until well combined.
Using a small cookie scoop, scoop into balls and store in the fridge or freezer. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Almond Joy Cookies
ingredients: ¼ cup softened coconut butter or coconut manna
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.
Mix the almond butter, coconut butter and honey together in a bowl. Beat in the eggs and extracts; set aside.

In a separate bowl, combine the flour, rolled oats, baking soda and sea salt. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until just combined. Fold in the chocolate chips, flaked coconut and chopped almonds.

Using a small cookie scoop, scoop onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper (makes 30 cookies). Bake for 7 minutes. Let cool on the cookie sheet for 2 minutes, then transfer to a cooling rack. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Butter Cream Frosting
directions: In a mixing bowl, cream the butter
Add powdered sugar, salt, almond extract, and cream
Beat until smooth and spreadable
If necessary, thin with additional cream

recipes.title: Cadbury Mini Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup unsalted butter, at room temperature
1 1/2 cups chopped Cadbury Mini Eggs (can substitute a mix of white and chocolate chips and Heath bits)
Flaked sea salt, for sprinkling on cookies
See the post for instructions on toasting coconut
You can chill the dough for 24-72 hours to enhance flavor
The cookies will keep in an airtight container for 3-4 days
Dough and baked cookies can be frozen for later enjoyment
directions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a large baking sheet with a Silpat mat or parchment paper and set aside
In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, baking soda, and sea salt. Set aside
Using a stand mixer, cream butter and sugars together for about 1 minute. Add eggs and vanilla, and mix until combined
Add dry ingredients and mix on low until just combined
Stir in chopped Cadbury Mini Eggs, chocolate chips, and toasted coconut
Form dough into balls, about 2 tablespoons each, and place on the prepared baking sheet, about 2 inches apart
Bake cookies for 10-12 minutes, or until edges are slightly golden brown. Remove from oven and sprinkle with sea salt
Let cookies cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire cooling rack to cool completely

recipes.title: Caveman Cookies
ingredients: 1 serving CSE Simply Vanilla protein powder
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Mix all the ingredients together, stirring in the chocolate chips last. Batter will be thick and sticky.

Using a small cookie scoop, scoop dough into balls and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper (makes 22 cookies). Bake for 7 minutes. Let cool for 2 minutes, then transfer to a cooling rack. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Chewy Gingersnap Cookies
ingredients: ½ cup coconut oil or grass-fed butter
½ cup organic sugar in the raw
directions: Beat the almond butter and coconut oil/butter together. Add the egg and vanilla. Slowly beat in the honey and molasses; set aside.

In a separate bowl, mix the flour, baking soda, salt, cloves, ginger and cinnamon. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until just combined. Cover and chill in the fridge for one hour.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

Remove the dough from the fridge. Using a small cookie scoop, drop round balls of dough into the raw sugar one at a time. Roll around until well-coated. Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper (makes 34 cookies). Bake for 8-10 minutes. Let cool for 2 minutes, then transfer to a cooling rack. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: 1 package instant vanilla pudding mix (3.4 oz)
directions: Preheat your oven to 375°F
Prepare Wet Ingredients:
In a large mixing bowl, cream together the softened butter, brown sugar, granulated sugar, vanilla pudding mix, and vanilla extract until creamy and smooth.
Add Eggs:
Add the eggs, one at a time, mixing well after each addition.
Combine Dry Ingredients:
Gradually add the flour and baking soda to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined.
Stir in Chocolate Chips:
Gently fold in the chocolate chips until evenly distributed.
Bake Cookies:

Drop the dough by teaspoonfuls onto an ungreased cookie sheet, leaving a little space between each cookie. Bake for 8 minutes. The cookies will look slightly underdone, but they will continue to set as they cool.
Cool and Serve:
Allow the cookies to cool on the baking sheet for a few minutes, then transfer them to a wire rack to cool completely.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies (giant cookies)
ingredients: 1 cup plus 2 tablespoons salted butter (2.25 sticks)
15 oz good quality chocolate (about 2 heaping cups)
directions: Cream butter and sugars with the paddle attachment on your mixer until blended. Don’t overmix.
Add eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition.
Stir in vanilla and salt.
Whisk dry ingredients together in a separate bowl (or pour them in and whisk the top a bit before turning on the mixer).
Mix dry ingredients into the wet ingredients on low speed until almost fully combined (avoid over-mixing when adding the chocolate).
Add chocolate and mix on low until just combined. Avoid over-mixing to prevent a tough cookie texture.
Use a large ¼ cup cookie scoop to form dough balls and place them on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Freeze the dough balls until firm, then transfer to large zip-lock bags.
Bake at 350°F for 17-20 minutes, until light golden brown. Baking from frozen is preferred, but you can bake thawed dough as well.
Optionally, sprinkle with flake salt before serving.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Streusel Cookies
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
Make the Dough:
In a large mixing bowl, combine the softened butter, oil, and brown sugar. Mix for about 2 minutes until smooth, light, and fluffy.
Add the egg and vanilla extract, and mix until combined.
Gradually add the flour, baking soda, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. Mix until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Prepare the Streusel:
In a medium bowl, combine the softened butter, brown sugar, cinnamon, and a pinch of salt.

Start by adding 1/3 cup flour. Mix with a spoon or your fingers until the mixture sticks together but crumbles easily when run through your fingers. If needed, add more flour in 1-tablespoon increments until you reach the desired texture.
Assemble the Cookies:
Using a large cookie scoop, place balls of dough onto a lined baking sheet.
Make an indent in the top of each dough ball using the back of the cookie scoop or your fingers. Add a couple of tablespoons of the streusel mixture into each indent.
Bake:
Bake the cookies for 10-12 minutes, or until the edges are set and lightly golden.
Make the Icing:
While the cookies are baking, prepare the icing by whisking together powdered sugar, milk, and a splash of vanilla until smooth and runny.
Finish and Serve:
Allow the cookies to cool slightly, then drizzle generously with icing. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Classic Chocolate Chippers
ingredients: 1 cup coconut oil or grass-fed butter, softened
directions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Beat coconut oil/butter, coconut sugar, and xylitol in a bowl until smooth. Add the eggs and vanilla until just combined.
Add 2 cups of the flour along with the baking soda, sea salt, and chocolate chips. Mix on low until incorporated, then add the remaining ¾ cup flour and mix until all ingredients are incorporated.
Using a small cookie scoop, scoop cookie dough onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper (makes 42 cookies). Bake for 8-9 minutes. Let cool for 2 minutes, then transfer to a cooling rack. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Coconoat Macaroons
ingredients: 22 large chocolate chunks or Cadbury Mini Eggs (great for Easter)
directions: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.
Beat the coconut oil, almond butter, egg and coconut sugar together until smooth. Add the oats, shredded coconut, sea salt and cinnamon. Mix until well combined.

Scoop rounded tablespoons of dough onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper (makes 22 cookies). Bake for 8 minutes. Remove from the oven and press a chocolate chunk or Cadbury Egg in the middle of each macaroon. Let cool for 5 minutes and then transfer to a cooling rack. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Coconut Cashew Macaroon Bites
ingredients: 1 cup Toasted Coconut Cashew Butter (recipe below)
2 servings CSE Simply Vanilla protein powder
directions: Mix all ingredients together, adding the oats last, until well combined.
Using a small cookie scoop, scoop into balls and store in the fridge or freezer. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Fall Cookie Dough Bites
ingredients: 2 servings CSE Simply Vanilla protein powder
directions: Place all ingredients into a mixing bowl and stir together until well combined.
Scoop into balls using a small cookie scoop. Store in the fridge or freezer. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Fruit Pizza
directions: Prepare the Dough:
In a mixing bowl, cream softened butter and sugar together until light and fluffy.
Add eggs, milk, and vanilla, and mix well.
Gradually add sifted flour and baking powder, mixing until smooth.
Refrigerate the dough for 8-10 minutes to make it easier to handle.
Once chilled, divide the dough and spread it onto two greased pizza pans.
Bake in a preheated 400°F oven for 8-10 minutes, or until the edges are golden.
Let the cookie crusts cool completely.
Make the Cream Cheese Frosting:
In a bowl, beat together cream cheese, powdered sugar, softened butter, and vanilla until smooth and creamy.
Assemble the Fruit Pizza:
Once the cookie crusts are cool, spread a generous layer of cream cheese frosting over the top of each one.
Decorate the pizzas with fresh fruits like strawberries, blueberries, kiwi, and pineapple slices, or any fruit of your choice.
Serve chilled and enjoy!

recipes.title: Lacey Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Preheat the oven to 325°F. Cover baking sheets with foil and coat with nonstick vegetable spray.
In a medium bowl, combine oats, flour, salt, and baking powder. Mix well with a wire whisk and set aside.
In a large bowl, combine sugar and butter with an electric mixer at medium speed to form a grainy paste.
Add the egg and vanilla, and beat until smooth.
Add the flour mixture and blend just until combined.
Drop dough by teaspoonfuls onto baking sheets, spaced 2½ inches apart.
Bake for 10-12 minutes or until the edges begin to turn golden brown.
Let cool, then gently peel the cookies off the baking sheet with your fingers.
Be sure to respray the baking sheets between batches.

recipes.title: Lemon Drop Cookies
ingredients: ¼ cup raw honey or pure maple syrup
½ serving CSE Simply Vanilla protein powder
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.
In a large bowl beat the egg, almond milk, honey/syrup, melted coconut oil, lemon juice and lemon extract together; set aside.
In a separate bowl, stir together the flours, protein powder, baking powder and sea salt. Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until well combined. Fold in the lemon zest.

Using a small cookie scoop, scoop the dough into balls and place on a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper (makes 16 cookies). Bake for 5-6 minutes or until lightly golden on the bottom. Transfer to a cooling rack.
Beat together the powdered sugar and egg whites. Once the cookies are cooled off, place a sheet of parchment or wax paper underneath the cooling rack and drizzle each cookie with the icing. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Melt Away Cookies
directions: Mix the cookie ingredients together and bake at 350°F for 10 minutes
While the cookies bake, mix the frosting ingredients together
Let the cookies cool before frosting
Frost and enjoy!

recipes.title: Mint Chocolate Cookies
ingredients: 12 oz. Thin Mint Cocoa Bar in a Jar
2 servings CSE Brownie Batter protein powder
directions: Add the Thin Mint Cocoa Bar in a Jar, honey, protein powder, Kodiak Cakes Mix, vanilla and salt together in a bowl. Mix until well combined. Using a small cookie scoop, scoop them onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper (makes 36 cookies). Using the bottom of a glass jar or cup, smash the balls flat and then round out the edges with your hands to form into a cookie. Place the cookies in the freezer for 30 minutes or until hardened.

Place the dark chocolate and coconut oil into a small saucepan over low heat to melt (or melt in a bowl in the microwave). Stir continuously until completely melted, then turn the heat off. Drop each cookie into the chocolate one at a time and scoop them out with a fork, letting the excess chocolate drip off into the pan. Place the chocolate dipped cookies back onto the parchment paper and then place them in the freezer to harden.
Once frozen, transfer to a storage container or bag. When ready to eat, let cookies sit out 5-10 minutes to thaw before taking a bite. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Never Fail Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Cream the shortening, sugar, brown sugar, eggs, and vanilla together thoroughly
Mix in the remaining ingredients
Drop spoonfuls of dough onto an ungreased cookie sheet
Use a fork to create crisscross patterns on top of each cookie
Bake at 350°F for 10 minutes

recipes.title: No Bake Cookies
ingredients: ¼ cup peanut butter or coconut
directions: Boil sugar, milk, butter, and cocoa for 1½ minutes, starting the timer once the mixture reaches a full, rolling boil
Remove from heat and add peanut butter or coconut, oats, and vanilla
Beat until blended
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper
Let cool and enjoy!

recipes.title: Oatmeal Almond Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Line a baking sheet with foil.
In a food processor or blender, blend the oats into a coarse powder.
In a medium mixing bowl, whisk together the oats, flour, protein powder, baking soda, and salt.
In a stand mixer (or with a hand mixer in a large bowl), beat together the butter, brown sugar, and almond butter. Once combined, add the vanilla and egg and mix.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet and mix until the dough comes together. Fold in the chocolate chips.
Roll into 26 1-oz cookie dough balls. Bake for 11 minutes.
Serving size is 1 cookie.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Prepare Wet Ingredients:
In a large mixing bowl, cream together the shortening, brown sugar, and white sugar until smooth. Add the egg, water, and vanilla extract, mixing until well combined.
Combine Dry Ingredients:
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, salt, and cinnamon. Stir in the oatmeal.
Mix Wet and Dry Ingredients:
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture, alternating with the chocolate chips until fully incorporated.
Bake Cookies:
Drop dough by spoonfuls onto an ungreased cookie sheet, spacing evenly. Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F for 7–8 minutes. Do not overbake.
Cool and Serve:
Allow cookies to cool slightly on the baking sheet before transferring them to a wire rack. For best results, refrigerate dough between batches.

recipes.title: Oatmeal PB Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: ½ cup grass-fed butter or softened coconut oil
1 serving CSE Simply Vanilla protein powder
¼ cup natural peanut butter or almond butter
½ cup extra dark chocolate chips
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.
Mix the butter, coconut sugar, protein powder and the peanut butter together in a bowl. Add the eggs and vanilla; mix until smooth.
In a separate bowl, combine the oats, baking soda and salt. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until just combined. Stir in the chocolate chips last.
Using a small cookie scoop, scoop the cookie dough onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper (makes 20 cookies). Bake for 6-7 minutes. Let cool 2 minutes, then transfer to a cooling rack. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Orange Carrot Cookies
directions: Prepare the Dough:
In a large bowl, cream together the shortening, sugar, and egg. Add vanilla and mashed carrots, and mix well.
Gradually add flour, salt, and baking powder to the wet mixture, blending thoroughly. Stir in chopped nuts.
Form and Bake Cookies:
Drop dough by the teaspoonful onto a cookie sheet.
Bake at 375°F for 15 minutes.
Frost While Hot:
Frost cookies immediately after baking with the prepared orange frosting.
Combine Ingredients:
In a small bowl, combine grated orange rind, orange juice, powdered sugar, and salt.
Beat well until smooth, then spread on hot cookies.

recipes.title: Oreo Cookies
ingredients: 1 (8 oz) cream cheese (use slightly less than 8 oz)
directions: Mix the cake mix, eggs, and shortening to form a stiff batter
Roll the dough into small walnut-sized balls
Bake at 350°F for 9 minutes
For the filling, blend the cream cheese, vanilla, butter, and powdered sugar until smooth
Spread the filling on top of one cookie and place another cookie on top to form a sandwich

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Kiss Cookies
ingredients: 1 ½ cup Kodiak Cakes Buttermilk Mix
1 serving CSE Simply Vanilla protein powder
24 Hershey’s chocolate kisses or Guittard SUPER cookie chocolate chips
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Beat the peanut butter, honey and coconut oil together in a bowl. Beat in the eggs and vanilla extract; set aside.
In a separate bowl, add the Kodiak Cakes Mix, protein powder, baking soda, baking powder and sea salt; mix well. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix on low until just combined.

Using a small cookie scoop, scoop dough onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper (makes 24 cookies). Bake for 5 minutes. Unwrap the chocolate kisses and place one in the center of each cookie. Transfer to a cooling rack. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Pecan Sandies Cookies
directions: Prepare the Dough:
Cream together the butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add water and vanilla, mixing well.
Blend in the flour and chopped pecans, mixing until fully combined.
Form the Cookies:
Shape the dough into small balls and place them on an ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake:
Bake at 325°F for about 20 minutes, or until lightly golden.
Finish:
Remove the cookies from the pan and roll them in powdered sugar while still warm.
Makes approximately 3 dozen cookies.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Beat together the coconut sugar and butter. Add the pumpkin, egg and vanilla. Mix well and set aside.

In a separate bowl, combine the Kodiak Cakes Mix, baking powder, baking soda, spices and sea salt. Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined. Fold in the chocolate chips.
Using a large cookie scoop, drop dough onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper (makes 24 cookies). Bake for 10-12 minutes. Let cool 2 minutes and then transfer to a cooling rack. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Shortbread Squares
directions: Cream Butter and Sugar:
In a large mixing bowl, cream the softened butter and gradually add the sugar, mixing well until light and fluffy. Add egg yolks and blend thoroughly.
Incorporate Flour and Knead:
Gradually work in the flour until the dough is well blended. Knead the dough for 1 minute to ensure a smooth consistency.
Press and Prepare for Baking:
Press the dough evenly into a large cookie sheet so that it is about ¼ inch thick. Cut into squares and prick the center of each square with a fork.
Bake:
Bake at 325°F for 20-30 minutes, watching closely to ensure the top does not brown.
Finish:
While still hot, cut squares again and dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodles
directions: Cream Butter and Sugar:
In a large mixing bowl, cream together the butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition. Stir in the vanilla extract.
Combine Dry Ingredients:
In a separate bowl, sift together the flour, baking soda, salt, and cream of tartar. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the butter mixture, mixing until just combined.
Shape Dough:
Form the dough into small balls, about 1 inch in diameter. Roll each ball in a mixture of cinnamon and sugar.
Flatten and Bake:
Place each dough ball on an ungreased baking sheet, then press down with a fork to flatten slightly. Bake at 375°F for about 10 minutes, or until edges are lightly golden.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookies
directions: Prepare Wet Ingredients:
In a large mixing bowl, cream together the sugar, shortening, and eggs until smooth. Add the vanilla extract and lemon juice, mixing well.
Combine Dry Ingredients:
Sift the flour, salt, baking powder, and baking soda together in a separate bowl.
Mix Wet and Dry Ingredients:
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture. Once combined, mix in the sour cream until a soft dough forms.
Chill Dough:
Refrigerate the dough for at least 1 hour to make it easier to handle.
Bake Cookies:

Preheat oven to 350°F. Roll out the dough to desired thickness on a floured surface, cut into shapes if desired, and place on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake for about 12 minutes, or until edges are lightly golden.

recipes.title: Thin Mint Cookie Bites
ingredients: 12 oz. Thin Mint Cocoa Bar in a Jar (1 container)
2 servings CSE Brownie Batter protein powder
1 ½ cups Kodiak Cakes Buttermilk Mix
directions: Place all ingredients into a mixing bowl and stir together until well combined.
Scoop into balls using a small cookie scoop. Store in the fridge or freezer. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Ultimate Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 375°F. In a small bowl, mix flour, baking soda, and salt; set aside
In a large bowl, beat softened butter and sugars with an electric mixer on medium speed or mix by hand until fluffy, scraping the bowl occasionally
Beat in egg and vanilla until smooth. Stir in flour mixture just until blended (dough will be stiff). Stir in chocolate chips
Drop dough by rounded tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets, spacing them about 2 inches apart
Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until light brown (centers will be soft). Cool 2 minutes on the cookie sheet, then transfer to a cooling rack. Cool completely, about 30 minutes

recipes.title: White Chocolate Macadamia Cookies
ingredients: ½ cup coconut oil or grass-fed butter, softened
1 serving CSE Simply Vanilla protein powder
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Beat coconut oil or butter together with the coconut sugar and protein powder. Beat in the egg and vanilla; set aside.
In a separate bowl, stir the flour, baking soda and sea salt together. Add the dry mixture to the wet mixture; mix well. Fold in the macadamia nuts and white chocolate chips.
Using a small cookie scoop, scoop the cookie dough on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper (makes 24 cookies). Bake for 8 minutes. Let cool for 2 minutes, then transfer to a cooling rack. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Apple Crisp and Ice Cream
ingredients: 5 Honeycrisp apples, peeled, cored, thinly sliced
⅓ c Truvia brown sugar blend
1 tsp cinnamon, ¼ tsp nutmeg, ¼ tsp allspice
6 c Breyers CarbSmart Vanilla ice cream
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Lightly grease a 9x13 baking dish.
In a large mixing bowl, mix together the apples, coconut sugar, cinnamon, flour, and salt. Pour into the baking dish and press flat.
In a medium mixing bowl, mix together the crumble ingredients until completely combined. Sprinkle evenly over the apples.
Bake for 45–50 minutes. Let cool about 10 minutes before serving.
Cut into 12 even squares and serve each square with ½ c ice cream.

recipes.title: Blueberry Chocolate Bark
directions: In the microwave, melt the chocolate chips with the coconut oil. Stir in the protein powder.
On a small baking sheet or in an 8x11 baking dish, spread the blueberries and almonds. Pour the chocolate over them and gently stir until well coated.
Freeze 3–4 hours. Cut into 6 even pieces and serve.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Pecan Roll
directions: Melt the butterscotch morsels over hot (not boiling) water.
Remove from heat and stir in sweetened condensed milk and vanilla.
Add chopped pecans and mix well.
Roll the mixture tightly in waxed paper and chill in the fridge or freezer for a few minutes until firm enough to handle.
On wax paper or a board, form the mixture into a 12-inch roll.
Mark the roll surface lengthwise with the tines of a fork, then brush with the slightly beaten egg white.
Press pecan halves into the roll.
Wrap the roll in wax paper or foil.
Slice into ½-inch pieces, making about 2 dozen pieces.

recipes.title: Chex Muddy Buddies
directions: In a large bowl, place your 9 cups of Corn Chex and set aside.

In a medium-sized saucepan, melt the chocolate chips, butter, and peanut butter on low heat until completely melted and smooth. Stir frequently to prevent the mixture from sticking. Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla.
Pour the chocolate mixture over the dry cereal and stir carefully until it is completely coated.
In a large ziplock bag, pour the cereal mixture inside and then slowly add the powdered sugar. Seal the bag and shake well until all of the cereal is coated.
Spread the mixture out on waxed paper until the Puppy Chow is completely cool and dry. Seal in an airtight container and place it in the fridge.

recipes.title: Choco-Banana Nice Cream
ingredients: 1 Tbs. almond butter or peanut butter
2 ½ servings ( 85g) CSE Brownie Batter Protein
directions: Place frozen bananas, milk, nut butter, vanilla and stevia and a high-powdered blender. Pulse until bananas are broken up and then let blender run until smooth. Add in protein powder and blend until smooth.
Enjoy as is or for thicker ice cream, pour into a glass baking dish or loaf pan. Freeze 2+ hours.
Scoop out with an ice cream scoop and top each serving with ½ of a chopped square bar. 50 PB

recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Cups
ingredients: 1 roll refrigerated peanut butter cookie dough
1 ½ cups crunchy or creamy peanut butter
4 Nature Valley Oats 'n Honey Crunch granola bars, crushed
directions: Prepare the Cookie Cups:
Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Grease 24 mini muffin cups with cooking spray (like Pam).
Slice the cookie dough into 24 even pieces.
Press one slice of cookie dough into the bottom and up the sides of each mini muffin cup, forming a 1/3-inch rim above the top of each cup.
Bake for 10-15 minutes, or until the edges are golden.
Allow the cookie cups to cool in the pan for 5 minutes on cooling racks.
Shape the Cookie Cups:
After cooling for 5 minutes, gently press the center of each cookie cup with the tip of a wooden spoon handle to create space for the filling.
Let the cups cool completely before removing them from the pan.
Prepare the Filling:
In a saucepan or microwave-safe bowl, melt the white chocolate chips, milk chocolate chips, and peanut butter together. Stir constantly if on the stovetop, or frequently if using a microwave.
Assemble the Cups:
Once melted, divide the filling mixture evenly into the cookie cups, about 1 tablespoon per cup.
Sprinkle the crushed granola bars over the top of each filled cup.
Set the Cookies:
Refrigerate the filled cookie cups until the filling is set, about 1 hour.

recipes.title: Churro Popcorn
ingredients: 1 Tbs. brown sugar or coconut sugar
directions: Use an air popper to pop the kernels, then dump out onto a sheet of parchment paper. Spray the tops well with cooking spray, then dump into a large Ziploc bag.
Add salt, sugar and cinnamon to the bag and shake until well coated. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Cinnamon Almonds
directions: Preheat the oven to 250°F
Line a cookie sheet with tin foil and lightly spray with cooking spray
Beat the egg white, vanilla, and almond extract until frothy but not stiff
In a separate bowl, mix the sugar, brown sugar, salt, and cinnamon
Melt the butter and mix it into the sugar mixture
Add the almonds to the egg white mixture and stir until the almonds are evenly coated
Transfer the coated almonds to the sugar mixture and mix until the almonds are fully coated
Spread the almonds over the prepared cookie sheet
Bake for 1-1 ½ hours, stirring occasionally, until the sugars start to clump onto the almonds
Allow the almonds to cool before storing in an airtight container

recipes.title: Dark Chocolate Mousse
directions: Stir the Greek yogurt, cocoa powder, honey and stevia (if needed) together in a bowl. Add the fresh raspberries.
Place the chocolate chips in a bowl and heat in the microwave for 30 seconds at a time until melted and smooth; stirring in between.
Drizzle the chocolate over the raspberries and top with whipped cream.

recipes.title: Dark Chocolate Mug Cake
ingredients: 1 Tbs. Cocoa Bar in a Jar (online only)
directions: Spray a mug or bowl with cooking spray and whisk in the almond milk, egg whites, vanilla and stevia. Add the Kodiak Cakes, cocoa powder. Stir until well combined.
Heat in the microwave for one minute. Top with chocolate chips or Cocoa Bar spread and syrup, if desired.

recipes.title: Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter Cups
ingredients: ½ serving CSE Simply Vanilla protein powder
directions: Melt the coconut oil, honey and cocoa powder together in a saucepan over low/medium heat. Whisk until well combined. Remove from heat.
Place ½ tablespoon of the chocolate mixture into each mini baking cup. Then place in the freezer to harden for 30 minutes.
Combine the peanut butter, powdered peanut butter, protein powder, honey, vanilla and sea salt in a bowl; set aside.

Once the chocolate is hardened, add a rounded teaspoon of the peanut butter filling to each mini baking cup. Press down to flatten the filling and fully cover the chocolate. Then pour another ½ tablespoon of the chocolate mixture over the peanut butter filling. Return the peanut butter cups to the freezer for at least 60 minutes.
To store the leftovers, pop out each peanut butter cup and place them in a freezer bag and store in the freezer. Let sit out for 5-10 minutes to soften before eating. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Divinity
directions: Mix sugar, corn syrup, and water in a saucepan.
Cook the mixture over medium heat until it reaches a semi-firm ball stage.
Slowly pour ¼ of the mixture over the beaten egg whites.
Continue cooking the remaining mixture until it is almost brittle.
Slowly pour the remaining mixture over the egg whites while constantly stirring.
Continue beating until the mixture loses its glossiness and becomes dull and creamy.
Stir in vanilla and walnuts.
Drop spoonfuls of the mixture onto a greased shallow pan to form divinity pieces.

recipes.title: English Toffee
directions: In a heavy pan, cook on high heat: sugar, margarine, butter, and water.
Stir the mixture constantly with a wooden spoon for 8-10 minutes. Do not leave it unattended! The mixture should remain fluffy throughout the cooking process.

When the mixture begins to pull away from the sides of the pan and turns amber with a slight smoking, immediately pour it into an 8x8 pan. Do not scrape the sides of the pan as it could cause crystallization.
Let it cook for 8-10 minutes.
While the toffee is still warm, sprinkle the chocolate chips on top and spread them to melt.
Optionally, sprinkle with nuts for added crunch and flavor.
Once completely cooled, crack the toffee into pieces and remove from the pan.

recipes.title: Fruit & Froyo Bark
directions: Mix the two yogurts together and then stir in the melted coconut oil.

Place a piece of parchment paper in the bottom of a 9x13 pan. Pour yogurt mixture into the pan and smooth it out evenly with a spatula. Sprinkle the fruit and granola over the top. Cover and freeze for 4+ hours.
Remove from freezer and cut into 4 equal portions. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Fudge
directions: Combine milk, butter, and sugar in a pan. Boil for 2½ minutes, stirring until the sugar goes clear.
Add marshmallows and cook for another 2½ minutes.
Stir in chocolate chips, nuts (if desired), and vanilla.
Pour the mixture into a buttered pan and let it cool to set.

recipes.title: Gourmet Caramel Apples
directions: Wash apples, pat dry and remove stems. Pierce apples down the center with popsicle sticks; set aside.
In a small sauce pan, melt the almond butter, honey and vanilla together over low/medium heat. Stir constantly until you reach a caramel consistency. Remove from heat.
Roll each apple in the caramel one at a time, scraping the excess from the bottom. Roll the apple in optional toppings of choice. Place on parchment paper.

Place dark chocolate and white chocolate in two separate, small bowls. Microwave 30 second at a time until fully melted, stirring in between. Pour into separate Ziploc bags. Snip a tiny hole in one of the corners and drizzle over the top of your caramel apples.
Let cool in fridge 30 minutes before slicing. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Hershey Bar Fudge
directions: Boil the sugar, mini marshmallows, and evaporated milk
Once boiling, cook for 7 minutes, stirring constantly
In a bowl, mix the remaining ingredients (except frozen marshmallows)
Pour the boiled mixture over the bowl contents and stir well
Once mixed, add the frozen marshmallows
Store the fudge in the fridge

recipes.title: Homemade Ice Cream
ingredients: Any fruit you like (optional, for flavor)
directions: Mix the Base:
In a large bowl, whisk together the half & half, sugar, cream, eggs, and vanilla until the sugar dissolves and the mixture is well combined.
Add Fruit (Optional):
If you’d like to make a fruit-flavored ice cream, blend in the fruit of your choice (fresh or frozen). You can mash or puree the fruit for a smoother texture or leave it in chunks for added texture.
Freeze:
Pour the mixture into your ice cream maker. Follow the manufacturer's instructions for your ice cream maker to churn until the ice cream reaches the desired consistency.
Serve:
Once the ice cream is ready, you can serve it immediately or transfer it to an airtight container and store it in the freezer until ready to enjoy.

recipes.title: Honey Butter
directions: Whip the softened butter until creamy.
Add the vanilla and egg yolk, and continue whipping until combined.
Gradually add the honey while whipping until smooth and fluffy.
Makes 1 cup.

recipes.title: Honey Candy
directions: Cook honey and sugar together in a pan until it reaches the crack stage in cold water (or 300°F).
Pour the mixture onto a buttered surface.
Let it cool enough to handle and stretch with bare hands.

recipes.title: Mother Goose Popcorn
ingredients: Butter the size of an egg
directions: Place sugar, butter, water, vanilla, and food coloring together in a saucepan and bring to a boil.
Pour the mixture into a large pan.
Add 4 quarts of popped corn and stir until the popcorn is coated and sugary.

recipes.title: PB Pretzel Yogurt Bark
ingredients: 16 oz vanilla Greek yogurt, fat free
½ c salted mini pretzels, crushed
directions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a medium mixing bowl, whisk together the Greek yogurt and PB Fit until completely combined.
Spread evenly over the parchment to about ⅛ inch thick.
Drizzle with the honey and peanut butter, then sprinkle with the pretzels and mini chocolate chips.
Freeze for 4+ hours. Once completely frozen, peel off the parchment and break the bark into pieces.
One serving is about ⅙ of the bark. Store in the freezer for up to 1 week.

recipes.title: Peach Cobbler
ingredients: 2 cups fresh peaches, peeled and sliced
A pinch of nutmeg or cinnamon
directions: Prepare Peaches:
Peel and slice 2 cups of fresh peaches. Cover them with 1 cup of sugar and set aside to let the peaches release their juice.
Melt Butter:
Melt 1 cube of butter in an 8-inch square pan. After melting, remove from heat and allow to cool slightly.
Make the Batter:
In a separate bowl, sift together the flour, salt, sugar, baking powder, and nutmeg or cinnamon. Add ¾ cup milk to the dry ingredients and stir to combine into a smooth batter.
Assemble Cobbler:
Spoon the batter over the melted butter in the pan. Do not stir!
Gently spoon the peaches (with their juice) on top of the batter. Do not stir! The batter will rise around the peaches as it bakes.
Bake:
Bake at 350°F for 1 hour, or until the top is golden and bubbly.
Serve:
Serve warm or cold, with whipped cream or ice cream, if desired. This cobbler can also be made with other fruits or canned fruits if fresh peaches aren't available.

recipes.title: Rice Pudding
directions: Scald milk and butter in a pan over medium heat
In a separate bowl, beat eggs with salt and sugar until stiff
Slowly add the milk to the egg mixture, stirring continuously
Add cooked rice, raisins, vanilla, cinnamon, and ginger
Grease a casserole dish, pour in the mixture, and sprinkle with nutmeg
Bake at 325°F for 20-25 minutes

recipes.title: Sticky Bun Chex Mix
ingredients: 1 cup Cashew Coconut Caramel Sauce (recipe below)
directions: Pour Rice Chex cereal into a large bowl. In a small bowl combine the coconut sugar, cinnamon and sea salt; set aside.

Add the caramel sauce to a sauce pan over low heat. Mix until smooth and pourable. Pour over the top of the cereal. Use a large spatula to scrape the sides of the bowl and stir until the cereal is well-coated.

Once coated in caramel, pour the cereal into a large Ziploc bag with the sugar/cinnamon mixture. Shake until well-coated. Dump out onto a baking sheet lined with parchment or wax paper. Allow to cool before eating. Enjoy! CASHEW COCONUT CARAMEL SAUCE ¾ cup salted cashews ¾ cup raw honey ½ cup softened coconut butter (heat in the microwave and stir well) 2-3 Tbs. water ½ tsp. caramel or vanilla extract
Soak cashews in water for 1 hour. Drain and place in a high-powered blender with the rest of the ingredients and blend until smooth. Store in the fridge until ready to use.
When ready to use, place the caramel sauce in a saucepan over low heat and stir until warm and melted.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cheesecake Bowl
directions: Stir Greek yogurt, almond milk and pudding mix together in a bowl. Top with fresh strawberries, almonds and graham cracker crumbs.

recipes.title: Sugar Almonds
ingredients: ½ tsp vanilla or maple flavoring
directions: In a heavy saucepan, combine sugar, water, corn syrup, and salt. Stir over low heat until the sugar is dissolved.
Increase the heat and bring the mixture to a boil, cooking until it reaches the soft ball stage (238°F).
Remove from heat and blend in the vanilla or maple flavoring and butter.

Turn out the mixture onto a sheet of wax paper and separate the nuts.
Allow to cool and harden before serving.

recipes.title: Sugar Cookie Muddy Buddies

recipes.title: S’mores Lava Cake
ingredients: ¼ cup Kodiak Power Cakes mix
2 tsp. sugar-free, fat-free instant vanilla pudding mix
1 tsp. sugar-free, fat-free instant vanilla pudding mix
¼ (4g) of a graham cracker, crumbled
directions: Spray a mug or a bowl with cooking spray. Whisk all mug cake ingredients together until well combined. Microwave for 1 minute.
In a small bowl, whisk together all the ingredients to make the cream.
Top warm mug cake with cream mixture and crumbled graham crackers. 49 PB

recipes.title: Toasted Coconut Cashew Butter
directions: Place cashews and coconut into a blender and blend until smooth, scraping down the sides in between blends if needed. Pour into a jar or container and store in the fridge.

recipes.title: Yogurt Bowl with Homemade Maple Granola
ingredients: 2 tsp cinnamon, ½ tsp nutmeg, ½ tsp ginger, 1½ tsp pumpkin pie spice, ½ tsp salt
directions: Preheat the oven to 325°F. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper.
In a large mixing bowl, mix together the oats, quinoa, pecans, pumpkin seeds, cranberries, and apples.
In a medium mixing bowl, whisk together the butter, maple syrup, pumpkin puree, cinnamon, nutmeg, ginger, pumpkin pie spice, salt, and vanilla until smooth.
Mix the wet ingredients into the dry until well coated. Spread half the granola onto each baking sheet — a thin layer makes for better granola.
Bake for 60–70 minutes, tossing every 20 minutes for an even cook. Halfway through, drizzle the honey over the granola.
Cool completely before storing. The granola makes about 20 ¼-c servings (about 184 cal, 24c/8f/4p per serving of granola alone).
For each bowl, serve ¼ c granola over 1 c Greek yogurt with 2 tbsp each of strawberries, blueberries, and raspberries.

recipes.title: Zebra Caramel Corn
ingredients: ½ cup natural peanut butter or almond butter
directions: Pour popped popcorn into a large bowl.
In a saucepan, melt the peanut butter, honey and vanilla over medium heat. Stir until pourable.
Pour over the popcorn and stir until well-coated. Pour out onto a sheet of parchement paper and let cool.

In two separate bowls, microwave the chocolate chip flavors, 30 seconds at a time until completely melted and smooth, stirring in between. Pour the dark chocolate into a Ziploc sandwich bag. Cut a small hole in one corner and drizzle over the popcorn. Repeat with the white chocolate. Sprinkle sea salt over the top and store in the fridge to cool.
Once the chocolate is hardened, separate into 8 servings. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Chocolate Pie
directions: Melt the Chocolate:
In a small saucepan, heat the unsweetened chocolate and ½ cup of milk over low heat. Stir constantly until the chocolate is melted and smooth.
Prepare the Filling:
In a separate saucepan, combine the sugar, cornstarch, salt, the remaining 2¾ cups of milk, and the beaten egg yolks. Beat the mixture with a rotary beater or wire whisk until well blended.
Combine and Cook:

Stir in the melted chocolate mixture into the egg yolk mixture. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens and begins to boil. Once it reaches a boil, cook for an additional minute.
Finish the Filling:
Remove the saucepan from heat and stir in the vanilla.
Assemble the Pie:
Pour the chocolate mixture into the prepared baked pastry shell. Place a piece of plastic wrap directly on the surface of the hot filling to prevent a skin from forming.
Refrigerate:
Chill the pie in the refrigerator for at least 3 hours to allow the filling to set.
Serve:
Before serving, spread whipped cream over the top for a rich, creamy finish.

recipes.title: Coconut Cream Pie
ingredients: 3-5 Tb ice-cold coconut-flavored water (a coffee mug with water and 1/2-1 tsp coconut extract)
directions: For the Crust:
Cut the butter into small cubes and place in the freezer to make sure it's very cold
Place 1/3 cup shredded coconut in the food processor and pulse to finely chop. Then add the flour and salt, pulsing again
Pour a couple of ounces of coconut rum over ice to chill. Add the cold butter to the flour mixture and pulse until it's finely chopped and mixed into the flour, resembling oatmeal or little pellets

One tablespoon at a time, pulse in the chilled coconut-flavored water (a few tsp coconut extract in a coffee mug of water) until the dough clumps together, firm but not sticky. Usually takes about 4 tablespoons
Dump the dough onto plastic wrap, form into a disk, wrap, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes
Preheat the oven to 375°F. Roll the chilled dough out on a floured surface into a 14-inch circle
Gently roll the dough over the rolling pin to transfer it to the pie pan. Don't stretch it—just move it gently into the pan. Turn the edges under and crimp to seal
Place a large piece of foil over the dough and gently shape it over the crust. Fill with pie weights or dried beans and bake for 15 minutes.
Remove the foil and weights, then bake for another 10 minutes. Cool completely before filling
Spread coconut onto a baking sheet and toast for 3-5 minutes until golden, then remove and cool. Don't leave the coconut unattended—it can burn quickly!
For the Filling:
Place instant pudding mix in a large jar or airtight container. Add cream of coconut and milk. Cover tightly and shake for 1-2 minutes until well combined. Refrigerate
Using an electric mixer, whip heavy cream with vanilla and sugar. Transfer to a separate bowl and refrigerate
Beat cream cheese until light and fluffy. Slowly beat in the pudding mixture a little at a time, scraping the bowl regularly to ensure smoothness
Fold in half of the whipped cream until smooth
Scoop the filling into the cooled pie crust. Top with the remaining whipped cream and generously sprinkle with toasted coconut
Chill for at least 4 hours, preferably overnight for best results

recipes.title: Cookie Crumb Pie Crust
directions: Combine all ingredients and press the mixture evenly into the bottom and up the sides of a 9-inch pie plate.
Bake at 400°F for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese Crust
directions: Combine the cream cheese and butter together, mixing well.
Gradually stir in the flour until the dough forms.
Roll out the dough between two sheets of waxed paper.
Transfer to a 9-inch pie plate and prick the dough with a fork to prevent shrinkage.
Bake at 350°F for 12-15 minutes or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Cream Pie Filling
ingredients: 3 egg yolks (or 2 whole eggs for a slightly less smooth filling)
directions: In a 3-quart saucepan, mix together the cornstarch, sugar, and salt.
Add the milk and cream and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture becomes smooth and thick.
Pour a small amount of the hot mixture into the egg yolks to temper them. Blend thoroughly, then return the egg mixture to the saucepan.
Cook for another 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat and stir in the butter and vanilla.
For Coconut Cream Pie:
Add ½ cup of coconut (toasted if desired) to the pie filling, then pour it into the baked pie crust.
Chill for 3-4 hours.
Once ready to serve, whip the cream and spread it over the pie. Top with an additional ½ cup of coconut.
For Banana Cream Pie:
Slice 2 bananas and arrange them in the bottom of the baked pie crust.
Pour the prepared filling over the bananas.
Chill for 3-4 hours.
When ready to serve, whip the cream and spread it over the pie.

recipes.title: Dear Abby’s Famous Pecan Pie
directions: Prepare the Pie Crust:
Preheat your oven to 350°F. Prepare the 9-inch pie crust in a pie dish.
Make the Filling:
In a large bowl, combine the corn syrup, brown sugar, eggs, melted butter, salt, and vanilla. Mix well until fully combined.
Assemble the Pie:
Pour the filling mixture into the prepared pie crust. Sprinkle the pecan (or walnut) halves evenly over the top.
Bake:

Bake the pie in the preheated oven for 45 to 50 minutes or until the center is set. (You can check by inserting a toothpick—it should come out clean when the pie is done.) If the crust or pie begins to get too brown, cover it with foil for the remainder of the baking time.
Serve:
Allow the pie to cool slightly. You can serve it plain, or top it with whipped cream or ice cream for an extra indulgent treat!

recipes.title: Deep Dish Apple Pie
ingredients: A few drops of lemon flavoring or fresh lemon juice
For the Topping (for Apple Brown Betty option):
Follow the same steps as the Deep Dish Apple Pie, but instead of a traditional pie crust, make the topping.
Blend together 1 cup flour, 1 cup brown sugar, and 1 cube butter until crumbly.
Spread this topping evenly over the apple filling and bake in the same 350°F oven for about 1 hour.
directions: Prepare the Apple Filling:

In a large bowl, blend together sugar, salt, cornstarch, lemon flavoring (or fresh lemon juice), and cinnamon. Sprinkle this mixture over the sliced apples. Let the apples stand for 1 hour to allow the flavors to meld.
Assemble the Pie:
Place the apple mixture into a deep dish pie pan. Cover with pie dough. Bake in a 350°F oven for about 1 hour, or until the crust is golden brown and the apples are tender.

recipes.title: Fresh Peach Pie
directions: Prepare the Cornstarch Paste:
In a bowl, combine ¾ cup cornstarch, salt, and sugar. Add 1½ cups cold water and stir until smooth.
Boil Water and Combine:
Bring 2 cups of water to a boil. Slowly add the cornstarch mixture to the boiling water, stirring constantly. Cook over medium heat for about 3 minutes or until the mixture becomes very thick.
Add Lemon Juice and Chill:
Remove the mixture from the heat and stir in the lemon juice. Let the mixture cool to room temperature, then chill thoroughly in the refrigerator.
Prepare the Peaches:
Peel and slice the ripe peaches, being careful to slice them evenly.
Assemble the Pie:
Once the glaze is fully chilled, carefully stir enough glaze to coat each slice of peach. Pour the glazed peaches into pre-baked pie crusts (this recipe makes enough for 3 - 9-inch pies).
Serve:
Top with whipped cream and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Graham Cracker Pie Crust
directions: Combine all ingredients and press the mixture evenly into the bottom and up the sides of a 9-inch pie plate.

recipes.title: Mud Pie
ingredients: ½ gallon ice cream (cookies ‘n cream or mint chocolate chip)
¼ cup evaporated milk(Alternatively, you can use Hershey’s Chocolate Fudge Sauce)
directions: Prepare the Crust:
Melt the butter. Mix the melted butter with the crushed Oreo cookies. Press the mixture into a 9-inch pie pan and freeze for several hours.
Fill the Pie:
Once the crust is frozen, fill the crust with the ice cream, shaping it into a round form. Freeze again until the ice cream is nice and firm.
Make the Sauce:

Melt the chocolate in a saucepan. Add 1 tablespoon of butter and ¼ cup of evaporated milk. Stir until smooth and remove from heat to cool. (If you are using Hershey’s Fudge Sauce, make sure it's cooled in the fridge before using.)
Assemble the Pie:
Once the ice cream is firm, pour the cooled chocolate sauce over the top of the pie and spread it evenly. Sprinkle with chopped pecans or walnuts.
Serve:
Before slicing, dip the knife in hot water for 15-20 seconds to make cutting easier. You can top each slice with whipped cream and a cherry for an extra special touch!

recipes.title: Pie Crust (Martha Stewart)

Gradually add ¼ to ½ cup ice water, pulsing as you go until the dough forms.

recipes.title: Pie Pastry
ingredients: ¾ cup shortening (chilled in the freezer)
directions: Mix the flour and salt together in a bowl.

Gradually add the ice water, mixing with fingers or a fork until the dough holds together.
Roll out the dough on a pastry cloth, then place it in a pie pan.
Bake at 450°F for 5-8 minutes, or until golden brown.

recipes.title: Fruit Trifle

Blackberries, strawberries, kiwi, blueberries, raspberries (or other colorful fruit, excluding melons)

recipes.title: Homemade Rootbeer
ingredients: Very cold water (enough to make 4 gallons, about 3½ gallons)
2 (2 oz) bottles Root Beer Extract (McCormick or Hires)
directions: Dissolve Sugar
In a 5-gallon drink cooler, add the hot water and then the sugar. Stir until the sugar is completely dissolved.
Add Ice
Add the 4 cups of ice and stir with a long spoon until the ice is mostly melted.
Add Cold Water and Extract

Add enough very cold water to the cooler to make 4 gallons of liquid. Then add the Root Beer Extract. The colder the water, the more carbon dioxide will be generated from the dry ice, creating a fizzy effect.
Prepare the Dry Ice
Dry ice comes in a paper bag. Leave it in the bag and break it into smaller pieces by gently tapping it with a hammer. Wear gloves while handling dry ice, as it can burn your skin.
Add Dry Ice
Slowly add pieces of dry ice to the root beer mixture a few pieces at a time. The dry ice will cause the mixture to bubble and "smoke" like a witch's cauldron. This creates a dramatic party effect!
Let it Boil
Let the mixture "boil" for about 20-30 minutes. Stir the root beer every 5 minutes, but do not seal the container tightly—otherwise, the lid may pop off due to the pressure buildup.
Serve and Enjoy

Once the dry ice has evaporated and the mixture has cooled, you can scoop out the slush that forms at the bottom of the container—perfect for a hot day! Serve it with an ice cream scoop. You can also make root beer floats by adding homemade ice cream.

recipes.title: Protein & Super Greens Smoothie
ingredients: ¾ serving (24g) CSE Simply Vanilla Protein
directions: Place all ingredients in a blender and blend on high until smooth. Enjoy! 46 PB

recipes.title: Protein Power Crunch Shake
directions: Place all the ingredients in a blender. Blend on high until smooth.

recipes.title: Radiant Raspberry Shake
ingredients: ½ cup fresh or frozen raspberries
½ serving CSE Simply Vanilla protein powder
directions: Place all the ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth.

recipes.title: Snickers Shake
ingredients: 2 Tbs. CSE Brownie Batter protein powder
directions: Place milk, protein powder, bananas, oats, peanut butter, cocoa powder and ice in a blender. Blend on high until smooth. Top with Reddi Wip and caramel syrup.

recipes.title: Strawberry Colada
ingredients: ½ cup lite canned coconut milk
½ serving CSE Simply Vanilla Protein
¼ cup nonfat, plain Greek yogurt
directions: Place all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth.

recipes.title: Thin Mint Shake
ingredients: ½ serving CSE Brownie Batter protein
1 Tbs. Thin Mint Cocoa Bar in a
directions: Place all the ingredients in a blender, Wip. Blend on high until smooth.

recipes.title: Vanilla Chai Shake
ingredients: ½ serving CSE Simply Vanilla protein powder
directions: Place all the ingredients in a blender. Blend on high until smooth.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Pork Chops
ingredients: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp salt (divided), 1 tsp pepper (divided), 2 tsp smoked paprika (divided)
1 tsp garlic salt, ½ tsp pepper
directions: Cook the rice according to the package instructions.
Preheat the air fryer to 400°F.
In a shallow bowl, whisk together the parmesan and spices.
Pat the pork chops dry, then spray both sides with oil. Dredge the chops in the parmesan-spice mix and rub it in well — try to use it all up!
Arrange the pork chops in the air fryer in one even layer. Air fry 9 minutes, flipping halfway through.
While the chops cook, heat the olive oil in a medium skillet over medium-high heat. Sauté the zucchini 5–6 minutes and season with the garlic salt and pepper.
Serve each pork chop over ½ c rice with ¼ of the zucchini.

recipes.title: Balsamic Steak with Caprese
ingredients: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, divided
1⅓ c cherry or grape tomatoes, quartered
directions: In a large zip-top bag or mixing bowl, rub the marinade into the steak (use only 1 tbsp of the olive oil). Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to overnight.

In a large skillet (cast iron highly recommended), heat the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil over medium-high heat and let the pan get very hot. Sear the steak 4–5 minutes per side, or until it reaches your preferred temperature. Remove from heat and rest for about 5 minutes.
For each serving, plate ⅓ c tomatoes, 2 tbsp mozzarella pearls, ¼ c basil, ½ c spinach, 2 tbsp red onion, ½ tbsp balsamic glaze, and ¼ c microgreens over 4 oz steak.

recipes.title: BBQ Pork Chops
ingredients: Three to four hours works for thicker chops, but with four chops 2 to 2.5 hours is usually enough.
directions: Preheat oven to 325°F for more tender chops over longer cook time.
Mix all sauce ingredients in a bowl.
Place pork chops in a baking dish in a single layer.
Top each with onion slices.
Pour sauce over the top.
Cover tightly with foil.
Bake 2 to 2.5 hours until tender.

recipes.title: Creamy Curry Beef Rice Bowls
ingredients: ¾ cup half-and-half, or coconut milk
½ large red onion, sliced very thin
directions: Brown the ground beef in a large pan over medium-high heat, breaking it apart as it cooks. Add the garlic, smoked paprika, cayenne, red chili flakes and a generous pinch of salt. Brown it really well.
For the broth, warm the red curry paste and garlic in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir for 1 to 2 minutes, until softened and fragrant.
Pour in the half-and-half and the bone broth. Stir until smooth and bring to a gentle simmer.
Season the broth with a couple generous pinches of salt, fresh lime juice and chopped cilantro. Taste and adjust. You want it creamy, savory, a little spicy, and bright from the lime.
For the pickled onions, put the sliced red onion in a bowl with the lemon juice and a sprinkle of sea salt. Mix well with a fork and let it sit 5 to 10 minutes to soften.
Cook 4 servings of rice. Swapping the water for bone broth adds flavor and protein.
To assemble, add ¾ cup cooked rice to a bowl, top with a quarter of the beef, and ladle a quarter of the broth over everything.
Finish with thinly sliced cucumber, the pickled onions, sesame seeds, Korean chili flakes and plenty of chopped cilantro.

recipes.title: Creamy Dijon Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 2 tsp thyme (divided), 2 tsp parsley (divided), 1 tsp salt and pepper
1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp thyme, 1 tsp salt and pepper
directions: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet with foil.
In a large mixing bowl, toss the vegetables with the butter, thyme, parsley, salt, and pepper. Spread on the baking sheet and roast for 45 minutes, or until fork-tender.
In a food processor or blender, blend the Dijon sauce ingredients until smooth. Set aside.

Spray a large oven-safe skillet (cast iron recommended) with oil and heat over medium-high. Sear the pork tenderloin on all sides and season with the garlic powder, thyme, salt, and pepper. Transfer to the oven for 10 minutes.
Pour the Dijon sauce over the pork and return to the oven for 10–15 minutes, until it reaches your desired temperature.
Garnish with fresh parsley if desired. Each serving is 6 oz pork, 150 g potatoes, and 100 g green beans.

recipes.title: Crockpot Meatballs
directions: Combine the grape jelly and BBQ sauce in a small bowl or in the base of your slow cooker
Add the meatballs and stir until they are coated with the sauce
Cook on high for 2 to 3 hours
Enjoy as an appetizer or serve over rice for a main dish

recipes.title: Grilled Tin Foil Dinner
ingredients: 2 red bell peppers, sliced into strips
directions: Heat grill to medium heat.

Lay out 4 big rectangular pieces of tin foil and then a second layer of foil on top of each. Spray foil with cooking spray. Create patties by rolling the raw meat into 4, 4 oz. balls and placing one in the center of each piece of foil. Smash flat and season with a dash each of garlic, onion, salt and pepper.

Slice the potatoes, onions and peppers into thin slices. Place 150g potatoes, ¼ of an onion and ½ of a red bell pepper on top of each bison patty; Season with sea salt and pepper. Fold foil firmly around meat and veggies.
Place on the grill. Turn every 5 minutes for 20 minutes. Once cooked through, top each serving with 1 Tbs. ketchup and enjoy! PB

recipes.title: Lion House Meatballs
ingredients: Mashed or twice baked potatoes and green beans
directions: Mix all meatball ingredients
Form into meatballs and place in dish
Mix sauce and bring to a boil
Pour sauce over meatballs
Bake at 325°F for 35 to 40 minutes

recipes.title: Marry Me Chicken Orzo Bake
ingredients: 1 stock cube, dissolved in 700ml boiling water
80g sun-dried tomatoes, or sun-dried tomato paste
2g oil (the oil from the sun-dried tomato jar works)
directions: Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic and saute until soft.
Dissolve the stock cube in the boiling water, then mix in the soft cheese. Microwave until almost boiling.
If you are using whole sun-dried tomatoes, blitz them into a paste first.
Add everything except the cheddar to a baking dish. Mix well and bake at 200°C (400°F) for 20 minutes.
Stir well, top with the cheddar, and bake another 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Meat Loaf
directions: Combine all ingredients except for the Ketchup Sauce and shape into a loaf in a loaf pan
Spread Ketchup Sauce on top
Bake at 350°F for 1 hour and 15 minutes

recipes.title: Mexican Fried Rice
ingredients: 2 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic salt, 1 tsp black pepper
directions: Heat the oil in a very large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Brown the beef, breaking it into small pieces. As it cooks, add the onion, bell pepper, and garlic, and cook 3–5 minutes.
Add the green chilies, tomatoes, corn, and seasonings. Mix and cook 5–6 minutes. Add the cooked rice and mix; cook another 2–5 minutes.
Split into 4 servings and top each with green onions, 25 g avocado, and fresh lime juice.

recipes.title: Mississippi Pot Roast Sandwiches
directions: Put the chuck roast in the crock pot.
Sprinkle the ranch packet and the au jus packet over the top.
Lay the slices of butter across the roast.
Pour in the whole jar of pepperoncini, juice and all. Do not add any other liquid.
Cover and cook on low for 8 hours.
Shred the roast. Spread cream cheese on the hoagie buns and pile the meat on.

recipes.title: Philly Fried Rice
directions: Brown ground beef
Add onion and pepper, cook until soft
Stir in rice
Add au jus seasoning and water
Mix well and cook until heated through
Top with spicy ranch and fried onions

recipes.title: Pot Roast with Carrots and Potatoes
ingredients: 1 lb russet potatoes (about 2–3 large), cut into large chunks
1 lb carrots, cut into large chunks
directions: Add the chuck roast and onion to a slow cooker. Pour the seasonings on top and place the pepperoncinis over everything. Cook on low for a total of 10 hours.
After 6 hours, add the potatoes and carrots and cook for the remaining 4 hours. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serving size is about 4 oz pot roast, 150 g potatoes, and 150 g carrots and onions.

recipes.title: Roasted Winter Squash & Sausage
ingredients: 1 Tbs. fresh rosemary, chopped (1 tsp. dried)
1 Tbs. fresh sage, chopped (1 tsp. dried)
directions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees.
Slice the chicken sausage. Cube the butternut squash. Trim the Brussels sprouts and slice them in half. Cut the red onion in half and then slice thick. Mince the garlic cloves.

Combine the sausage and veggies together in a large bowl with the spices and seasonings. Spread out onto a baking sheet lined with foil or parchment paper. Spray tops with cooking spray and roast for 20 minutes or until veggies are lightly browned and tender. Weigh the entire recipe and divide the weight by four to get the amount needed to fill one serving. Enjoy warm.

recipes.title: Salisbury Steaks
directions: Mix the ground beef with bread crumbs, pepper, dry mustard, ketchup, evaporated milk, onion, and seasoned salt
Shape the mixture into patties and brown on the stove
In a separate bowl, mix together 1 can of cream of mushroom soup and 1 cup of milk
Pour the soup mixture over the browned patties
Cover the pan and cook on low for 20 minutes

recipes.title: Skillet Pork Chops and Apples
directions: In a rice cooker or pressure cooker, cook the rice according to the package directions.
In a large skillet (cast iron recommended), heat 1 tbsp olive oil over medium-high heat. Season both sides of the pork chops with salt and pepper and sear 3–5 minutes per side.
In a small mixing bowl, whisk together the bone broth and Dijon. Set aside.
Remove the pork from the skillet. Add the remaining tbsp of olive oil, the onions, and the apples, along with the sage, rosemary, and thyme. Sauté 5 minutes.
Add the broth to the skillet and return the pork chops. Mix to combine, turn the heat to medium-low, and simmer 3–4 minutes.
Serve ½ c rice with 1 pork chop and ¼ of the apples and onions.

recipes.title: Sunday Pot Roast
directions: Trim any excess fat from the beef chuck roast. Cut the beef into serving-size pieces and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cut up the vegetables (potatoes, carrots, parsnip, celery, and onion) into desired pieces.
Place vegetables, onion, and bay leaves in the slow cooker. Sprinkle with rosemary and thyme.
Arrange the beef cubes over the vegetables. Pour the beef broth over the beef.
Cover and cook on LOW for about 8-9 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Remove the beef from the slow cooker and place it on a large serving platter. Arrange the vegetables around the beef and discard the bay leaves.
Serve the pot roast with juices from the slow cooker or with homemade gravy (see below).
For Gravy:
Ladle the juices from the slow cooker and place them in a saucepan. Heat to a boil.
For each cup of juice, mix ¼ cup cold water and 2 tablespoons flour until smooth.
Add this mixture to the boiling juices, stirring constantly.
Cook until the gravy has thickened, then serve with the pot roast.

recipes.title: Asian Rice Bowl
ingredients: 14 oz. raw chicken breast (10.5 oz. cooked)
directions: Place olive oil, coconut aminos, honey, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, dry mustard, black pepper, sea salt and minced garlic in a large Ziploc bag. Shake and massage mixture until combined. Add all chopped veggies to the bag and let marinate in the fridge 2+ hours.
Cook and chop chicken. Prepare rice according to the directions on the package.

Place veggies in a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir veggies about 5 minutes, or until tender. For one serving, serve 1/3 cup cooked rice, with 2.6 oz. cooked chicken and ¼ of the marinated veggies in a bowl. Top with sliced green onions and 1 tsp. sesame seeds. 91 PB

recipes.title: Balsamic Chicken Chopped Salad
ingredients: Sea salt and pepper to taste
directions: Cube and roast sweet potatoes according to directions in the Food Prep Guide.

Cube the chicken; set aside. Whisk balsamic vinegar, olive oil, water, honey, Italian seasoning, garlic and sea salt together in a small bowl. Add two tablespoons of marinade to a bag with the cubed chicken and let sit for 10 minutes. Weigh the remaining marinade and divide the weight by four to get the amount needed to fill one serving of dressing for the salad.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook until all sides are golden and the chicken is cooked through.

For one serving lay 2 cups spring mix out on a plate and layer with 2.5 oz. cooked chicken, 3 oz. roasted sweet potatoes, chopped tomato, red onion, 15g avocado, one tablespoon feta cheese and ¼ of the remaining dressing/marinade. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: BBQ Bean Bowl
ingredients: 6 oz. raw sweet potato (5.6 oz. cooked)
1 cup Stubb’s Smokey Mesquite BBQ sauce
directions: Brown turkey with onions and garlic in a pan or skillet over medium/high heat.

Cube sweet potatoes. Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Spray tops with cooking spray and a sprinkle of sea salt. Bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes. Flip potatoes and add broccoli to the pan. Spray tops with cooking spray and sprinkle with sea salt. Bake another 20 minutes.

Place 3 oz. turkey, ¼ cup onions, 2 Tbs. black beans, 40g roasted sweet potatoes, ½ cup roasted broccoli and 2 Tbs. BBQ sauce in a bowl. Stir until incorporated. Top each serving with 1 Tbs. cheese, 30g avocado and chopped cilantro. PB

recipes.title: BBQ Chicken Chopped Salad
ingredients: 1 cup black beans, drained and rinsed
2 Tbs. Bolthouse Farms Cilantro Avocado dressing
directions: Cook or grill the chicken according to the directions in the Food Prep Guide.
Cube the chicken and mix together with the BBQ sauce.

For one serving, layer 2 cups of chopped spinach, 3 oz. BBQ chicken, ¼ cup of the black beans, ¼ cup of the corn, ½ of a diced tomato, two tablespoons diced red onion, 30g avocado, two tablespoons of the dressing and one tablespoon Parmesan cheese.

recipes.title: BBQ Chicken Sweet Potato Bowls
ingredients: ½ cup sugar free BBQ sauce
directions: Cube sweet potatoes, season, bake at 350 for 25 minutes
Mix coleslaw with ranch cottage cheese dip
Mix chicken with BBQ sauce
Assemble bowls

recipes.title: BBQ Ranch Grilled Bounty Bowl
ingredients: 12.5 oz. raw chicken breast (10 oz. cooked)
7 oz. bell peppers, seeded and halved
2 ears corn on the cob (1 cup corn)
directions: Cook rice according to the directions on the package. Season with a dash of cumin, turmeric and sea salt once cooked.

Heat grill to medium. Place chicken, zucchini, bell peppers and corn on the grill. Spray corn liberally with cooking spray and rotate it frequently. Spray tops of the other veggies with cooking spray and sprinkle sea salt, pepper and cumin over everything. Cook chicken and veggies about 5 minutes per side, until the chicken is fully cooked through and the veggies are tender.
Cut all the corn off the cob and set aside.

To each bowl add 2.5 oz. grilled chicken, 50g zucchini, 50g peppers, 1/4 cup corn, 1/4 cup cooked rice, 30g chopped avocado, 1 Tbs. ranch dressing, 1/2 Tbs. BBQ sauce, 1/2 Tbs. sunflower seeds and a squeeze of lime juice. Enjoy warm.

recipes.title: Burger Bowls
ingredients: Can also just buy burger sauce
directions: Brown ground beef, season with salt and pepper
Mix sauce
Build bowls with lettuce, beef, toppings
Drizzle sauce

recipes.title: Cheesy Taco Salad
ingredients: ½ tsp pepper, 1 tbsp taco seasoning
2 Laughing Cow light Swiss cheese wedges
2 bags Quest Nacho Cheese protein chips
½ c Greek yogurt, nonfat plain
½ jalapeño, membrane removed and deseeded
directions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Spray with nonstick spray, add the onions and peppers, season with ½ tsp salt, and sauté 5–7 minutes, until soft. Set aside.

Reduce the heat to medium and re-spray the pan. Add the ground turkey and season with 1 tsp salt, the pepper, and taco seasoning, breaking the meat up as it cooks. When it's about 80% cooked, break the Laughing Cow cheese into small pieces and stir in until combined. Return the onions and peppers to the skillet, turn off the heat, and cover for a couple of minutes to finish cooking.
Combine the dressing ingredients in a food processor and blend until smooth.
Build each salad with 1 c lettuce, about 1 c of the turkey mixture, 2 tbsp pico de gallo, 13 g protein chips, and 2 tbsp cilantro dressing. Toss and serve.
Macros without the protein chips: 171 cal, 10c/3f/26p.

recipes.title: Chicken Burrito Bowl
ingredients: 10 oz. raw chicken breasts (8 oz. cooked)
½ cup shredded Mexican blend cheese
directions: Grill chicken according to the direction in the Food Prep Guide. Cook the rice according to the directions on the package.

Plae cauliflower in a blender and pulse untiil broken up into rice. Place in a frying pan with cooking spray. Sautee until tender. Combine cauliflower rice, jasmine rice, chili-lime seasoning, sea salt, cumin, paprika and garlic powder together in a bowl. Weigh rice an divide by 4 to get the amount needed for one serving.

Slice chicken. For one portion, place ½ cup chopped romaine lettuce in the bottom of a bowl and layer 1 serving of the rice mixture, 2 oz. grilled chicken, ¼ cup black beans, 2 Tbs. corn, 2 Tbs. shredded cheese, 40g avocado, 1 Tbs. Greek yogurt, 2 Tbs. salsa, green onions and lime juice. PB

recipes.title: Chicken Harvest Bowl
ingredients: 1 large white sweet potato, cubed (325 g)
1 small crown broccoli, cut into large florets (260 g)
1 small crown cauliflower, cut into large florets (315 g)
¼ tsp red pepper flakes, ¼ tsp salt and pepper
1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tbsp salt and pepper, 1 tbsp Montreal Chicken Seasoning
directions: Preheat the oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet with foil.
In a medium mixing bowl, toss the sweet potatoes with ½ tbsp olive oil and ½ tsp salt and pepper. Pour onto the baking sheet and roast for 10 minutes.

In the same bowl, toss the broccoli and cauliflower with the remaining ½ tbsp olive oil and ½ tsp salt and pepper. After the sweet potatoes have roasted 10 minutes, add the broccoli and cauliflower to the baking sheet and return to the oven for 35 minutes.
In a food processor or blender, blend the vinaigrette ingredients on low for 4–5 minutes, until combined and fairly smooth.
