Preheat a grill or grill pan to 350°F. Season the chicken evenly and grill 4–5 minutes per side, until the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Set aside to rest.
In a medium mixing bowl, massage the kale with the olive oil.
Each serving: ½ c kale, ¼ of the vegetables, 4 oz chicken, and ¼ of the dressing.

recipes.title: Chicken Katsu Bowl
ingredients: ½ c coconut aminos or low-sodium soy sauce
½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
directions: In a rice cooker or pressure cooker, make the rice according to the package instructions.
In a small or medium mixing bowl, whisk together the sauce ingredients until completely combined. Set aside.

Set out three shallow bowls: flour in the first, beaten eggs in the second, and the panko mixed with sesame seeds in the third. Dredge the chicken in the flour, then the eggs, then the panko mixture, pressing the coating into the chicken so it sticks. Set aside.

Heat a large skillet (cast iron is great) over medium-high heat. Add 1 tbsp olive oil and heat until it shimmers. Cook each chicken breast until the breading is golden and crispy and the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Remove from the pan and let rest.
Add ½ tbsp olive oil, the broccoli, and the edamame to the same skillet over medium-high heat. Add 3–4 tbsp of the sauce and cook for 5–7 minutes, until fork-tender. Stir in the green onions.
Serve 4 oz chicken and 1 c veggies over ½ c rice. Divide the remaining sauce into 4 servings and drizzle over each bowl.

recipes.title: Chipotle Chicken Bowls w/ Street Corn
ingredients: 3 cups cooked rice (1 cup per serving)
directions: Cook the rice.
Toss the chicken with the olive oil and seasonings.
Spray a pan with avocado oil over medium heat. Sear the chicken a few minutes per side until cooked through.
Mix all the street corn salsa ingredients.
Assemble bowls with rice, chicken, and street corn salsa.

recipes.title: Citrus Chicken Salad
ingredients: 10 oz. cooked chicken breast, sliced (12.5 oz. raw)
directions: Peel grapefruit and chop into small pieces. Chop spinach and cucumbers. Set aside.
In a small bowl, mix together lemon juice, olive oil, honey and vinegar. Weigh the dressing in grams and divide by 4 to get the amount needed to fill one serving.

On a plate, layer 2 cups spinach, 50g chopped cucumber, 2.5 oz. chicken and ½ cup chopped grapefruit. Drizzle dressing evenly over each salad. Top each salad with 1 Tbs. parmesan cheese and 8 crackers. PB

recipes.title: Cobb Salad
directions: Grill chicken breast and boil eggs according to directions in the Food Prep Guide. Chop turkey bacon and place in a frying pan over medium/high heat. Cook until crispy.

For one serving, layer 2 cups spinach, 1 boiled egg, 1 slice chopped bacon, 1 oz. chopped grilled chicken, 6 cherry tomatoes, ¼ cup corn, 2 Tbs. dressing and 2 Tbs. chopped green onions on a plate. Enjoy 2 cups of watermelon on the side. 100 PB

recipes.title: Fajita Bowls
ingredients: 12 oz chicken breast, cut into thin strips
1 c black beans, drained and rinsed
directions: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the chicken, bell peppers, and onions. Season with the fajita seasoning and sauté until the chicken is cooked through, about 6–8 minutes.
In each bowl, serve ¼ c black beans, ¼ c rice, 2 oz guacamole, 2 tbsp salsa, 2 tbsp cheese, and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.title: Greek Meatball Tzatziki Bowl
ingredients: 1 c plain Greek yogurt, fat free
1 tsp white Modena vinegar or white wine vinegar
1 tsp salt, ½ tsp cumin, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tbsp parsley
1½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil, divided
directions: In a small pot, make the quinoa according to the package instructions.
In a blender or food processor, blend the tzatziki ingredients. Chill in the fridge.

In a medium mixing bowl, combine the meatball ingredients, except the olive oil. Rub about 1 tsp of olive oil on your hands at a time (using ½ tbsp total) while rolling the meatballs — this helps them keep their shape and keeps them from sticking to the skillet. Each meatball should be about 1 oz; you should have about 16.

Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet (cast iron recommended) over medium-high heat. When the oil is hot and shimmering, add the meatballs. Sear on all sides and cook for 6–8 minutes, until the internal temperature reaches 165°F.
In a large mixing bowl, massage the 1 tsp olive oil into the kale. Do not skip this step!

For each serving: 4 meatballs, ½ c cooked quinoa, 1 c kale, 1 tbsp red onion, ¼ c grape tomatoes, ¼ c cucumbers, ½ tbsp feta, and fresh dill and mint to taste. Drizzle ¼ of the tzatziki over each bowl.

recipes.title: Ground Turkey Teriyaki Bowls
directions: Cook rice
Brown turkey
Add garlic and broccoli
Stir in soy sauce, honey, sesame oil
Simmer 3 to 4 minutes
Serve over rice, top with sesame seeds

recipes.title: Kale and Cranberry Salad
ingredients: 12 oz rotisserie chicken, shredded and chopped
directions: Preheat the oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet with foil.
In a medium mixing bowl, toss the sweet potatoes with the olive oil, salt, and pepper. Spread on the baking sheet and roast 30–40 minutes, until fork-tender.
Make the quinoa according to the package instructions.
In a medium mixing bowl, massage the kale with the olive oil.
Toss together the kale, quinoa, sweet potatoes, cranberries, almonds, rotisserie chicken, and parmesan.
In a small bowl, whisk together the dressing ingredients. Pour over the salad and toss. Split into portions and serve.

recipes.title: Lemon Pepper Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 cup red onion, sliced into rings
directions: Make the Homemade, Honey-Wheat Bread in advance.

Whisk the olive oil, lemon juice, Sriracha and thyme in a small saucepan over low heat. Add salt and pepper to taste. Remove from heat and keep warm. Weigh the dressing and divide the weight by four to get the amount needed to fill one serving.

Heat oven to HI broil. Place the chicken and onions onto a greased broiler pan. Sprinkle with sea salt and lemon pepper. Broil for 8 minutes per side. Cut th chicken crosswise into thin slices. Separate the onions into rings.

For each serving, layer 2 cups of spinach, 2 oz. warm chicken, ¼ cup onions, ¼ cup tomatoes and ¼ of the warm dressing. Toss and top with one tablespoon feta cheese. Enjoy one serving of the homemade bread on the side.

recipes.title: Mexican Fajita Bowl
ingredients: 1 cup cooked (1/3 cup uncooked) white jasmine rice
1 cup black beans, drained and rinsed
directions: Cook the rice according to the directions on the package.
Slice the chicken thin and sprinkle with taco seasoning. Spray a skillet and add the chicken; cook thoroughly. Add the thinly sliced peppers and onions; sauté until tender.
In a bowl, layer ¼ cup cooked rice, ¼ cup black beans, 2 oz. cooked chicken, onions and peppers, and all the toppings. Enjoy warm.

recipes.title: Orange Almond Chicken Salad
directions: Marinate chicken in ½ of the marinade for 2+ hours. Reserve the remaining marinade in the fridge to use for the salad dressing.
Preheat oven to 375 degrees.

Combine the chopped almonds, bread crumbs and seasoning. Dip the chicken into the mixture and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Discard the used marinade. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until cooked through.

Place ¼ of the chicken on top of two cups of the spring lettuce mix. Weigh the remaining orange balsamic dressing and divide the weight by four to get the amount needed to fill one serving. Drizzle each salad with one serving of dressing, then top with orange slices and cracker crumbles.

recipes.title: Pear & Candied Pecan Salad
ingredients: 12 oz. grilled chicken breast (15 oz. raw)
directions: Grill or cook your chicken according to the directions in the Food Prep Guide. Slice chicken. Whisk or blend all the dressing ingredients together. Weigh the dressing and divide the weight by 4 to get the amount needed to fill one serving. Set aside.
Add pecans and 2 teaspoons of honey to a frying pan over low heat. Stir and heat 3-5 minutes or until coated and fragrant. Remove from heat.
For one serving, layer 2 cups spinach, 3 oz. grilled chicken, 110g sliced pears, ¼ of the candied pecans and ¼ of the dressing. PB

recipes.title: Roasted Butternut Squash & Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 2 chicken sausage links, sliced into rounds
20 oz. raw butternut squash, peeled and diced
½ of a sweet onion, thinly sliced
Stevia in the Raw, to taste
directions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

Chop the sausage, turkey bacon and butternut squash. Thinly slice the sweet onion. Pour them onto the baking sheet. Spray tops with cooking spray and sprinkle with sea salt. Roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes or until the squash is tender.
Cook the quinoa according to directions on package.
Whisk the lemon juice, olive oil, stevia and a pinch of salt together in a small bowl to make the dressing; set aside.

Combine the butternut squash, onions, sausage and quinoa together in a bowl. Stir in the spinach and cranberries. Add the dressing and toss until well coated. Weigh entire recipe and divide the weight by four to get the amount needed to fill one serving. Enjoy warm.

recipes.title: Southwest Chicken Salad
ingredients: Cumin, chili powder, paprika, black pepper
2 ears of corn on the cob
directions: Season the chicken with the cumin, chili powder, paprika and pepper, then grill until cooked through; chop. Grill or boil the corn and cut it off the cob.
Divide the romaine among 4 plates and top with the chicken, corn, black beans, bell pepper, jicama, tomatoes and avocado.

Stir the taco seasoning into the Greek yogurt with a spoonful of salsa to make a quick dressing. Drizzle over each salad and finish with the remaining salsa, green onions, cilantro and a lime wedge. (The original catalog page left off the directions, so this assembly is our best reconstruction.)

recipes.title: Spicy Honey Garlic Beef & Broccoli Bowls
directions: Cook rice
Brown ground beef
Add broccoli and cook until tender
Add garlic, soy sauce, honey, chili paste
Stir and cook 5 minutes
Serve over rice, top with sesame seeds

recipes.title: Taco Salad
ingredients: 1 cup black beans, rinsed and drained
½ cup nonfat, plain Greek yogurt
directions: Brown ground beef and onions together in a frying pan over medium/high heat. Add taco seasoning and stir until well coated. Remove from heat. Weigh the meat mixture and divide the weight by four to get the amount needed to fill one serving.

Assemble each salad by piling up 2 cups lettuce, ¼ of the meat mixture, ¼ cup beans, ¼ cup corn, ¼ cup tomatoes, one tablespoon cheese, two tablespoons plain Greek yogurt and two tablespoons salsa. Garnish with green onions.

recipes.title: Thai Power Bowl
ingredients: 10 oz rotisserie chicken, shredded and chopped
¼ c Bolthouse Cilantro Avocado Dressing
¼ c cashews, roasted and salted
directions: Prepare each bowl with 2.5 oz chicken, ¼ c quinoa, 1 c spinach, ½ c cabbage, 2 tbsp dressing, ½ c broccoli, ½ c bell pepper, ¼ c cucumbers, and 2 tbsp cashews.

recipes.title: Tropical Coconut-Mac Shrimp Salad
ingredients: 18 oz. raw shrimp, tail-off, peeled and deveined
¼ cup Buttermilk Kodiak Power Cakes Mix
¼ cup finely chopped macadamia nuts
directions: Heat oven to 450 degrees. Run shrimp under cold water to thaw, if frozen. Beat egg whites with a teaspoon of water in a large bowl. Set aside. Place Kodiak cakes, shredded coconut, chopped macadamia nuts, chili-lime seasoning and sea salt in a gallon Ziploc bag. Set aside.

Pat shrimp dry then toss into the bowl with the egg whites, then drain. Dump all the shrimp into the bag with the coconut-mac mixture in it. Shake until well combined. Place in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 10 minutes or until golden brown.
While baking, make the dressing. Add all the dressing ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth. Weigh the dressing and divide into 4 equal portions.
For one serving layer 2 cups spring salad mix, 1 cup cabbage, 2 oz. carrots, 25g fresh pineapple, ¼ of the shrimp and top with ¼ of the dressing. Enjoy! PB

recipes.title: Turkey Sub Salad
ingredients: ½ of a small red onion, thinly sliced
directions: Place all dressing ingredients in a blender. Blend on high until smooth.

Make salad by layering 2 cups spinach, 4 oz. chopped turkey, 1 chopped tomato, ¼ cup red onion, 6 slices cucumber, 6 slices pickles, ¼ of a bell pepper, 20g avocado and ¼ of the dressing. Enjoy 100g strawberries on the side. PB

recipes.title: Waldorf Chicken Salad Wrap
ingredients: 6 oz. grilled chicken breast (7.5 oz. raw)
directions: Cook chicken according to the directions in the Food Prep Guide.
Optional step: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place pecans or walnuts in a single layer on a baking sheet and bake for 6-8 minutes or until toasted and fragrant, stir halfway through.
Stir grilled chicken, chopped apples, grapes, celery and nuts together with yogurt, mayo, mustard, dash of sea salt and pepper. Add stevia until you reach your desired sweetness.
Weigh mixture and divide by 4. Evenly distribute mixture into the wraps, top with lettuce and roll up tightly. 109 PB

recipes.title: California Chicken Bake
ingredients: 1 cup shredded cheese blend, plus ¼ cup reserved for topping
2 boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut in half or diced
If rice is not fully tender at 50 minutes, add 2 to 3 tablespoons hot water and continue baking covered.
You can add black beans to stretch portions if needed.
directions: Preheat oven to 350°F.
In a bowl, mix cheese, rice, cilantro, salsa, and water.
Pour mixture into an 8x8 baking dish.
Place chicken on top.
Cover tightly with foil. Bake 45 to 55 minutes, until rice is tender and chicken reaches 165°F.
Remove foil during last 5 minutes. Sprinkle reserved cheese on top and bake until melted.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchiladas
directions: Combine soup, sour cream, chilies, and sautéed onion in a bowl.
Fry tortillas in hot oil, just long enough to soften them (quickly dip in and out of the oil).
Dip each tortilla in the soup mixture, then place half of the chicken and grated cheese on each tortilla.
Roll up the tortillas and place them in a greased baking dish.
Cover the rolled tortillas with the remaining sauce.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie Pasta
directions: Add everything except pasta and cheese to slow cooker
Cook on low 6 hours
Shred chicken
Stir in cooked pasta and cheddar
Cover until melted and creamy

recipes.title: Fire Roasted Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: ½ of a yellow onion, small
½ of a green bell pepper, diced
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.

Heat a large frying pan over medium heat. Spray with cooking spray and add bell peppers and onions. Sauté 3-5 minutes, then add cumin and chili powder. Cook another minute. Remove from heat. Add cooked chicken, beans, salsa and laughing cow cheese. Mix well.
Wrap tortillas in foil and place in oven 5-10 minutes to soften. Scoop 1/3 cup of mixture into each tortilla. Roll up carefully and place seam down in a greased 9x13 baking dish.
Top with enchilada sauce and cheese. Bake at 375 degrees for 20-25 minutes. Serve 2 enchiladas warm, topped with 1 oz. guacamole, green onions, cilantro and lime juice. 90 PB

recipes.title: Hearty Tuna Casserole
directions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.
Cook pasta according to the directions on the package; drain.
Combine pasta, tuna, mushrooms and bell peppers in a bowl; set aside.

In a small saucepan, melt butter over medium-low heat. Once melted add onions and sauté for 1-2 minutes. Whisk in Kodiak Cakes and let cook another 1-2 minutes. Slowly stir in chicken broth and milk. Bring to a boil, stirring continually. Once it begins to boil, turn heat down to low and continue to whisk until the sauce thickens. Remove from heat and season with salt and pepper.

Add mayo and mustard to the sauce. Pour over pasta, tuna and veggies. Stir gently until well combined. Transfer to a greased 8x8 baking dish. Sprinkle parmesan cheese and paprika over the top. Bake for 25 minutes. Slice into four equal portions. Enjoy warm.

recipes.title: Honey-Lime Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: ¼ cup nonfat, plain Greek yogurt
¼ cup low-fat, shredded mozzarella cheese
4 Tbs. fresh Pico De Gallo or salsa
directions: Add Greek yogurt, honey, lime juice, chili powder and garlic powder to a large Ziploc bag. Massage ingredients together until well combined. Add cooked, shredded chicken and onion to the bag. Massage all ingredients until well combined. Store in the fridge and let marinate 2+ hours.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Weigh chicken mixture and divide by 4. Fill each tortilla with ¼ of the chicken mixture. Roll up tight and place in a greased 9x13 baking dish.
Beat the Laughing Cow cheese until smooth, then beat in the enchilada sauce. Pour the mixture over the top of the tortillas and then sprinkle with shredded mozzarella.
Bake for 30 minutes. Top with fresh salsa, salt and pepper to taste.
Turn oven heat up to 400. Place asparagus on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Drizzle olive oil over the top and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Roast for 8 minutes. Enjoy on the side. PB

recipes.title: Mom's Enchilada Supreme
ingredients: 1 can chunk white chicken in water, drained
directions: In a saucepan, mix and heat the cream of celery soup, cream of chicken soup, green chiles, and chicken.
When hot, stir in the sour cream and Monterey Jack cheese until fully mixed and melted.
Fill and roll the flour tortillas with the sauce mixture. Place them side by side in a 9x13 pan.
When the pan is full, cover the tortillas with the remaining warm sauce.
Top with the cheddar cheese.
Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Poppyseed Chicken Casserole
ingredients: 2 (10 3/4 ounce) cans cream of chicken soup
directions: Preheat oven to 350°F
Place chicken in a pan, cover with water, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until tender and no longer pink (about 10 minutes). Once cool enough, cut into bite-size pieces
In a 13x9 inch pan, mix soup with sour cream and spread evenly
Sprinkle the chicken over the soup mixture
Place Ritz crackers in a plastic bag and gently crush. Add poppy seeds, shake to combine, then pour melted butter over the crackers and shake again
Sprinkle cracker mixture over the chicken
Bake for 30-40 minutes until bubbling around the edges and crackers are golden brown

recipes.title: Spaghetti Pizza Pie
ingredients: ½ cup low-fat, shredded mozzarella cheese
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cook the spaghetti according to the directions on the package.

Spray a frying pan with cooking spray and sauté onions, garlic and spinach over medium heat until onions are tender. Add the cottage cheese and cook until melted. Remove from heat and place in a bowl.
Add the cooked spaghetti and beaten egg to the bowl, stir until well combined. Press into two greased 9” pie pans to form a crust.

Brown the turkey in a pan over med/high heat. Combine cooked ground turkey and marinara sauce, then spread evenly over the spaghetti crusts. Sprinkle cheese on top and bake for 30 minutes. Let stand for five minutes, then cut each pie into four slices and serve warm.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Squash & Bacon Fritters
directions: Roast spaghetti squash according to directions in the Food Prep Guide. Once cooled, place squash in a paper towel and wring out the liquid with your hands over the sink. Try to get as much of the liquid out as you can.
Chop the bacon and cook it in a frying pan over medium-high heat until crispy; set aside.

Beat the eggs with an electric mixture on high for 2 minutes. Add the Kodiak Cakes Mix and beat until well combined. Add the spaghetti squash, parmesan cheese, green onion, bacon and sea salt. Mix until well combined.

Heat a skillet to medium-high heat. Once hot, spray with cooking spray and spoon ¼ cup of the mixture onto the skillet. Shape and flatten the top so the fritter is level. Repeat with the remaining mixture. Cook until the bottom side is golden brown, then flip the fritter over. Once both sides are golden brown, remove from the pan and top with Greek yogurt, salsa and green onions. Enjoy pomegranate seeds on the side.

recipes.title: Stuffed Acorn Squash
ingredients: 1 tsp salt and pepper, 1 tbsp dried parsley, 2 tbsp Italian seasoning (divided), 1 tsp dried thyme, 1 tsp dried basil, ½ tsp red pepper flakes
directions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.

Cut the acorn squash in half lengthwise and scrape out the seeds. Lightly spray the flesh with oil and season with salt and pepper to taste. Place flesh side down on a baking sheet and roast for 25 minutes, or until soft and tender.

While the squash cooks, prepare the filling. In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat. Add the onion, garlic, and ground turkey and sauté until the meat is cooked through, about 5–7 minutes. Add the salt, pepper, parsley, 1 tbsp of the Italian seasoning, thyme, dried basil, and red pepper flakes.
Add the cauliflower rice, tomatoes, and remaining 1 tbsp Italian seasoning. Mix until well combined. Cover, turn the heat to low, and simmer about 5 minutes, until the squash is done.
Season the squash flesh with salt and pepper to taste. Each serving is 1 acorn squash and ¼ of the filling, topped with parmesan and fresh basil.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Pie
directions: Cook sweet potatoes whole, according to the directions in the Food Prep Guide.
Chop bacon and cook in a small frying pan over medium heat until crispy.
Place the cooked sweet potatoes, bacon, eggs, six tablespoons grated Parmesan cheese, green onions, garlic, cumin and sea salt together in a bowl. Beat with a hand mixer until smooth.

Place mixture into a greased pie round or an 8x8 baking dish. Sprinkle the remaining two tablespoons of Parmesan cheese on top. Bake for 30-35 minutes or until edges begin to brown. Slice into four equal portions. Enjoy warm.

recipes.title: Tater Tot Casserole
directions: Layer the cooked hamburger, partially cooked peas and carrots, and tater tots in a baking dish.
Mix together the cream of chicken soup, cream of mushroom soup, and a little milk. Add the mixture to the layers.
Top with cheese.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes, or until it bubbles.

recipes.title: Tomato Herb Spaghetti Squash
ingredients: 2 large spaghetti squash, cut in half lengthwise
directions: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Spray the flesh of the spaghetti squash with oil and season with salt and pepper. Place cut side down on a baking sheet and roast 25–30 minutes, until the flesh shreds easily with a fork.
In a large mixing bowl, mix together the meatball ingredients except the olive oil. Spray your hands with oil and form 16 1-oz meatballs.
In a large skillet or pot, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat. Sear the meatballs on all sides and cook until almost done. Add the sauce, reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer 5–10 minutes.
Serve 1 c sauce and 4 meatballs over half a spaghetti squash.

recipes.title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
directions: Cook noodles in boiling water until tender, then drain.
Combine the cooked noodles, drained tuna, mayonnaise, diced vegetables (celery, onion, and green pepper), and salt in a large bowl.
In a separate bowl, blend the cream of celery soup and cream of chicken soup with the milk. Heat the mixture thoroughly.
Add the grated cheese to the soup mixture, stirring until the cheese melts and is well combined.
Add the noodle and tuna mixture to the soup and cheese mixture, and stir until everything is well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a greased casserole dish. Top with buttered bread crumbs.
Bake at 425°F for about 25 minutes or until the casserole is bubbly and golden brown on top.

recipes.title: White Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: 18 oz rotisserie chicken, shredded and chopped
1 tsp salt and pepper, 2 tsp garlic powder
1 c pepper jack cheese, shredded, divided
¾ c plain nonfat Greek yogurt
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Spray a 9x13 baking dish with oil.
In a medium mixing bowl, mix together the chicken, cream cheese, onion, salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Stuff each tortilla evenly with about 1.8 oz of the mixture. Roll tightly and place seam-down in the dish.
In a medium pot, melt the butter over medium-low heat. Whisk in the flour and taco seasoning. Add the broth and whisk until incorporated. Simmer 2–3 minutes, until it thickens.
Whisk in ½ c of the cheese until melted. Add the Greek yogurt and green chilies and whisk until combined — heat through, but don't let it simmer or boil.
Pour the sauce evenly over the enchiladas and sprinkle with the remaining ½ c cheese. Bake 22–25 minutes.
One serving is 2 enchiladas with 3 tbsp cilantro, ¼ c shredded lettuce, and ¼ c tomatoes.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Basic Chicken
ingredients: 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts (6 oz each)
directions: In a small bowl, mix butter, salt, garlic powder, smoked paprika, and pepper
Brush both sides of the chicken breasts with the butter mixture
Place chicken in the air fryer basket, standing against the sides of the basket if necessary
Set the air fryer to 350°F and cook for 15 minutes
Turn the chicken and cook for an additional 5 to 8 minutes, or until the juices run clear and the internal temperature reaches at least 165°F

recipes.title: Apple Chicken Hash
directions: Heat skillet or large frying pan to medium heat.
Place cubed sweet potatoes on a microwave safe plate. Spray tops with cooking spray and microwave for 2 minutes.

Spray skillet with cooking spray, then add sausage, sweet potatoes, onion, spinach and seasonings. Cook over medium/high heat for 5-7 minutes or until cooked through. Add chopped apples and cook 2 additional minutes (apples should be warm, but crisp).
Remove from pan. Weigh the entire recipe and divide the total weight by 4 to get the amount needed to fill one serving. Top each serving with ¼ cup shredded cheese. Enjoy! 93 PB

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Breasts
directions: Preheat the oven to 450°F. Pound the chicken breasts lightly so they are of even thickness.
Pour olive oil into a 13" x 9" baking dish. Lightly dredge the chicken through the olive oil to coat it, then place the chicken breasts side by side in the dish.

In a small bowl, whisk together salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and chili powder. Sprinkle the seasoning mixture over both sides of the chicken and rub it in with your hands. Make sure the chicken breasts are placed side by side without overlap.

Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, until the juices are clear or a meat thermometer reads 160-170°F. Note - Depending on the size of your chicken breasts, it could take longer. Mine were pounded to less than an inch thick.
Cover with foil and allow the chicken to rest for 5-10 minutes to let the juices settle before slicing.

recipes.title: Cashew Kung Pao Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup cooked ( 1/3 cup uncooked) white jasmine rice
1 tsp. sriracha sauce or chili paste
directions: Cook rice according to the directions on the package. Roast broccoli according to directions in the Food Prep Guide.

Cube chicken and place in a greased skillet over medium heat. Add whole garlic cloves and ginger. Cook until all sides of the chicken are golden brown and chicken is cooked through. Add the cashews and cook another minute. Turn heat off or down to low heat.

Whisk all the sauce ingredients together and add to the skillet. Stir until all the chicken is well coated. Weigh the chicken mixture and divide by four to get the amount needed to fill one serving. Serve one portion of chicken over ¼ cup of cooked rice and garnish with green onions. Enjoy the roasted broccoli on the side or stir in with the chicken and rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Alfredo
ingredients: 1 cup heavy cream or half and half
directions: Cook pasta according to package directions
Season chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning
Cook chicken in skillet until done, then slice
Melt butter in skillet
Add garlic and cook 30 seconds
Pour in cream and simmer lightly
Stir in parmesan until smooth and creamy
Add spinach if using
Add pasta and chicken to sauce
Toss together and serve immediately

recipes.title: Chicken Pillows
ingredients: 1 (8 oz) can Pillsbury Crescent Roll dough
directions: Preheat oven to 350°F and lightly grease a cookie sheet with cooking spray. Set aside.
Mix together the softened cream cheese and 1 tablespoon butter. Add in the chicken, chives, onion, and season with salt and pepper.

Unroll the crescent dough and press together two triangles to create one rectangle. Ensure the perforations are sealed well to prevent the filling from oozing out. Repeat to create 4 rectangles total.

Spoon about 3 tablespoons of the chicken mixture into the center of each rectangle. Fold each corner over the center of the filling, pressing to seal the edges and shape into a ball. Repeat with all rectangles.
Dip each chicken pillow into the melted butter, then coat in breadcrumbs, shaking off the excess. Place on the greased cookie sheet.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
While baking, make the chicken gravy: In a small saucepan, combine the cream of chicken soup, gravy packet, and water. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and let simmer until thickened.
Pour the gravy over each chicken pillow and serve!

recipes.title: Chicken Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 1/3 cups cooked (½ cup uncooked) white jasmine rice
Sea salt and pepper, to taste
directions: Cook rice according to the directions on the package. 2, Heat a skillet to medium heat and spray with cooking spray. Cube chicken and add it to the skillet; sprinkle with sea salt and pepper. Flip the chicken over every three minutes until the chicken is golden on the edges and cooked through. Remove from skillet and set aside.

Add the coconut oil, two tablespoons coconut aminos and garlic to the skillet. Once the oil is melted, add the carrots, pea pods, mushrooms, broccoli and water chestnuts. Sauté about 10 minutes or until the veggies are tender. Add a little sea salt and pepper to taste.

Add the cooked chicken and chopped cashews to the skillet and stir together with the veggies. Weigh the entire recipe and divide the weight by four to get the amount needed to fill one serving. Serve each portion over 1 / cup cooked rice. Top with remaining 3 coconut aminos and sliced green onions.

recipes.title: Chicken Verde
ingredients: Rice or tortillas, corn, black beans, mexican rice
directions: Add chicken to slow cooker
Mix salsa verde, garlic, oregano, cumin, salt
Pour over chicken
Cook on low 5 to 6 hours
Shred chicken and mix into sauce

recipes.title: Coconut Curry
directions: Roast the red bell peppers, broccoli, and sugar snap peas for 20 minutes.
While the veggies are roasting, cube the chicken. Spray a skillet and heat to medium. Add chicken and cook until browned, then add the shredded coconut. Stir until well coated. Turn heat down to low.

Add the roasted veggies and the Yellow Curry Simmer Sauce to the skillet with the chicken. Stir until well combined and let simmer for a few minutes. Turn heat off. Weigh the entire mixture and divide by 4 to get the amount needed for one serving.
Serve each portion of curry over ⅓ cup cooked rice and top with lime juice, 1 Tbs. cashews, and green onions. Add salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Creamy Garlic Parmesan Chicken
ingredients: ½ cup heavy cream or half-and-half
directions: Season chicken with salt, pepper, and Italian seasoning.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook chicken for 6-7 minutes per side or until cooked through (165°F). Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add garlic and sauté for 30 seconds. Add heavy cream, stirring gently, then add Parmesan cheese.
Simmer until sauce thickens slightly, about 2-3 mins.
Return chicken to pan, coat with sauce, and serve alongside steamed broccoli.

recipes.title: Creamy Italian Chicken
ingredients: ½ cup shredded mozzarella or parmesan
directions: Preheat oven to 375.
Season chicken.
Whisk cream cheese and broth. Spread over chicken.
Cover and bake 25 to 30 minutes.
Uncover, add cheese, bake until 165 internal temp.

recipes.title: Creamy Tuscan Chicken
ingredients: ¾ cup heavy cream or half and half
directions: Cook rice
Season chicken with salt, pepper, Italian seasoning
Sear chicken in oil, remove
Add garlic, cook briefly
Add broth and cream, simmer
Stir in parmesan, spinach, sun dried tomatoes
Return chicken and cook through
Serve over rice

recipes.title: CSE Summer BBQ Plate
ingredients: 2 Tbs. Bolthouse Farms Ranch yogurt dressing
directions: Pre-heat grill to medium-high heat. Remove husk from corn and remove silk. Spray all sides of the corn with cooking spray and place directly on the grill. Rotate every 2-3 minutes until kernels are tender and all the sides are evenly speckled with char spots; about 10-12 minutes.
Add chicken sausage to the grill with the corn and cook about 5 minutes per side.
Enjoy 1 chicken sausage and 1 ear of corn warm with ½ cup of watermelon and a salad on the side. Top corn with sea salt, minced garlic and/or lime juice to taste. 81 PB

recipes.title: General Tso's Chicken
ingredients: ¼ c coconut aminos or low-sodium soy sauce
directions: Make the rice according to the package instructions.
In a small mixing bowl, whisk together the sauce ingredients. Set aside.
In a gallon-size zip-top bag, shake the chicken pieces with the cornstarch until coated.

In a large skillet or wok, heat the canola oil over medium-high heat until it shimmers. Sear the chicken on all sides until golden. Add the ginger, chili flakes, and garlic; mix and cook until the chicken reaches 165°F, about 5–7 minutes total.
While the chicken cooks, heat the sauce in a small saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a boil, whisking constantly, until it thickens significantly, about 3–5 minutes.
Pour the sauce over the cooked chicken and turn the heat to low. Mix until well coated and simmer 3–5 minutes.
Steam the frozen broccoli in the microwave and season with salt and pepper.
Serve 4 oz chicken over ½ c rice with broccoli. Sprinkle with 1 tbsp green onion and ¼ tsp sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Grilled Bruschetta Chicken
ingredients: 8 small boneless, skinless chicken breast halves
1 cup Kraft Sun-Dried Tomato dressing, divided
1/2 cup fresh basil, chopped (or 1 teaspoon dried basil)
directions: Place a large sheet of heavy-duty foil over half of the grill and preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Place the chicken in a resealable plastic bag. Add 3/4 cup of dressing, seal the bag, and refrigerate for at least 10 minutes.
Grill the marinated chicken on an uncovered grill for about 6 minutes.
In a bowl, combine the remaining 1/4 cup dressing with tomatoes, cheese, and basil.
Turn the chicken over and place the cooked side up on the foil on the grill. Top each piece with the tomato mixture.
Close the grill lid and cook for an additional 8 minutes or until the chicken is fully cooked.

recipes.title: Grilled Coconut-Lime Curry Chicken
ingredients: 14 oz. raw chicken breast, cut into strips
½ cup white jasmine rice, uncooked
directions: For the chicken: Add olive oil, lime zest and juice, ground cumin, ground coriander, coconut aminos, honey, sea salt, curry powder, 4 Tbs. lite canned coconut milk and cayenne pepper to a small bowl and whisk together. Pour half of the mixture into a large Ziploc bag. Store the other half in the fridge for later. Add chicken strips to bag. Let marinate in the fridge 2+ hours.

For the coconut rice: Add 1-½ cups canned coconut milk, ½ cup water, ½ cup uncooked rice and a pinch of sea salt to a pot. Bring to a boil. Turn heat down to low, stir the rice, cover and cook for 20 minutes. Remove from heat.

After the chicken has had time to marinate, preheat the grill to medium-high heat. Add chicken to the grill and cook 5 minutes per side. Place a piece of foil on the grill and spray with cooking spray. Add asparagus and grill for about 8 minutes.

For one serving: 3 oz. of chicken over ¼ of the coconut rice and top with ¼ of the remaining marinade, 100g chopped pineapple, lime juice and cilantro. Enjoy 6 roasted asparagus spears on the side. 87 PB

recipes.title: Honey Mustard Baked Chicken
ingredients: 2 large boneless, skinless chicken breasts (cut in half to make 4 portions)
directions: Preheat oven to 400°F. In a small bowl, mix Dijon mustard, honey, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Rub chicken breasts with olive oil and coat with honey mustard mixture. Place on a baking sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes, flipping once.

recipes.title: Indian Butter Chicken
ingredients: 16 oz chicken breasts, cut in 1-inch cubes
1½ tbsp curry powder, 1 tbsp garam masala
¾ c plain nonfat Greek yogurt
directions: Add all the "before cooking" ingredients to a slow cooker. Mix until everything is evenly coated in the seasonings and sauce.
Cook on low for 5–6 hours or high for 3–4 hours. After cooking, stir in the half and half and yogurt, and top with cilantro.
Split into 6 servings and serve each over ½ c rice.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Crack Chicken
directions: Place chicken breasts into Instant Pot and add 1 cup water. Close the lid and the pressure release valve, then set the Instant Pot to Manual, High Pressure, for 9 minutes
Once cooking is complete, let it set for 3 minutes, then quickly release the pressure
Remove the chicken from the pan with tongs and discard the juices. Return chicken to the pan and shred with two forks
Add cream cheese, shredded cheddar cheese, and hot sauce to the pan, mixing well. If desired, add a packet of powdered ranch dressing for extra flavor
If the pan cools and mixing becomes difficult, turn the Instant Pot to warm and let it heat up, but be cautious not to burn the cheese
Season with salt and pepper
Serve the chicken on buns. This recipe makes 6-8 sandwiches.

recipes.title: Italian Cream Cheese Chicken
directions: Place butter in a crock pot on high. Once melted, add the Italian dressing and blend
Add the cream of chicken soup and cream cheese, stirring until melted
Cut the chicken into 1-inch strips and place in the crock pot, stirring to coat the chicken
Cook on high for 2 hours
Serve over rice, pasta, or potatoes

recipes.title: Loaded Baked Sweet Potato
directions: Bake the sweet potatoes whole according to the directions in the Food Prep Guide.
Heat a frying pan over med/high heat and then add the bacon. Cook about 10 minutes or until crispy, then chop into small pieces.
Top each 160g serving of sweet potato with 3 Tbs. cheddar cheese, 3 slices chopped bacon, 1 Tbs. Greek yogurt and chopped chives or green onion. PB

recipes.title: Parmesan Chicken
ingredients: 1 slice Ezekiel Bread or Haarper’s Bran Bread
directions: Toast the bread in the toaster until lightly browned. Place the toast into a blender with the almonds, Parmesan cheese, granulated garlic, thyme, sea salt and pepper. Pulse until broken up into crumbs; set aside.

Heat the oven to 400 degrees. Halve the potatoes and place in a large Ziploc bag. Add the olive oil, minced garlic and a dash of sea salt and black pepper to the bag. Massage until well coated. Pour out onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 20 minutes; flip and bake an additioinal 20 minutes.

Dip the chicken tenderloins in the egg whites and then dip into the bread crumb mixture. Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake at 400 degrees for eight minutes. Flip the chicken over and add the asparagus to the pan. Spray the tops with cooking spray and sprinkle with sea salt. Bake for an additional eight minutes. Drizzle balsamic over the asparagus. Divide everything evenly into four servings.

recipes.title: Peach Balsamic Chicken
directions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to 350°F.
Season the chicken with the salt and pepper. Grill 5 minutes per side, then set aside to rest.
In a medium skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat. Add the zucchini and season with the pepper and garlic salt; sauté until tender.
Serve 3.5 oz chicken with 1 oz mozzarella, 100 g peaches, ¼ c fresh basil, 2 tbsp balsamic glaze, and ¼ of the zucchini.

recipes.title: Peach Caprese Chicken
recipes.serves: 4 servings heat. Spray chicken with cooking spray and sprinkle
ingredients: 1 cup roasted or grilled asparagus (side, per serving)
directions: Butterfly cut the chicken. Heat the grill to medium-high heat and grill until fully cooked through, about 4-5 minutes per side.

Turn grill down to medium/low heat. Slice peaches in half and remove the pit. Spray the inside of the peaches with cooking spray and place face down on the grill. Leave grill open and cook for 1-2 minutes. Flip over and cook for an additional minute. Remove from the grill.

Transfer chicken to a plate and top each serving with 2 oz. fresh mozzarella, 150g grilled peaches, fresh basil, and 2 Tbs. balsamic glaze. Enjoy with asparagus on the side (about 1 cup roasted or grilled asparagus per serving).

recipes.title: Sanpete BBQ Turkey
directions: In a bowl, create the sauce by mixing Sprite, oil, soy sauce, and garlic powder.
Add the turkey meat to the sauce, ensuring it is fully coated, and let it marinate overnight in the refrigerator.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Cook the marinated turkey on the barbecue, turning as needed until fully cooked.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Greek Chicken
ingredients: ½ small red onion, cut into chunks
Salt and pepper to taste, ½ tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp oregano
½ tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp oregano
directions: Preheat the oven to 400°F.

On a lined baking sheet, arrange the bell peppers, onions, tomatoes, artichoke hearts, garlic, and chicken. Drizzle with the lemon juice and olive oil and season with the oregano, smoked paprika, and salt and pepper to taste.
In a small mixing bowl, whisk together the sauce ingredients. Pour over the chicken and veggies. Bake 20–25 minutes, until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Make the rice according to the package instructions.
When the sheet pan comes out, sprinkle the feta evenly over everything. Split into four portions and serve over the rice.

recipes.title: Skillet Baked Ziti
ingredients: Table salt and ground black pepper
1 (28-ounce) can crushed tomatoes (we used Muir Glen fw/basil) (A combo of tomato sauce and diced to all together)
1/4 cup minced fresh basil leaves, or dried to taste
directions: Making the Minutes Count: Measure the water and the pasta before you begin cooking. Prep the Parmesan and basil while the pasta cooks.
Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 375 degrees.
If using sausage, brown in a separate NON-STICK pan, drain and set aside.

Combine oil, garlic, pepper flakes, and 1/2 teaspoon salt in 12-inch, ovensafe nonstick skillet and saute over medium-high heat until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add crushed tomatoes, water, ziti, and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Cover and cook, stirring often and adjusting heat as needed to maintain vigorous simmer, until ziti is almost tender but barely al dente (almost still a bit hard), about 8-10 minutes. Do not overcook! Pasta will continue cooking in the oven.

Stir in cream, parmesan, and basil (and sausage if using). Season with salt and pepper to taste. Sauce will be runny! Sprinkle mozzarella evenly over ziti. Transfer skillet to oven and bake until cheese has melted and browned, about 10 minutes. Serve.

Tip: If you are in a hurry you can broil the top quickly, which is what I usually do. Makes for more saucey pasta which I like. You can also brown some Italian sausage (hot or mild) and add it to the pasta right before putting it in the oven, for a heartier meal.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Honey Garlic Chicken
ingredients: ½ c coconut aminos or low-sodium soy sauce
1 tsp dried basil, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp salt and pepper
directions: In a slow cooker, combine all the ingredients and mix until well combined.
Cook on low for 6 hours.
Serving size is 4 oz chicken and ¼ of the veggies and sauce.

recipes.title: Twice-Baked Southwest Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: ½ cup black beans, drained and rinsed
½ cup diced red bell pepper
directions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Poke holes in sweet potatoes, place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, spray the tops with cooking spray and sprinkle with sea salt. Bake 30 minutes, flip. Bake another 30 minutes and remove from the oven. Add to a large bowl (with or without peel) and mash up.

In a large frying pan or skillet, brown turkey with taco seasoning over medium/high heat. Add veggies and sauté a few minutes. Add turkey, veggies and beans to the bowl of sweet potatoes. Stir until well combined.

Place mixture in a greased 9x13 baking dish or back into skins then sprinkle with cheese. Return to the oven for 10-15 minutes. Divide into 4 equal portions and enjoy warm. Garnish each serving with 1 oz. guacamole, 1 Tbs. Greek yogurt and 1 Tbs. salsa. 104 PB

recipes.title: Warm Spiced Chicken & Vegetables
ingredients: 1 tsp ginger powder (divided), 2½ tbsp garam masala (divided), 2 tsp salt (divided), 2 tsp pepper (divided)
directions: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Line 2 baking sheets with foil.
In a large mixing bowl, toss together the cauliflower, broccoli, red potatoes, shallots, olive oil, ½ tsp ginger powder, 2 tbsp garam masala, 1 tsp salt, and 1 tsp pepper.
Transfer the veggies to one baking sheet and roast for 40–45 minutes.
Season the chicken with the remaining ½ tsp ginger powder, ½ tbsp garam masala, 1 tsp salt, and 1 tsp pepper.

After the veggies have roasted about 15 minutes, put the chicken on the second baking sheet and bake for 20–25 minutes, until it reaches 165°F. The chicken and veggies should finish at about the same time.
Serving size is 4 oz chicken and ¼ of the veggies.

recipes.title: Eggs Goldenrod
directions: Boil the eggs
Chop the egg whites and stir into the white sauce
Push the yolks through a strainer to create a "powder" topping
Break the toast into pieces, top with the white sauce mixture, and sprinkle the yolk powder over the top

recipes.title: Beef & Broccoli Ramen Stir Fry
ingredients: ¼ c coconut aminos or low-sodium soy sauce
1 lb sirloin steak, trimmed and sliced ¼-inch thick
directions: In a medium mixing bowl, whisk together the sauce ingredients until completely combined. Set aside.
Cook the ramen noodles according to the package instructions. When done, rinse with cool water and lightly spray with oil to prevent sticking.

While the ramen cooks, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Season the steak with salt and pepper and sear the strips 3–4 minutes per side. Remove the steak, drain any juices, and wipe the skillet with a paper towel.
Add the broccoli to the skillet with ½ c water. Cover and steam 2–3 minutes — don't overcook it. Drain the water.
Reduce the heat to low. Return the steak and add the noodles. Pour in the sauce, toss everything together, and simmer 2–3 minutes.
Split into 4 portions and top each with 1 tbsp green onion and ¼ tsp sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
directions: In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium-high heat. Add the onion, mushrooms, salt, and pepper and sauté 8–10 minutes, until the mushrooms are tender.
Add the ground beef and garlic. Cook 4–5 minutes, crumbling the beef as it browns.
Mix in the flour and cook 2–3 minutes, then add the beef broth, Worcestershire, and Dijon. Mix until combined.
Bring to a boil, then add the egg noodles. Reduce to a simmer and cover 5–6 minutes, until the noodles are cooked and most of the liquid is absorbed.
Reduce the heat to low and stir in the sour cream until fully combined. Split into 4 portions and top each with 1 tsp parmesan and chopped parsley if desired.

recipes.title: Boss Baked Mac & Cheese
ingredients: 4 oz. whole wheat macaroni or elbow pasta (uncooked)
½ cup low-fat, shredded cheddar cheese
Dash of sea salt, garlic powder, paprika, thyme
directions: Heat oven to 350 degrees.
Bake cauliflower according to the directions in the Food Prep Guide. Cook macaroni according to the directions on the package. Drain and set aside.

Slice the chicken sausage into thin rounds and chop bacon into small pieces. Place in a frying pan over medium/high heat. Cook until fragrant and all sides are browned. Remove from heat and set aside.

In a large saucepan, melt the butter over low/medium heat. Add the Kodiak Cakes and stir until well combined. Slowly whisk in the milk and stir constantly until slightly thickened. Add in the sea salt, black pepper, cheddar cheese and 4 Tbs. of the parmesan cheese. Stir until the cheese is melted into the sauce. Add the cauliflower, macaroni, sausage and bacon to the sauce. Stir until well combined. Pour into an 8x8 baking dish.

Toast the Ezekiel bread in the toaster until browned on both side. Break into pieces and place in a blender. Pulse until it turns into bread crumbs. Combine the bread crumbs, 2 Tbs. parmesan cheese, sea salt, garlic powder, paprika and thyme together in a bowl. Sprinkle over the top of the macaroni. Bake for 25 minutes. Divide into four equal servings and enjoy warm.

recipes.title: Brown Butter Mushroom Pasta
ingredients: 12 oz Rigatoni pasta (or your favorite pasta)
8 tablespoons salted butter, cut into tablespoon pieces
12 oz cremini or baby bella mushrooms, sliced
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese (or mozzarella cheese)
For serving: chopped fresh parsley, crushed red pepper flakes, extra Parmesan cheese (optional)
directions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and season generously with salt. Once boiling, add the pasta and cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente. Reserve ½ cup of the pasta water and drain.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
Swirl occasionally until the butter starts to foam and smells nutty (about 3-4 minutes).
Add the mushrooms and onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until the mushrooms are tender and browned (about 5 minutes).
Add the garlic and thyme, cooking for 2 more minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper, to taste.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and stir in the reserved pasta water.
Reduce heat to low and add half of the Parmesan cheese, stirring gently until melted.
Add the remaining cheese and stir until fully melted. You can also use tongs to toss the pasta and cheese to avoid clumping.
Taste and season with more salt and pepper if necessary.
Transfer the pasta to plates or bowls.
Garnish with chopped parsley, crushed red pepper flakes, and extra Parmesan cheese if desired.

recipes.title: Cheesy Broccoli & Bacon Penne
ingredients: ¼ cup fresh, minced yellow onion
½ cup low-fat, shredded mozzarella cheese
directions: Roast broccoli according to directions in the Food Prep Guide.
Cook the pasta with sea salt according to directions on package; drain. Remove the pot from the heat and add pasta back to the pot with the olive oil.

Heat a frying pan over medium-high heat. Spray with cooking spray and add the chopped bacon. Cook until crispy, then remove from pan. Turn the heat down to medium/low. Add the onions and garlic; sauté until tender. Add the almond milk and cheese wedges; stir until cheese is completely melted.

Add the cheese mixture, bacon and broccoli to the pasta. Stir until well combined. Stir in the shredded mozzarella and Parmesan cheeses. Weigh the entire recipe and divide the weight by four to get the amount needed to fill one serving. Enjoy warm. Add salt and pepper as needed, to taste.

recipes.title: Cheesy Slow Cooker Tortellini Pasta Bake
ingredients: 1 lb Italian sausage, mild or spicy
20 oz cheese tortellini, fresh or frozen
1 cup water, plus about ½ cup more as needed
directions: In a skillet over medium-high heat, cook the sausage with about 1 tbsp water. Season with the salt and pepper and cook until no longer pink. Drain.
Spray the inside of the slow cooker with nonstick cooking spray. Add the cooked sausage.
Stir in the tortellini, marinara, 1 cup water, 1 cup mozzarella, and the Parmesan.
Top with the remaining ½ cup mozzarella.
Cover and cook on high for 3-4 hours, until the pasta is tender and the cheese melts. Check halfway and add about ½ cup more water if it looks dry.
Let rest 15 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken Orzo w/ Zucchini & Tomato
ingredients: 2 Roma tomatoes (about 2 cups when cut into wedges)
1 cup orzo pasta (or half the package)
4 oz fresh mozzarella (cut into ½-inch cubes)
2 tablespoons olive oil (for roasting and cooking)
directions: Wash and dry all produce. Adjust rack to upper position and preheat oven to 425°F. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Slice zucchinis into ¼-inch-thick rounds. Cut tomatoes into ½-inch-thick wedges. Toss zucchini and tomato with 1 tablespoon olive oil and half the Italian seasoning on a baking sheet. Season with salt and pepper.

Roast zucchini and tomatoes in the oven until just shy of tender, about 10 minutes. Once the water is boiling, add 1 cup orzo to the pot (use the rest as you like). Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, about 9-11 minutes. Drain, then return to pot.

With your hand on top of each chicken breast, cut ¾ of the way through the middle, parallel to the cutting board, stopping before you slice through completely. Repeat with the other chicken breast. Open each up and season all over with salt, pepper, and the remaining Italian seasoning.

Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook until no longer pink in the center, about 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from pan and set aside on a plate. Meanwhile, cut mozzarella into ½-inch cubes. Halve the lemon. Roughly chop the parsley.

Once veggies have roasted for 10 minutes, remove the baking sheet from the oven. Heat the broiler to high or increase oven temperature to 500°F. Sprinkle veggies with panko breadcrumbs, mozzarella, and Parmesan cheese. Broil (or bake) until panko is golden brown, cheese is melted, and veggies are tender, about 3-5 minutes.

Add juice from one lemon half and half the parsley to the pot with orzo and toss to combine. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Divide orzo between plates. Top with roasted veggies and chicken. Drizzle with any chicken juices from the plate and a squeeze of lemon. Garnish with remaining parsley and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken Pad Thai
ingredients: 4 oz. uncooked, pad thai, brown rice noodles
½ cup fresh, minced yellow onion
Sea salt and pepper, to taste
directions: Cook the noodles according to directions on the package. Drain and set aside.
Whisk peanut butter, rice vinegar, coconut aminos and honey in a bowl. If sauce is too thick, add a little water; set aside.
Spray a skillet with cooking spray and add the minced garlic and onions. Chop the chicken and chicken to the skillet. Cook until all the sides are golden brown and the chicken is cooked through.

Add the veggies and sauce; cook until tender. Add the noodles last. Weigh the entire recipe and divide by four to get the amount needed to fill one serving. Garnish each serving with the toppings listed. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmesan Pasta
ingredients: 2 tablespoons Italian dressing (not the creamy kind)
3 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into cubes
directions: Heat chicken and Italian dressing in a large 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat (or use a stock pot if you don’t have a large skillet)
Season chicken with salt and pepper to taste and cook until browned and just cooked through, about 5 minutes (depending on thickness of chicken)
Add pasta and marinara sauce to the skillet, then fill the empty marinara jar with water and add it to the skillet (use 2 cups of water if using a stockpot)
Stir the mixture lightly to combine and bring to a boil
Reduce to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes or until pasta is tender to your liking (see note)
Cover with grated parmesan and shredded mozzarella cheese, no need to stir
Continue to cook for 2-3 more minutes or until cheese is fully melted, or broil the entire skillet for about 4 minutes to make the cheese extra melty
Top with chopped fresh basil (optional) and serve

recipes.title: Creamy Italian Sausage Pasta
ingredients: ¾ cup cream or half and half
directions: Cook pasta according to package
Brown sausage in a large skillet
Add garlic and cook 30 seconds
Pour in chicken broth and cream, simmer
Stir in parmesan, spinach, and sun dried tomatoes
Add cooked pasta and toss
Simmer a few minutes until sauce thickens

recipes.title: Korean Chicken Noodle Bowl
ingredients: ¼ c coconut aminos or low-sodium soy sauce
1 tbsp sriracha (medium-high spice; use less for milder)
24 oz chicken breast, cut into bite-size pieces
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, divided
directions: In a small mixing bowl, whisk together the sauce ingredients.
Add the chicken and cornstarch to a gallon-size zip-top bag and shake until well coated.

In a large skillet or wok, heat 1 tbsp olive oil over medium-high heat. Sauté the chicken for 5–7 minutes, until it reaches 165°F, getting a golden sear on all sides. Transfer to a plate. Add the remaining tbsp of olive oil, then the green beans, edamame, salt, and pepper; cook over medium-high heat for 6–8 minutes, until fork-tender. Reduce heat to low.
Add the sauce and chicken to the skillet and simmer for 5–10 minutes. Sprinkle the chives over the top.
While the sauce simmers, soak the rice noodles in hot water for 6–9 minutes.
Push the chicken and vegetables to one side of the skillet, add the noodles, and toss them in the sauce.
Serving size is 1½ oz noodles, 6 oz chicken, and ¼ of the veggies.

recipes.title: Kristy’s Mac & Cheese
ingredients: Spices: salt, pepper, garlic powder, smoked paprika and a pinch of nutmeg
3 cups of shredded cheese (mix of Asiago, Romano, and Cheddar)
French's Fried Onions (about half of a container or less)
directions: Melt the butter slowly in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add your desired spices: salt, pepper, garlic powder, and a pinch of smoked paprika and nutmeg.
Pour in the 2 cups of milk and bring to a gentle boil, stirring occasionally.
Add the can of Campbell’s Cheddar Cheese Soup, stirring until well combined and smooth.
Gradually add the 3 cups of shredded cheese (a mix of Asiago, Romano, Cheddar, or Monterey Jack), stirring until all cheese is melted and incorporated.
Add a handful (about half of the French's Fried Onions) and stir them in.
Taste and adjust seasoning with more salt, pepper, garlic, or spices if needed.
If the sauce is too thick, add a little more milk to reach your desired consistency.
Cook the noodles according to the box and mix in the sauce and enjoy.

recipes.title: Lemon Chicken Orzo
ingredients: 2 medium chicken breasts, pounded to ½ inch thick
Kosher salt and ground black pepper
¾ cup heavy cream (plus more, to taste)
½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese
1 medium lemon, zested and juiced (plus more, to taste)
directions: Season the Chicken
Rub chicken breasts with olive oil, garlic powder, 1 teaspoon of Italian seasoning, and ½ teaspoon of Kosher salt per breast. Sprinkle with black pepper to taste.
Cook the Chicken
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Sear the chicken for about 6 minutes per side until fully cooked through. Remove from the skillet and rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
Prepare the Sauce Base

In the same skillet, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the diced onions and sauté until softened. Stir in minced garlic and the remaining teaspoon of Italian seasoning. Sauté for another minute until fragrant.
Cook the Orzo

Add orzo to the skillet, stirring for 2 minutes. Pour in chicken broth, season with salt and pepper, and bring to a low boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 12 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add Creaminess
Once the orzo is tender, stir in spinach, heavy cream, and Parmesan cheese until creamy and well-combined.
Brighten with Lemon
Mix in lemon zest and juice to taste. Adjust cream and seasonings as needed.
Serve
Plate the orzo mixture and top with sliced chicken. Garnish with lemon slices and chopped parsley for a vibrant finish.

recipes.title: Pasta e Fagioli
ingredients: ½ cup red kidney beans, drained
½ cup great northern beans, drained
2 oz. uncooked ditalini or macaroni pasta
directions: Brown the ground beef in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onions, garlic, celery and carrots. Sauté for about 10 minutes. Add the remaining ingredients, except for the pasta, and simmer for 30 minutes.

Cook the pasta al dente according to the directions on the package; drain. Add the pasta to the pot of soup and then simmer for five minutes. Weigh the entire soup and divide the weight by four to get the amount needed to fill one serving. Serve warm topped with Parmesan cheese.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Penne with Sage Sausage
ingredients: ½ tsp red pepper flakes, 1 tsp salt and pepper, ½ tsp nutmeg
directions: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Cook the pasta according to the package instructions.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet (cast iron recommended) over medium-high heat and brown the turkey sausage.
Add the onion, garlic, and bay leaf to the same skillet and sauté about 3 minutes. Add the sage, red pepper flakes, nutmeg, salt, and pepper.
Add the broth and cook until reduced, about 5 minutes over medium-high heat. Stir in the pumpkin puree until well incorporated.
Add the noodles to the sauce and mix until completely combined. Grate the parmesan over the top.
Transfer to the oven and bake for 20 minutes. Split into 6 equal portions and serve.

recipes.title: Salmon & Greens Spaghetti
ingredients: Sea salt and pepper, to taste
directions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees.

Cut the salmon into four, three ounce portions. Season with sea salt and pepper. Place skin-side down on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Place asparagus on the same baking sheet. Spray the tops with cooking spray and sprinkle with sea salt. Bake asparagus for 8 minutes. Bake the salmon for 12-15 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti according to the directions on the package; drain. Add the spaghetti back to the pot with the pesto sauce. Toss until well coated.
Spiralize the zucchini squash. Spray a large frying pan or wok with cooking spray and add then zucchini noodles. Cook over medium-high heat for 3-5 minutes until zucchini is crisp-tender.

Weigh the pasta and divide the weight by four to get the amount needed to fill one serving. Add ½ cup cooked zuchinni noodles to each plate then top with pesto pasta, roasted salmon and six asparagus spears. Squeeze lemon juice up over the top.

recipes.title: Stuffed Pasta Shells
directions: Preheat oven to 375F.
Cook shells according to package instructions. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
In a skillet, brown ground beef with salt and pepper.
Stir in tomato sauce and ricotta. Add reserved pasta water, Italian seasoning, basil, and garlic powder.
Stuff each shell with the mixture, place in a baking dish, top with mozzarella and basil.
Bake for 20-25 minutes.
Toss together salad ingredients.
Serve 3 shells and 1/6 of salad per portion.
Serves: 6
Calories per serving: 339
Macros: 29g carbs / 11g fat / 31g protein

recipes.title: Summer Pesto Pasta Salad
ingredients: 8 oz. grilled chicken breasts (10 oz. raw)
3 oz. dry whole wheat spaghetti or 7.5 oz. cooked
directions: Grill chicken and corn on the cob according to the directions in the Food Prep Guide. Cook spaghetti according to the directions on the package. Drain noodles and set aside.

Spiralize the zucchini into noodles and slice tomatoes in half. Add to the pot over medium heat and toss constantly for 2 minutes. Remove from heat and add whole wheat noodles and pesto sauce. Stir until well combined. Place a bowl on the food scale and zero it out. Place noodles in the bowl and weigh. Divide the total weight by 4 to get the amount needed to fill one serving.
Cut charred corn off of the cob and divide into 4 equal portions.
Add pasta to a plate or bowl, top with 2 oz. grilled chicken and ¼ of the corn. Season with salt, pepper and lime juice, then garnish with fresh basil. Enjoy warm or cold. 106 PB

recipes.title: Teriyaki Chicken + Pasta
ingredients: 3 boneless skinless chicken breasts (cut into ¾ inch pieces)
1 ½ cups frozen sugar snap peas
½ cup teriyaki baste and glaze
directions: Cook the linguine to your desired doneness
Spray a medium skillet with nonstick cooking spray and heat over medium heat
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook, stirring until browned
Add the peas and teriyaki baste and glaze to the chicken
Reduce the heat to medium, cover, and cook for 5-8 minutes or until the chicken is no longer pink and the peas are tender
Grate 1 teaspoon of orange peel and set aside
Peel the orange and cut it into 1-inch pieces
Add the grated peel and orange pieces to the chicken mixture
Serve over linguine and sprinkle with cashews, if desired

recipes.title: Thai Peanut Noodle Bowl
ingredients: 2 cups sugar snap peas, trimmed and halved
3 oz. uncooked spaghetti (or 7.5 oz. cooked), or brown rice noodles
½ tsp. Stevia in the Raw
directions: Spray a wok or skillet with cooking spray and add the shrimp. Cook until fully cooked, season with salt and pepper, then remove from pan.
Cook pasta according to the directions on the package. Drain and set aside.
Whisk all sauce ingredients together in a small bowl or blender. Set aside.

Spray pan again and add shallots, carrots, and snap peas. Season with salt and pepper. Sauté for 3-5 minutes or until veggies are crisp-tender. Add shrimp back to the pan along with the cooked pasta and peanut sauce. Stir until heated through and well combined. Remove from pan and cover to keep warm.

Spray pan and add spiralized zucchini. Season with sea salt. Toss constantly for 1-2 minutes and remove from heat. (Zoodles should be heated through but still crisp — do not overcook or they will be soggy.)
Place zoodles in a bowl and top with the shrimp, noodle, and veggie mixture. Top with chopped peanuts and green onions.
Find your serving: weigh the shrimp, veggies, and sauce together. Find the weight in grams and divide by 4 to get the amount needed for one serving. Serve over 1 cup of zoodles.

recipes.title: Tomato Butter Chicken Spaghetti
directions: Cook the spaghetti according to the directions on the package; drain. Weigh the spaghetti and divide the weight by four to get the amount for one serving.
Butterfly-cut the chicken to make it even in thickness. Sprinkle both sides with sea salt and pepper. Dice the tomatoes, mince the garlic and chop the basil.
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the chicken, cover, and cook about 3-4 minutes per side, until cooked through. Turn the heat down, remove the chicken and set aside.

Let the oil cool a moment. Add the tomatoes and broccoli to the skillet and turn the heat back up to medium. Break up the tomatoes and simmer about four minutes. Add the garlic and butter; stir until the butter is melted. Return the chicken to the pan and let it marinate a few minutes. Weigh the tomato butter chicken mixture and divide by four for one serving.
Top one serving of spaghetti with one serving of the tomato butter chicken mixture. Finish with fresh basil.

recipes.title: Creamy Pesto Salmon
ingredients: ½ cup nonfat, plain Greek yogurt
directions: Cook rice according to directions on package and roast broccoli according to the directions in the Food Prep Guide.
Heat a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Spray with cooking spray and add salmon to the pan. Season, cover and cook for 5 minutes per side, or until salmon begins to flake apart.

Stir Greek yogurt and pesto sauce together until well combined. Top each 3 oz. salmon portion with ¼ of the creamy pesto sauce. Serve over ½ cup cooked rice with 1 cup roasted broccoli on the side. PB

recipes.title: Fish & Chips
ingredients: ¼ cup Kodiak Buttermilk Power Cakes Mix
1 slice Harper’s Homemade Bran or Ezekiel Bread
1 Tbs. finely chopped scallions or green onions,
directions: Heat the oven to broil. Cube the bread and place on a baking sheet. Spray the tops with cooking spray and sprinkle with season-all seasoning. Broil for 2 minutes, flip and broil another minute. Place in a blender and pulse until broken up into crumbs. Pour into a bowl with parmesan cheese, sea salt, paprika and black pepper. Set aside.

Heat oven to 425. Slice potatoes into wedges and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Spray tops with cooking spray and sprinkle with seasonall. Bake 25 minutes, flip and bake another 25 minutes.

Place Kodiak cakes in a bowl. Beat the egg with the lemon juice in a separate bowl. Slice the fish into 1-inch strips. Dip each strip into the Kodiak Cakes Mix, then into the egg mixture, then into the bread crumb mixture. Place fish sticks onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Turn heat down to 400 degrees. Bake for 8 minutes, then flip. Add the asparagus to the pan. Spray the asparagus with cooking spray and sprinkle with sea salt. Return to the oven and bake another 8 minutes.

Whisk or blend all tartar sauce ingredients together and divide into 4 equal portions. Use the tartar sauce as a dip for the fish stick and fries. Enjoy the asparagus on the side. Weigh the potatoes and fish separately after cooking and divide the total weight by 4 to get the amount needed to fill one serving. PB

recipes.title: Honey Chipotle Salmon
ingredients: 1 tbsp chipotles in adobo, minced (La Costeña brand)
1 tbsp coconut aminos or low-sodium soy sauce
directions: In a small mixing bowl or zip-top bag, combine the salmon, chipotles, honey, coconut aminos, apple cider vinegar, and lime juice. Marinate in the fridge for at least 20 minutes or up to overnight.
In a rice cooker or pressure cooker, make the rice according to the package instructions.
Preheat the oven to 425°F. Place the asparagus on a baking sheet, drizzle with the olive oil, and season with salt and pepper. Set aside.

Line another baking sheet with foil and place the salmon on it. Put the salmon and asparagus in the oven at the same time and cook for 25–30 minutes, until the salmon reaches 135°F and the asparagus is fork-tender.
Serve each salmon filet over ½ c rice with ¼ of the asparagus. Garnish with chives.

recipes.title: Honey Garlic Salmon
ingredients: Sea salt and pepper, to taste
directions: Cube the sweet potatoes. Trim and halve the Brussels sprouts. Roast both according to directions in the Food Prep Guide.

While the veggies are roasting, prepare the salmon. Sprinkle salmon with sea salt and pepper. Add oil to a large skillet over medium heat. Once hot, add salmon to the skillet skin side down. Cover and cook for five minutes. Whisk the honey, lemon juice and garlic together in a small bowl. Carefully flip the salmon over and cook for five more minutes or until salmon is fully cooked and begins to flake. Remove the skin. Add the honey, lemon, garlic mixture to the pan for the last minute.
Serve 3 oz. of salmon alongside 4 oz. of roasted sweet potatoes and 1 cup Brussels sprouts. Garnish with chopped parsley.

recipes.title: Lemon Basil Salmon
ingredients: Fresh basil leaves and lemon wedges for serving
directions: In a small mixing bowl, mix together the marinade ingredients (everything except the salmon). Remove ¼ c of the marinade and set aside. Add the salmon and gently rub the marinade into the fish. Refrigerate for at least 20 minutes or up to overnight.
In a pressure cooker or rice cooker, make the rice according to the package instructions.
Preheat the oven to 425°F. Line two baking sheets with foil.
Place the salmon on one baking sheet and bake for 20–30 minutes, until the internal temperature reaches 135°F.
On the other baking sheet, spray the asparagus and shallots with oil and season with salt and pepper. Bake for 20–25 minutes.
Serving size is ½ c rice, 1 salmon filet, and ¼ of the asparagus.

recipes.title: Spicy Shrimp Stacks
ingredients: 16 oz shrimp, peeled, deveined, tails removed
1 tsp coconut aminos or low-sodium soy sauce
directions: Make the rice according to the package instructions and drizzle with the rice vinegar.
Line a bread pan with plastic wrap. Press the rice into an even, compact layer.
In a large skillet, heat the canola oil over medium-high heat. Peel the rice slab free of the plastic and fry until it starts to crisp, 2–3 minutes per side. Set on a paper towel to cool.
Spray a medium skillet with oil and cook the shrimp over medium-high heat until pink and cooked through, 2–4 minutes.
Chop the shrimp into very small pieces and mix together with the rest of the spicy shrimp ingredients.
Cut the rice into 4 even pieces. Top each with ¼ of the spicy shrimp mix, 25 g avocado, ½ tsp sesame seeds, and ½ tbsp eel sauce.

recipes.title: Walnut Rosemary Crusted Salmon
ingredients: 2 tsp rosemary, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp salt and pepper
directions: Preheat the oven to 420°F.
In a large mixing bowl, toss together the veggie ingredients. Spread on a baking sheet and roast for 30 minutes.
In a small mixing bowl, whisk together the Dijon, garlic, lemon juice, rosemary, honey, and red pepper flakes. In another small bowl, mix together the walnuts and panko.
Season the fish with salt and pepper. Spread the Dijon mixture over the salmon, then press the panko-walnut mixture into it. Bake the fish for 9–11 minutes.
Each serving is 1 salmon fillet, 125 g brussels sprouts, and 125 g potatoes.

recipes.title: BBQ Cheddar Chicken Burger
ingredients: 4 Tbs. Stubbs Smokey Mesquite BBQ sauce
½ tsp. stevia in the raw
directions: Butterfly-cut the chicken, then cut into 4 portions (2.5 oz. each). Grill according to the directions in the Food Prep Guide, basting the chicken with BBQ sauce while grilling. Once the chicken is cooked through, place it on the top rack and turn the grill off. Immediately add the cheese and close the grill to let it melt.

Chop or slice the apples, red onion and cabbage, then add to a bowl. Add the lemon juice, apple cider vinegar, stevia, salt and pepper; stir until well combined. Weigh the slaw and divide by 4 to get one serving.
Toast the sandwich thins. Evenly distribute the BBQ cheddar chicken onto the buns and top each burger with one serving of slaw. Enjoy!

recipes.title: BBQ Ranch Chicken Wraps
ingredients: ½ c Stubb's Hickory Bourbon BBQ sauce
directions: Preheat the air fryer to 400°F. Air fry the chicken for 4 minutes.
In a medium mixing bowl, toss the chicken with the BBQ sauce until coated, then return to the air fryer for 4 more minutes.
Spread a cheese wedge on each tortilla, then add 3 oz chicken, 1 c romaine, 2 tbsp carrots, 2 tbsp tomatoes, and 2 tbsp light ranch. Wrap and serve.

recipes.title: Beef Bulgogi Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: ¼ c coconut aminos or low-sodium soy sauce
1 lb top sirloin steak, chilled, cut into thin strips
directions: In a zip-top bag or medium mixing bowl, mix together the beef ingredients. Marinate in the fridge for at least 30 minutes or up to overnight.
In a pressure cooker or rice cooker, make the rice according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat. Let the marinade drip off the meat before adding it to the pan. Sear both sides of each strip and cook to your desired doneness.
For each serving: ½ c rice, 4 oz beef, 2 tbsp cilantro, and 2 tbsp green onions, with as many lettuce wraps as you like.

recipes.title: Black Bean & Roasted Butternut Tacos
ingredients: ½ cup butternut squash, peeled, cubed
directions: Cook chicken according to the directions in the Food Prep Guide. Cube and roast butternut squash according to the directions in the Food Prep Guide.

Lay the tortillas out on a baking sheet. Add one ounce chicken, one tablespoon butternut squash, one tablespoon beans, seasonings and one tablespoon cheese to the middle of each tortilla. Broil on HI for 3 minutes or until cheese is melted.
Top each taco with one tablespoon red onion, 20g avocado, cilantro and lime juice. Enjoy two tacos per serving.

recipes.title: Black Bean Tostadas
ingredients: 8 oz. grilled chicken breast (or cook 10 oz. raw)
directions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Line baking sheet with foil. Spray foil with cooking spray. Lay tortillas in a single layer on foil and spray tops with cooking spray. Sprinkle tops of tortillas with taco seasoning. Bake for 8 minutes.

Drain and rinse beans. Place on a plate and microwave 30-45 seconds. Mash with a fork, then spread on warm tortillas. Slice bell peppers, grilled chicken and green onions. Layer evenly on tortillas and top each one with 1 Tbs. shredded cheese.
Return to oven for another 8 minutes. 2 tostadas per serving. Enjoy each serving warm with 2 oz. guacamole, 1 Tbs. Greek yogurt, 1 Tbs. salsa and a squirt of lime juice. PB

recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken & Pesto Sandwich
ingredients: Sea salt and pepper, to taste
2 whole wheat hamburger buns (140 cals each)
directions: Coat chicken in hot sauce and dried basil. Place in a pan over medium heat, then sprinkle with salt and pepper. Cover and cook for three minutes per side or until cooked through. Remove from the heat and separate into two equal portions. Top each portion with one slice of cheese.
Stir the pesto sauce and yogurt together in a bowl.

Toast the buns then spread ½ of the pesto cream sauce on the bottom of each bun. Add ½ of the chicken, ¼ cup of the cabbage, ¼ cup of the spinach and two tomato slices to each sandwich. Top with the other half of the bun.

recipes.title: Chicken Al Pastor Tacos
ingredients: 2 tbsp chipotles in adobo (La Costeña brand)
½ c freshly squeezed orange juice
1 tsp chipotle chili powder, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp salt
24 oz chicken breast, cut into bite-size pieces
1 jalapeño, seeds and membranes removed, diced
directions: In a large zip-top bag or mixing bowl, combine all the marinade ingredients. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours or up to overnight.

After marinating, heat the olive oil in a large pan (cast iron recommended) over medium-high heat. Sauté the chicken and onions until cooked through, about 5–7 minutes, or until the chicken reaches 165°F.
If desired, char the tortillas directly over a stove burner.
Dress each tortilla with 2 oz chicken, 2 tbsp pineapple, 1 tsp queso fresco, 1 tsp jalapeño, and cilantro if desired.
Serving size is 3 tacos.

recipes.title: Chicken Fajita Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 12 oz. raw chicken breasts, cut into strips
Cumin, paprika, cayenne pepper, garlic powder
2 cups yellow onion, cut into rings
2 cups bell peppers, cut into strips
directions: Cook rice according to directions on the package.

Heat large skillet over medium/high heat. Grease with cooking spray. Add chicken to the pan and a dash of all the spices listed. Cover. Cook 5 minutes on each side or until fully cooked through. Remove from pan.
Add avocado oil, peppers and onions to the skillet. Cover. Cook about 5-10 minutes, stirring occasionally until veggies are soft.

For one serving, lay out 2-3 butter lettuce cups and evenly distribute 2.5 oz. cooked chicken, 1 cup cooked veggies, ¼ cup cooked rice, ¼ cup black beans, 2 Tbs. salsa, 40g guacamole and 1 Tbs. Greek yogurt. PB

recipes.title: Chicken Salad Sandwich
ingredients: 1/4 cup sour cream or ranch dressing
directions: In a large bowl, combine the chicken, celery, grapes, and green onions, toss to combine and set aside
In a small bowl, whisk together the mayonnaise, sour cream (or ranch dressing), chopped dill, black pepper, salt, and lemon juice until fully combined
Pour the dressing over the chicken mixture and stir until evenly coated
Cover and refrigerate for at least 6 hours or overnight to allow the flavors to meld
When ready to serve, slice each croissant roll in half, spread 1/2 cup of the chicken salad on the bottom half of each croissant, top with the other half of the croissant roll

recipes.title: Citrus Salmon Tacos
