ingredients: ½ cup Stubb’s Citrus & Onion Marinade
Stevia in the raw, to taste
Sea salt and pepper, to taste
directions: Place the salmon in a Ziploc bag with the marinade. Let marinate 2+ hours or overnight.
Spray a frying pan with cooking spray. Remove the salmon from the marinade and pan-fry over medium heat. Cook for five minutes per side or until the salmon begins to flake.
In a bowl, combine the cabbage, carrots, green onions, yogurt, lime juice and stevia. Stir until well combined.

Assemble tacos by evenly distributing the salmon and cabbage slaw between the tortillas. Season each taco with salt and pepper to taste. Top each taco with 15g of the avocado, ½ tablespoon of the grated Parmesan cheese and a pinch of cilantro. Two tacos per serving.

recipes.title: Coconut Fish Tacos
ingredients: 1 tsp garlic powder, ½ tbsp chili powder
24 oz white fish (rockfish, cod, or halibut)
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Line a baking sheet with foil.
In a shallow bowl, mix together the shredded coconut, panko, garlic powder, and chili powder. Dredge the fish in the coconut mixture, pressing the coating in so it sticks well.
Place the fish on the baking sheet and bake for 18 minutes.
Toss together the salsa ingredients. Char or warm the tortillas as desired.
Each taco gets 2 oz fish, 1 heaping tbsp salsa, and a lime wedge. Serving size is 3 tacos.

recipes.title: French Dip Sandwiches
directions: Place roast in a slow cooker all night
Add water, soy sauce, and seasonings
Cover and cook on high for 5-6 hours or low if all night or until beef is very tender
Remove meat from broth, shred with forks, and keep warm
Strain broth into small cups for dipping
Serve beef on rolls

recipes.title: Grilled Lime Salmon Tacos with Mango Avocado Salsa
ingredients: ½ cup chopped red bell pepper
directions: Add all marinade ingredients to a large Ziploc bag. Place salmon in bag and let marinate in the fridge for 2+ hours.
Heat grill over medium-high heat. Place a piece of tin foil on the grill and spray with cooking spray. Place salmon on the foil and cook about 3 minutes per side or until just cooked through.

In a medium bowl toss together mangoes, avocados, bell peppers, cilantro, red onions, lime juice and olive oil. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Weigh the salsa and divide by 4 to get the amount needed to fill one serving.
For one serving, place ¼ of the salmon into 2 tortillas. Enjoy warm topped with one serving of the Mango-Avocado Salsa. 77 PB

recipes.title: Honey-Garlic Chicken Tacos
directions: In a large mixing bowl, mix together the honey, taco seasoning, garlic, olive oil, and salt. Add the chicken and toss until coated. Transfer the chicken and sauce to a slow cooker and cook on low for 3 hours.
Shred the chicken and let it soak in the sauce for a few minutes.
Divide the chicken among the tortillas. Top each with 2 tbsp cabbage, 1 tbsp pico, 1 tbsp Greek yogurt, a squeeze of lime, 1 tbsp green onions, and 1 tbsp cilantro.

recipes.title: Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 12 oz rotisserie chicken, shredded and chopped
¼ c coconut aminos or low-sodium soy sauce
directions: In a large skillet or wok, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat. Sauté the onion and garlic 3–4 minutes.
Add the peas, corn, chicken, rice, coconut aminos, sesame oil, and ginger. Sauté 5–6 minutes, until everything is soft and heated through.
Make a well in the middle of the skillet and scramble the eggs. Once cooked, mix them through the rice. Season with salt and pepper and top with green onions.
Serve scooped into butter lettuce leaves.

recipes.title: Marinated Steak Tacos
ingredients: 4 Tbs. Bolthouse Farms Salsa Verde dressing
directions: Combine lime juice, olive oil, honey, garlic and seasonings in a bag. Slice steak into thin strips and add to the bag; massage until coated. Let marinate in the fridge 2+ hours.
Heat grill to medium heat. Place sliced steak on the grill and cook 3 minutes per side or until you reach your desired doneness.

Weigh the steak in grams and divide by 4. Place steak evenly into 8 tortillas. 2 tacos per serving. Top each serving with shredded lettuce, 2 Tbs. Pico de Gallo, 1 Tbs. dressing, 1 Tbs. feta cheese, cilantro and a squirt of lime. PB

recipes.title: Meatball Subs
ingredients: ½ cup finely chopped red bell peppers
½ cup low-fat, shredded mozzarella cheese
4 whole-wheat or potato hot dog buns
directions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.
Toast the bread in a toaster until browned and crispy. Break up into pieces and place in a blender. Pulse into crumbs; set aside.

Add the ground turkey, egg, homemade bread crumbs, spinach, bell peppers, onion, tomato paste, garlic and seasonings into a bowl. Mix with hands until well combined. Using a cookie scoop, scoop into 20 1-inch balls and place in a 9x13 non-stick baking dish. Cover with marinara sauce and bake for 15-20 minutes or until cooked through.

Distribute the meatballs evenly between the four hot dog buns. Top each sub sandwich with two tablespoons mozzarella cheese and return to the oven for 10 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the subs are heated through.

recipes.title: Navajo Tacos
directions: Brown the hamburger with onions and mix with Nalley’s chili con carne.
Deep fry Terrel’s scone dough until golden and crispy.
Layer the taco ingredients on top of the fried dough: shredded lettuce, chopped green peppers, chopped tomatoes, sour cream, fresh salsa (optional), shredded cheese, and chopped olives.

recipes.title: PF Chang's Chicken Lettuce Wraps
directions: Heat the oil in a saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add the ground chicken and cook, breaking it up, until browned. Drain the excess grease.
Add the garlic and onion and sauté for 2 minutes.
Add the hoisin sauce, soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, ginger, and green onions. Cook 2 more minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Divide the chicken mixture evenly between the lettuce leaves and serve.

recipes.title: Pear and Sautéed Onion Grilled Chicken Sandwich
directions: In a small skillet, sauté the onions in the olive oil over medium-high heat until cooked through and golden. Turn the heat to low.

Preheat a grill or grill pan to 350°F. Season the chicken with salt and pepper and grill 5 minutes per side, until the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Melt the cheese on the chicken and set aside.
Each sandwich: 1 ciabatta, 4 oz chicken, 1 tbsp fig preserves, 2–3 pear slices, and ½ c arugula.

recipes.title: Pepper Jack Chicken Wrapped Asparagus
directions: Cube and roast sweet potatoes according to the directions in the Food Prep Guide.

Slice the chicken into 12 thin strips (pound flat if needed). Cut cheese slices in half and place one on each chicken strip. Wrap chicken and cheese around three asparagus spears and place seam down in a skillet over medium heat. Sprinkle with seasoning. Cover and cook for five minutes per side or until chicken is cooked through.
Enjoy three chicken wraps warm topped with one tablespoon Dijon mustard and 115g roasted sweet potatoes on the side per serving.

recipes.title: Pesto Chicken Panini
ingredients: 9 oz. grilled chicken breast (11.25 oz. raw)
4 pieces or 100g mini Stonefire naan breads
1 yellow onion, thinly sliced into rings
directions: Cook and season chicken according to the directions in the Food Prep Guide.
Brown onions and peppers in a greased frying pan until slightly tender.
Spread 1-½ Tbs. pesto sauce on two of the mini naan breads and 1 cheese wedge to the others. Sandwich 4.5 oz. chicken, ½ the onions and ½ the peppers inside each one.
Place in panini maker or frying pan and cover. Cook and press until lightly browned. One serving is half of a sandwich. Enjoy hot or cold. PB

recipes.title: Prosciutto, Mozzarella, Tomato, & Basil Panini
directions: Whisk olive oil, vinegar, and garlic in a small bowl to blend; season dressing to taste with salt and pepper
Layer prosciutto, mozzarella, tomatoes, and basil over the bottom of the bread
Drizzle lightly with dressing, then sprinkle with salt and pepper
Press top of bread over
Cut bread equally into 4 sandwiches
Grill sandwiches until bread is golden brown and cheese melts, pressing occasionally with a large spatula, about 5 minutes per side

recipes.title: Pulled BBQ Chicken Sandwiches with Apple Slaw
ingredients: 1 tsp dried mustard, ½ tsp cumin, ¼ tsp cayenne
½ c apple, cut into matchsticks
directions: Add the chicken ingredients to a slow cooker or pressure cooker. For a pressure cooker, cook on high pressure for 22 minutes; for a slow cooker, cook on high for 3–4 hours. Shred the chicken and return it to the BBQ sauce before serving.
To make the apple slaw, toss together the coleslaw mix, apple, apple cider vinegar, maple syrup, light mayo, and salt and pepper.
Serve each sandwich with 4 oz meat and ½ c slaw. Serving size is 1 sandwich.

recipes.title: Rotisserie Chicken Tacos
ingredients: 1 Tbs. cashew sour cream (recipe in Food Prep Guide)
directions: Preheat the oven to HI broil. Shred the chicken into a bowl and stir in the taco seasoning. Lay the tortillas out on a pan and fill each 2 tortillas with 2.5 oz. shredded chicken and one tablespoon shredded mozzarella cheese.
Place in the oven and broil for three minutes or until the cheese is melted.
Remove from oven and add toppings. Enjoy one clementine on the side.

recipes.title: Shredded BBQ Chicken Sandwiches
ingredients: ½ cup Stubb’s Original BBQ sauce
directions: Place chicken, water and BBQ sauce in a crockpot. Cook on low for 4 hours.
Weigh the chicken and divide the weight by 4 to get the amount needed to fill one serving. Shred with forks and serve on toasted Sandwich thins with 50g sliced avocado. Enjoy salad on the side. 80 PB

recipes.title: Sloppy Joes
directions: Brown the ground beef
Mix together the remaining ingredients in a bowl and pour over the browned beef
Simmer the sauce over the beef for 1 hour

recipes.title: Sweet Mustard Chicken Wraps
ingredients: 4 oz. grilled chicken (or cook 5 oz. raw)
directions: Combine the Greek yogurt, mustard and honey to make the sauce. Set aside.

Lay out tortillas and layer 2 oz. grilled chicken, 2 tomato slices, ½ cup chopped cucumbers, ½ cup sprouts, ½ cup spinach, 60g sliced avocado and sea salt and pepper into each one. Drizzle ½ of the honey mustard sauce evenly over the top of the avocado then roll up tight and enjoy warm or cold. 69 PB

recipes.title: Taco Dinner
directions: Brown the ground beef, onion, and green pepper
Add the tomato sauce, chili powder, salt, pepper, oregano, vinegar, and brown sugar
Let the mixture simmer for 15-20 minutes
Serve over corn chips as a taco salad base and top with lettuce, tomatoes, and grated cheese
Add salsa or ranch for extra flavor if desired

recipes.title: Taco Fries
ingredients: ¼ of a red pepper, minced
½ Tbs. Cashew Sour Cream (recipe in Food Prep
directions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Slice potatoes into fries and lay out onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper in a single layer. Spray tops with cooking spray and sprinkle with sea salt, onion powder and garlic powder. Bake for 20 minutes. Flip and bake another 15-20 minutes.
Brown turkey in a frying pan or skillet over medium heat. Once cooked, add taco seasoning. Remove from heat. Add onions and peppers to the pan and cook until tender. Add to the turkey mixture.

Weigh the potatoes and turkey mixture separately and divide by 4 to get the amount needed for one serving. Place fries on a plate topped with turkey mixture, cheese, guacamole, sour cream, jalapenos and green onions. Enjoy! PB

recipes.title: Taco Stuffed Pepper Skillet
directions: Cook peppers and onion
Add meat and cook fully
Stir in Rotel, seasoning, rice, corn, beans
Top with cheese and cover until melted

recipes.title: Zupas Pesto Chicken Panini
ingredients: About a cup of alfalfa sprouts
1 roasted red pepper (I used the ones from the jar = easiest), sliced into small cubes
1 batch of homemade basil pesto (basil, garlic, pine nuts, EVOO, parmesan, lemon juice)
1 cup real mayonnaise (I love Miracle Whip, but don't use it with this recipe)
directions: In a bowl, mix together chicken breast, roasted red pepper, slivered almonds, basil pesto, and mayo until just combined
Slightly broil your ciabatta rolls in the oven so they're warm and a little crispy (or use a panini maker after assembling the sandwich)
On the bottom half of the ciabatta roll, layer on muenster cheese, chicken mixture, tomato (seasoned with salt and pepper), and alfalfa sprouts
Top with the other half of the roll, and use a toothpick to hold it in place

recipes.title: Chili Sauce
directions: Boil until thick, for five or six hours on low heat
Stir often

recipes.title: Cooking Time For Fruit
ingredients: tomato juice: 1/2 tsp salt, 4 quarts=10tbsp sugar, 10 minutes
stewed tomatoes: 1 tsp salt, 2 tsp sugar, 30 minutes

recipes.title: Dill Pickles
ingredients: Fresh dill to cover the bottom of the jar
directions: Prepare the jar by filling the bottom with dill
Dissolve 2 tablespoons of uniodized salt in the hot water
Add a clove of garlic to the jar
Pour in the amber vinegar and the saltwater mixture
Process the jar in boiling water for 5 minutes

recipes.title: Frozen Fruit Cocktail
ingredients: If desired, small bottle of maraschino cherries
directions: Mix and freeze

recipes.title: Frozen Strawberry Jam
ingredients: 3¼ cups strawberries or raspberries (fresh, hulled, and crushed)
directions: Prepare Fruit and Measure Ingredients:
Measure out 3¼ cups of prepared strawberries or raspberries and ¼ cup of lemon juice.
In a separate bowl, measure 4½ cups of sugar and set aside.
Combine Pectin with Fruit:
Gradually stir 1 package of MCP pectin into the fruit mixture, making sure it is mixed thoroughly.
Set this mixture aside for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally to ensure the pectin fully dissolves.
Add Corn Syrup:
Pour 1 cup of light corn syrup into the fruit mixture and mix well. This helps prevent sugar from crystallizing during freezer storage.
Add Sugar:
Gradually stir in the sugar. Continue to mix until the sugar is fully dissolved.
Optionally, you may heat the mixture on the stove to a warm temperature (do not boil) to help dissolve the sugar.
Prepare for Freezing:
Pour the jam into freezer-safe containers, leaving about ½ inch of space at the top.
Wipe off the edges of each container to ensure a clean seal, then cover with lids.
Freeze:
Place containers in the freezer. The jam will last several months in the freezer and can be stored in the refrigerator once thawed.

recipes.title: Pickled Beets
ingredients: 10 pounds fresh, small beets, stems removed
Let jars cool completely, and store in a cool, dark place.:
directions: Prepare the Beets
Place beets in a large stockpot and cover with water.
Bring to a boil and cook until tender, about 15 minutes (adjust time depending on beet size).
If beets are large, cut them into quarters.
Drain the beets, reserving 2 cups of the beet cooking water. Cool and peel the beets.
Sterilize Jars
Sterilize jars and lids by immersing them in boiling water for at least 10 minutes.
Place several whole cloves in each sterilized jar, then fill with the peeled beets.
Prepare the Brine
In a large saucepan, combine the sugar, reserved beet water, vinegar, and pickling salt.
Bring to a rapid boil.
Pour Brine and Seal Jars
Pour the hot brine over the beets in the jars, filling each jar, then seal with lids.
Process the Jars
Place a rack in the bottom of a large stockpot and fill halfway with water. Bring the water to a boil over high heat.
Carefully lower the jars into the pot, leaving 2 inches of space between each jar.
Add more boiling water if needed to ensure the water level is at least 1 inch above the jar tops.
Cover the pot and process the jars in boiling water for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Salsa
ingredients: 2 or 3 jalapeño peppers, chopped (use gloves when cutting them up)
directions: Cook in a heavy pan for at least 7 or 8 hours
Bottle in pint-size jars and then hot water bath for 10 minutes

recipes.title: Bubble Bath
directions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl, mixing well.
Store in a tightly sealed container.
Add to your bathwater for a fragrant, relaxing soak.

recipes.title: Scents of the Holidays
directions: In a small saucepan, combine the cinnamon sticks, cloves, allspice, and water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer over low heat.
Check the mixture periodically and add more water if necessary.
Simmer the mixture before guests arrive to fill your home with the “scents of the holidays.

recipes.title: Baking Powder
directions: Combine all ingredients and sift thoroughly five times.
Store in a tightly covered glass jar or tin.

recipes.title: Flour Seasoning
directions: Mix all the ingredients together.
Add the flour and mix thoroughly until well combined.

recipes.title: Graham Crackers
directions: Add the flour mixture to the creamed ingredients, alternating with ½ cup milk, mixing well after each addition.
Chill the dough overnight or for several hours.
Divide the dough into quarters. Roll out each portion on a floured surface to about ¼ inch thick.
Trim the dough into 5 x 15-inch rectangles, then cut into six 2½ x 5-inch rectangles.
Mark a line down the center of each dough piece with the edge of a knife. Use a fork to mark each inch.
Place on a greased cookie sheet and bake at 350°F for 10-15 minutes or until golden.

recipes.title: Sweet + Condensed Milk
directions: Place all ingredients in a blender and mix until smooth.
Store in the fridge.
Note: 1½ cups of this mixture equals 1 can of condensed milk.

recipes.title: Bean Salsa
ingredients: 1 (16 oz) carton of your favorite fresh salsa
directions: In a large bowl, combine the fresh salsa, lime juice, and lime zest.
Add the diced tomatoes, cilantro, black-eyed peas, black beans, corn, avocados, and chopped olives.
Season with garlic powder, salt, and pepper to taste.
Gently mix to combine and chill before serving.

recipes.title: Bread Bowl Artichoke Dip (Emily Dyches)
ingredients: 2 (16 oz) sourdough bread rounds (about 6-in diameter), divided
1 (14 oz) can artichoke hearts in water, drained
directions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees
Slice off the top of one bread round to create a lid Carefully remove the center of the bread round to form a 4 1/2-inch-wide and 2-inch-deep well for dip
Slice the center of the first bread round and the entire second bread round into 1-inch cubes
Place the bread bowl on the center of a stoneware dish Arrange the bread cubes around the bowl and spray with vegetable oil
Whisk cream cheese until smooth Add milk to the cream cheese Chop artichokes and add them to the soup mix and pressed garlic Mix well Microwave on HIGH for 5-7 minutes or until hot (do not boil)
Stir lemon juice and sour cream into the hot artichoke mixture
Grate Parmesan cheese over the bread bowl and bread cubes Bake for 13-15 minutes or until the bread cubes and top of the dip are golden brown
Remove from oven and serve immediately Yield: 12 servings
Variation: Instead of using the bread bowl method, use thinly sliced baguette French bread

recipes.title: Carmelized Onion-Bacon Dip
ingredients: 1 pound onions, halved and thinly sliced
directions: In a large nonstick skillet, sauté onions in olive oil until golden brown, about 15 minutes.
Cover the skillet and reduce the heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the onions are deeply golden brown, 35-40 minutes.
Cool slightly, then coarsely chop the onions.
Stir together the cream cheese and sour cream until smooth.
Reserve 2 tablespoons of crumbled bacon; stir the remaining bacon, caramelized onions, red wine vinegar, thyme, salt, and pepper into the cream mixture.
Chill for at least 30 minutes.
Before serving, sprinkle the dip with the reserved bacon.

recipes.title: Corn Salsa
ingredients: 1 can Great Northern white beans or 1 can black beans, drained
1 can corn (Shoepeg or yellow & white petite corn), drained
¼ - ½ bunch cilantro, finely chopped
1 package Good Seasons Italian dressing, mixed according to directions
directions: Drain all the canned ingredients and place them in a large bowl.
Add the chopped green onions, diced tomatoes, avocado, and cilantro.
Prepare the Italian dressing mix according to the package directions and pour it over the mixture.
Gently stir to combine, then chill before serving with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Cowboy Caviar
ingredients: 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained
1 can black-eyed peas, rinsed and drained
1 cup tomatoes, seeded and finely diced
1 cup corn (fresh, canned, or thawed from frozen)
3/4 cup red and/or orange bell pepper, seeded and finely diced
directions: Place the beans, black-eyed peas, tomatoes, corn, avocado, bell pepper, onion, and cilantro in a large bowl
In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lime juice, honey, chili powder, cumin, and salt and pepper
Pour the dressing over the bean mixture and toss gently to coat
Serve as a salad or with chips

recipes.title: Fresh Peach Salsa (Nora Cook)
ingredients: ¼ cup cilantro or Italian parsley
directions: Core, seed, and finely dice tomatoes
Finely chop peaches and add to tomatoes
Stir remaining ingredients into salsa, starting with the lesser amounts of lime juice and sugar
Wait a few minutes, taste the salsa, and add more lime juice or sugar if needed
Cover and refrigerate until serving timeMakes about 3 cups

recipes.title: Fresh Salsa
directions: Chop ingredients in a small food processor
Slice cilantro into small pieces
If you prefer less heat, remove the seeds from the jalapeno pepper
Sprinkle with a bit of onion and garlic salt, then add freshly ground pepper to taste
Mix everything together and enjoy!

recipes.title: Guacamole
directions: Mix all ingredients together
Delicious with chips and quesadillas

recipes.title: Hot Cream Cheese Dip
directions: Mix all ingredients together in a small crockpot
Heat on low, stirring occasionally until the cream cheese and cheese are melted and everything is well combined

recipes.title: Mexican Ranch Dip
ingredients: 1 package Hidden Valley Ranch dip seasoning
Vegetables, crackers, or pretzels of your choice
directions: Combine cream cheese, corn, jalapeños, red pepper, chopped olives, Hidden Valley Ranch mix, salt, pepper, and garlic salt until well combined
Add the cream cheese and mix until the texture is smooth
Serve with your choice of vegetables, crackers, or pretzels

recipes.title: Seven Layer Dip
directions: Layer one: Spread 1 can of bean dip at the base of your serving dish.
Layer two: Mash 3 ripe avocados with 1 tablespoon lemon juice, salt, and pepper, then spread over the bean dip.
Layer three: In a bowl, mix 1 cup sour cream, 1/2 cup mayonnaise, and 2 tablespoons taco seasoning. Spread this mixture on top of the avocado layer.
Layer four: Sprinkle grated cheese evenly over the previous layers.
Layer five: Add a layer of sliced olives.
Layer six: Top with diced tomatoes.
Layer seven: Finish with chopped onion.

recipes.title: Fruit Dip
ingredients: 1 (3.4 oz) box dry instant vanilla pudding mix
directions: In a large bowl, mix together vanilla yogurt, Cool Whip, and pudding mix until completely combined and smooth
Cover with plastic wrap and chill for about 30 minutes
Serve with your choice of fruit and enjoy
Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 5 days

recipes.title: Marshmallow Fruit Dip
directions: In a saucepan, combine the sugar, corn syrup, and hot water. Heat, stirring until the sugar dissolves.
Boil the mixture without stirring to the firm ball stage (244°F to 248°F on a candy thermometer; in humid weather, cook to 248°F).
Beat the egg whites until stiff.
Slowly add the hot syrup to the egg whites, beating at high speed until thick and fluffy.
Add the salt and vanilla, mixing well.
Gently fold in the mayonnaise and grated orange rind.
Allow to cool and serve with fresh fruit.

recipes.title: Speckled Cinnamon Apple Dip
directions: In a small bowl, stir together the yogurt, protein powder, almond butter, water and cinnamon. Mix until smooth.
Slice apples and dip! 48 PB

recipes.title: Strawberry Cream Cheese Fruit Dip
ingredients: ½ cup heavy whipping cream, cold (120 ml)
¾ cup powdered sugar, sifted and divided (90 g)
¾ heaping cup fresh strawberries, sliced (about 100 g)
8 oz cream cheese, room temperature (226 g), cut into pieces
directions: Prepare the Cream:
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cold heavy whipping cream and ¼ cup of the powdered sugar.
Using a hand mixer, whip until fluffy and stiff peaks form. Set aside.
Blend the Strawberries:
Add the sliced strawberries and blend until smooth in a blender or food processor.
Combine with Cream Cheese:
Add the cream cheese to the blended strawberries and blend until well combined, scraping down the sides as needed.
Blend in the remaining ½ cup of powdered sugar until fully incorporated.
Assemble the Dessert:
Gently fold the strawberry-cream cheese mixture into the whipped cream until completely combined and no streaks remain.
Serve:
Transfer to a serving dish and serve immediately for a whipped texture, or refrigerate for 1-2 hours for a firmer texture.

recipes.title: Creamy Tomatillo Dressing (Cafe Rio)
directions: Place all ingredients in a blender
Blend until smooth and well combined
Serve immediately or refrigerate until ready to use

recipes.title: Cucumber & Buttermilk Dressing
directions: In a bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, mayonnaise, and lemon juice until smooth and well combined
Add the dill weed, salt, and freshly ground pepper to the mixture, adjusting the seasoning to taste
Stir in the finely chopped cucumber and mix until evenly distributed
Cover the bowl and refrigerate the dressing for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld together
Serve chilled as a refreshing sauce or dressing for salads, sandwiches, or as a dip

recipes.title: Lemon Dressing for Fruit Salad
directions: Mix 2 beaten eggs with 1 lemon (3 eggs with 2 lemons) ½ C sugar
Add juice - cook till thickens

recipes.title: Thousand Island Dressing
directions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl
Mix until well blended
Serve immediately or refrigerate until ready to use
Makes 1½ cups dressing

recipes.title: BBQ Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl or container
Marinate meat for 8 or more hours
Grill or cook as desired

recipes.title: Cashew Sour Cream
directions: Soak cashews in water for 30 minutes.

Drain cashews, add them to a blender with all the other ingredients and blend on low until smooth. Keep adding water until you get the right consistency. It should be thick and creamy, but pourable. 37 PB

recipes.title: Enchilada Sauce
ingredients: Enough oil to make a thin paste
directions: In a pan, mix flour and oil to make a thin paste and cook until golden brown
Add water, chili powder, garlic salt, onion salt, and salt, stirring to combine
Cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens

recipes.title: Mom’s Gravy
directions: Boil the juice from the roast (if there's not enough, add 1-2 bouillon cubes)
Mix 5-6 tablespoons of flour into 1 cup of cold water, then whisk until smooth
Add the flour mixture to the juice and whisk to combine
Season with salt, pepper, and 1 teaspoon of Kitchen Bouquet seasoning

recipes.title: Sweet & Sour Sauce
directions: In a saucepan, combine all ingredients and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally
Once the mixture thickens and becomes smooth, remove from heat
Optionally, add pineapple and green peppers to the sauce for extra flavor
Serve with your favorite dishes, such as stir-fries or chicken

recipes.title: Tartar Sauce
directions: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan over low heat and bring to a boil
Marinate salmon in the sauce
Sprinkle fish or salmon with lemon pepper
Cook fish on coals, meat side down for 10 minutes
Turn and cook on the other side for about 15 minutes

recipes.title: White Sauce
directions: Melt butter in a pan and add flour, mixing well
Cook until bubbly
Add salt and milk, stirring continuously until the sauce thickens

recipes.title: Buttermilk Syrup
directions: In a pot, combine the butter, buttermilk, and sugar, and bring to a boil.
Remove the pot from the stove and stir in the vanilla and baking soda.
Mix well and serve hot.

recipes.title: Cranberry Sauce
directions: Mix all ingredients in a food processor until well combined

recipes.title: Hot Fudge Sauce
directions: Melt the chocolate and butter together
Alternately add the powdered sugar and evaporated milk, stirring constantly
Bring the mixture to a boil over medium heat and cook for about 8 minutes, stirring until thick
Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla
Cover with plastic wrap and let cool in the fridge
Before serving, stir in a little leftover canned milk to achieve a smooth and creamy consistency

recipes.title: Apple Snack
directions: Slice the apple and boiled egg. Arrange with the turkey jerky and string cheese on a plate. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Baked Onion Rings
ingredients: 2 sweet onions, cut into ½-inch slices
2 tsp dried thyme, 1 tsp paprika, ¼ tsp pepper
directions: Separate the onions into rings and place in a large mixing bowl. Cover with ice water and soak 30 minutes, then drain.
Preheat the oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In one shallow bowl, whisk together the egg whites and mayo. In another, whisk together the breadcrumbs, thyme, paprika, and pepper. In a third, add the flour.
Dredge the onions through the flour, then the egg mixture, then the breadcrumbs. Arrange in an even layer on the baking sheet.
Bake for 20 minutes. Split into 8 servings.

recipes.title: Caprese Crunch Snack
directions: Layer turkey, mozzarella and tomato slices on top of the rice cakes. Drizzle with balsamic glaze and top with fresh basil. 41 PB

recipes.title: Cheddar Cheese Cheese Ball
ingredients: ¾ teaspoon onion flakes or fresh onion
directions: Mix together all ingredients with a mixer, except for the cheddar cheese
Fold in the grated cheddar cheese
Chill the mixture and then roll it into a ball
Roll the ball in chopped nuts for coating
Optional: Add shrimp, green olives, or other ingredients as desired

recipes.title: Cheese Ball
ingredients: ½ bottle Kraft Roquefort cheese spread
directions: Blend all ingredients together
Let the mixture set in the fridge
Once set, roll the mixture in chopped nuts

recipes.title: Chicken Snack Wrap
ingredients: 1 whole grain or whole wheat tortilla (120 cals)
2 tsp. Bolthouse Farms Honey Mustard dressing
directions: Lay out the tortilla, pile in all of the ingredients, and wrap up tight.

recipes.title: Deviled Eggs
directions: Boil the eggs and cut them in half.
Remove the yolks and mash them in a bowl.
Blend in the mayonnaise, vinegar, mustard, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Refill the halved egg whites with the yolk mixture. Top with a sprinkle of paprika, salt, and pepper, if desired.

recipes.title: Loaded Deviled Eggs
ingredients: 3 strips turkey bacon, cooked crisp and chopped small
directions: Cut the hard-boiled eggs in half and remove the yolks.
In a small mixing bowl, mix the yolks with the Greek yogurt and light mayo. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Spoon the yolk mixture back into the egg whites. Top each egg with ½ a bacon strip and ½ tbsp chives.
Serving size is 1 egg.

recipes.title: Open Faced Cheese & Cucumbers
ingredients: Dried dill, dried minced onions or Everything Bagel Seasoning
Sea salt and pepper, to taste
directions: Top each rice cake with ¼ cup cottage cheese, 4 cucumber slices, seasoning of choice, sea salt and pepper to taste. Enjoy the almonds on the side.

recipes.title: Open Faced Turkey & Swiss
ingredients: Everything Bagel Seasoning (Trader Joes) or dried minced onion
Sea salt and pepper, to taste
directions: Layer the rice cakes evenly with mustard, turkey, cheese and tomato slices. Sprinkle with seasonings, sea salt and pepper and fresh basil. Enjoy celery on the side.

recipes.title: Parmesan Roasted Edamame
ingredients: 1 tsp garlic salt, ½ tsp pepper
directions: Preheat the oven to 450°F.
In a medium mixing bowl, toss the edamame in the olive oil. Add the parmesan, garlic salt, and pepper and toss until evenly coated.
Spread on a baking sheet in one even layer. Roast 18–20 minutes, flipping halfway.
Split into 4 portions and serve.

recipes.title: Protein Power Balls
ingredients: 2 cups old-fashioned oats (slightly broken down in the blender)
1 cup peanut butter (such as Adams all-natural no-stir)
1/2-1 cup mix-ins (mini chocolate chips, dried fruit, or nuts)
directions: Combine all dry ingredients in a kitchen-aid mixing bowl
Using the paddle attachment, mix until well blended
Add wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a "dough" forms
Scoop into balls with a 2-inch cookie scoop
Place onto a cookie sheet and refrigerate for at least one hour before serving

recipes.title: Turkey Roll-Ups
directions: Slice cucumber in half, then cut into thin strips, lengthwise. Set aside. Cut string cheese into four long strips. Set aside.

Lay turkey out to create four “roll-ups.” Spread mustard on turkey. Divide the spinach, cucumbers, cheese and seasonings evenly between the turkey slices. Starting at the edge, roll cheese and veggies together tightly inside the deli turkey. Enjoy berries on the side. PB

recipes.title: Veggies, Hummus & Turkey Jerky
ingredients: Dip veggies in hummus and enjoy jerky on the side.

recipes.title: Broccoli w/ Bacon Salad
ingredients: ½ lb bacon (cooked and crumbled into bits)
directions: In a large bowl, combine the broccoli, grated cheese, crumbled bacon, chopped onion, and raisins (or cranraisins).
In a separate small bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, red wine vinegar, and sugar until well combined.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss everything together.
Let chill before serving.

recipes.title: Chopped Thai Mango Salad
ingredients: ¾ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp coconut aminos or low-sodium soy sauce
1 c edamame, shelled, steamed and cooled
1 large red bell pepper, thinly sliced
directions: In a small mixing bowl, whisk together the dressing ingredients.
In a large mixing bowl, massage 1 tsp olive oil into the kale. Do not skip this step!
Toss together all the salad ingredients with the dressing.
Split into servings and serve.

recipes.title: Creamy Dill Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 6 oz plain Greek yogurt, fat free
directions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the Greek yogurt, vinegar, sugar, and dill. Mix in the cucumbers and red onion.
Split into 4 portions and serve.

recipes.title: Edamame Cashew Crunch Salad
ingredients: 3 tbsp cashew butter (peanut butter works too, but the macros will change)
2 tbsp coconut aminos or low-sodium soy sauce
1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp ginger powder
½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp cashew pieces, roasted and salted
directions: In a medium mixing bowl, whisk together the dressing ingredients. Set aside.
Toss together the salad ingredients. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss until combined.
Serving size is about 1 c.

recipes.title: Grape Salad
directions: Mix the cream cheese, sour cream, and sugar together until smooth
Add the grapes and stir to combine
Top with brown sugar and pecans to your desired amount

recipes.title: Harvest Cobb Salad
ingredients: 4 pieces turkey bacon, cooked and chopped
2 tbsp pecans, roasted, salted, and chopped
4 c butternut squash, cubed and steamed
directions: Whisk together the dressing ingredients.
Toss together the salad ingredients with the dressing. Split into 4 portions and serve.

recipes.title: Heirloom Tomato Salad
ingredients: ½ c multicolored grape tomatoes, halved
directions: In a small mixing bowl, whisk together the dressing ingredients. Set aside.
In a large mixing bowl or on a serving plate, add all the salad ingredients. Drizzle the dressing and balsamic glaze over the top.
Split into 4 even portions and serve.

recipes.title: Italian Orzo Salad
ingredients: ½ tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper
½ c roasted red peppers, chopped (Mezzetta brand)
½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
directions: Cook the orzo according to the package instructions. Strain and rinse under cold water to cool.
In a large mixing bowl, toss together all the ingredients. Drizzle with balsamic glaze.
Split into 4 servings. Serving size is about 1 c.

recipes.title: KFC Coleslaw
directions: In a large bowl, mix the cabbage, carrots, onion, sugar, and salt. Set aside.
In a separate container, combine the vinegar, vegetable oil, sour cream, and Miracle Whip.
Toss the dressing mixture with the cabbage mixture until evenly coated.

recipes.title: Lemon Summer Pasta Salad
ingredients: 5 cups penne pasta (dry) (16 oz, 1 lb or 454 g)
directions: Cook pasta: Cook pasta according to package instructions in salted water. Drain and do not rinse. Let the pasta cool slightly before proceeding with the recipe
Make the dressing: In a small bowl, add all the dressing ingredients and whisk to combine. Alternatively, add the ingredients to a glass jar and shake to combine. Set aside
Assemble the pasta salad: In a large bowl, combine pasta, vegetables, onion, and half of the dressing. Add parmesan cheese and fresh dill, stirring to combine. Save the rest of the dressing
Refrigerate: Chill the salad for at least 2 hours
Serve: When ready to serve, toss with the remaining dressing. Taste and adjust salt and pepper as needed. Garnish with fresh dill

recipes.title: Macaroni Salad
ingredients: ½ c red bell peppers, chopped
¼ c plain nonfat Greek yogurt
¼ tsp garlic powder, ¼ tsp paprika, salt and pepper to taste
directions: Cook the macaroni according to the package instructions and hard boil the eggs.
In a large mixing bowl, toss together the salad ingredients.
In a small mixing bowl, whisk together the dressing ingredients.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss until well incorporated. Split into 6 servings.

recipes.title: Strawberry Feta Spinach Salad
directions: In a large salad bowl, combine spinach, olive oil, balsamic vinegar, and pepper. Toss to mix well
Add strawberries and walnuts, and toss again
Add feta cheese and toss gently

recipes.title: Fresh Fruit Salad
ingredients: 1 lb strawberries, hulled and chopped (about 4 cups)
¾ lb fresh pineapple, chopped (about 3 cups)
Make ahead: prep the fruit and dressing up to 1 day early and store separately. Combine a few hours before serving.
Keeps in the fridge up to 2 days.
Use fresh fruit, not frozen. Bananas, mango, or crisp apples also work. Add bananas just before serving.
directions: Put all the fruit in a large bowl.
Whisk the dressing ingredients together in a small bowl.
Pour the dressing over the fruit and toss gently to coat.
Serve right away or chill. Stir gently before serving to mix in the juice that collects at the bottom.

recipes.title: Brown Rice
ingredients: 2 cans French Onion Soup (or 1 can French Onion Soup & 1 can water)
directions: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
In a baking dish, mix the rice and soup together until well combined.
Cut the butter into small pieces and place them evenly over the top of the mixture.
Bake in the oven for 40-45 minutes, or until the rice is tender.

recipes.title: Cheesy Oven Potatoes
ingredients: 1 small can cream of mushroom soup
½ empty can full of milk
6 large potatoes, boiled, drained, and cut in half
directions: Melt the butter and sauté the chopped onion until transparent
Add the cream of mushroom soup and milk, stirring to combine, then heat through
Stir in the shredded cheddar cheese until melted and smooth
Season with salt and pepper to taste
Place the sliced potatoes in a 9x13 casserole dish and pour the sauce mixture over the top
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes

recipes.title: Cinnamon Roasted Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 2 sweet potatoes, peeled and chopped (660 g)
directions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
In a medium mixing bowl, toss the sweet potatoes with the butter, Truvia brown sugar, and cinnamon. Transfer to a baking sheet and roast for 40 minutes.
Split into 4 portions and serve.

recipes.title: Creamy Scalloped Potatoes
ingredients: 6 medium potatoes, peeled and sliced thin
Optional: ¼ lb grated cheddar cheese (for a cheesy version)
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Peel and slice the potatoes into thin rounds and layer them in a baking pan.
Add the sliced onion on top of the potatoes.
In a saucepan, melt the margarine over low heat. Once melted, blend in the flour, salt, and pepper.
Gradually stir in the milk, and cook over medium heat until the mixture thickens into a smooth sauce.
Pour the white sauce evenly over the potatoes and onion in the pan.
Cover the pan with aluminum foil and bake for 1 hour.
If you’d like a cheesy version, sprinkle the grated cheddar cheese over the potatoes before baking or mix it into the sauce before pouring it over the potatoes.

recipes.title: Dressing (Stuffing)
directions: Melt the butter in a pan and sauté the celery and onion until softened.
In a large frying pan, add enough water to cover the top and dissolve 4-5 chicken bouillon cubes.
To the dressing mix, add grated carrots, salt, pepper, sage, and poultry seasoning, then stir in the butter mixture.
Gradually add the liquid and eggs, alternating between the two, mixing well.
Grease a casserole dish and pour the mixture in.
Bake at 350°F for 30-45 minutes until golden and set.

recipes.title: Easy Fried Rice
ingredients: 12 oz rotisserie chicken, shredded and chopped
¼ c coconut aminos or low-sodium soy sauce
directions: In a large skillet or wok, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat. Sauté the onion and garlic 3–4 minutes.
Add the peas, corn, chicken, rice, coconut aminos, sesame oil, and ginger. Sauté 5–6 minutes, until the vegetables are soft and cooked through.
Make a well in the middle of the skillet and scramble the eggs. Once cooked through, mix them into the rice. Season with salt and pepper and top with green onions.
Split into 6 portions and serve.

recipes.title: Funeral Potatoes
ingredients: 32 oz package of frozen hash browns
directions: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Spread the hash browns evenly in a 9x11 baking pan.
In a large bowl, mix together the sour cream, melted butter, cream of chicken soup, grated cheese, salt, pepper, and onion salt.
Pour the mixture over the hash browns, spreading it evenly.
Bake in the oven for about 1 hour, or until the top is golden and bubbly.

recipes.title: Orange Glazed Yams
directions: Peel and chop the sweet potatoes into chunks. Boil them in water until tender, then drain.
In a separate saucepan, melt the butter over low heat.
Add the brown sugar, orange juice, grated orange peel, and Karo syrup. Stir well and cook on low heat for 10-15 minutes until the mixture thickens slightly.
Add the cooked sweet potatoes to the glaze and stir to coat them.
Simmer the sweet potatoes in the glaze for 20-30 minutes, allowing them to absorb the flavors and become tender.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Casserole (Boston Market Copycat)
ingredients: 3 ½ - 4 pounds yams, peeled and cut into 1” pieces (or 2-29oz cans yams, drained)
¾ cup packed light brown sugar
½ cup heavy cream or milk (or 1/4 C if using canned yams)
¼ cup old fashioned rolled oats
directions: Fill a large pot with sweet potato pieces and water. Bring to a boil over high heat. Cook until fork-tender. Drain potatoes and place them back into the pot. Mash potatoes with a potato masher or blend with an electric mixer until mostly smooth
Add remaining ingredients (except topping ingredients). Mix until combined
Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease an 8”x10” casserole dish (8x8 or 9x9 works too)
Spoon sweet potatoes into the casserole dish and smooth out. Sprinkle the top of the sweet potatoes with marshmallows
Melt butter in a medium microwave-safe bowl. Add remaining topping ingredients and mix with a fork. Sprinkle the mixture over the top of the casserole
Bake for 20-25 minutes until the streusel is crisp and marshmallows are golden brown

recipes.title: Twice Baked Potatoes
ingredients: 1 cup grated cheddar cheese (reserve ¼ cup for topping)
directions: Bake the potatoes, then let them stand for a few minutes. Once cooled slightly, halve the potatoes lengthwise and carefully scoop out the insides. Set the shells aside.
In a mixing bowl, combine the potato insides, butter, milk, salt, and pepper. Mash until fluffy.
Stir in ¾ cup cheese and chopped onion. Spoon the mashed potato mixture back into the potato shells.
Sprinkle the remaining ¼ cup cheese on top.
Place the stuffed potatoes on a serving plate and microwave for 1 ½ to 2 minutes on high, or until the cheese melts and the potatoes are hot.

recipes.title: Absurdly Addictive Asparagus
ingredients: 4 ounces pancetta, cut into 3/8 inch to 1/4 inch dice
1 pound asparagus, woody ends trimmed and sliced into 2-inch pieces on the bias
1 1/4 cup leek, thinly sliced crosswise (white and pale green parts only)
Salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
directions: In a large non-stick pan, sauté pancetta, stirring frequently, over medium heat, until crisp and lightly golden
Add 1 tablespoon of butter to the pan. Add asparagus pieces and leek and sauté until asparagus is tender-crisp, about 3-4 minutes
Add garlic, lemon and orange zest, toasted pine nuts, and parsley, and sauté for about 1 minute, until fragrant
Season to taste with freshly ground pepper and salt and serve immediately

recipes.title: Bacon Garlic Green Beans
directions: In a large skillet, cook the bacon until crispy. Remove from the pan and set aside.
Add the green beans directly to the skillet and cook 4–5 minutes. Add the garlic and cook until the green beans are fork-tender, about 15 minutes.
Crumble the bacon over the top, split into 4 portions, and serve.

recipes.title: Cheesy Velveeta Vegetables
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup (can use mushroom)
directions: Cook the vegetables according to the package
When cooked, add cream of chicken soup, butter, and Velveeta cheese
Stir until the cheese and butter are melted and the mixture is well combined
Serve hot

recipes.title: Creamed Corn
ingredients: A pinch of white or red pepper
directions: In a medium-sized saucepan, combine the thawed corn, heavy whipping cream, whole milk, sugar, salt, and pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat and let it simmer for about 5 minutes.
In a separate bowl, blend the melted butter with the flour to create a smooth mixture. Add this to the simmering corn mixture and mix well.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and pour the mixture into a medium-sized heat-proof casserole dish.
Sprinkle the Parmesan cheese evenly over the top.
Place the casserole dish under the broiler until the top is lightly browned (about 2-3 minutes). Watch carefully to avoid burning.

recipes.title: Four Cheese Garlic Spaghetti Squash
ingredients: 1 cup Four-Cheese Italian White Cheese Blend (Mozzarella, White Cheddar, Provolone, Asiago)
Parsley, chives, or green onions, finely chopped

To cut baking time, place raw squash halves face down in a shallow dish with a bit of water, and microwave for 8 minutes (adjust based on the squash size). The flesh will be nearly cooked through, and then you only need to bake for 20-25 minutes
To make cutting the squash easier, poke 10-15 holes all over the squash with a fork, microwave for 2 minutes, and then carefully cut it open
Scrape the squash lengthwise to get the long strands, making it easier to enjoy each bite!
directions: Preheat your oven to 400°F

Cut the spaghetti squash in half lengthwise, scoop out the innards and seeds, and place both halves on a baking sheet. Use a small foil ring to stabilize the squash halves. Sprinkle fresh cracked pepper over each half
In a large bowl, combine minced garlic, heavy cream with 1/2 cup water, crumbled bouillon cube, chives, and fresh thyme. Mix well
Sprinkle a layer of grated cheese into the cavities of each squash half. Divide the cream mixture evenly on top of the cheese in each half, then top with more cheese
Roast in the oven for 40 to 50 minutes, or until the flesh is very tender when poked with a fork. Remove from the oven and serve immediately

recipes.title: Herbs de Provence Roasted Root Vegetables
directions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
In a large mixing bowl, toss together the vegetables, olive oil, and herbs. Transfer to a baking sheet and roast for 35–40 minutes.
Split into 6 portions and serve.

recipes.title: Honey Cinnamon Carrots
ingredients: 3 large carrots, peeled and sliced into rounds
½ tsp cinnamon (optional, for extra flavor)
directions: Cook carrots: In a small saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Add sliced carrots and cook for 6-8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until tender. Drizzle with honey and sprinkle with cinnamon (if using). Stir and cook for 2 more minutes.

recipes.title: Honey Roasted Carrots
ingredients: 1 lb carrots, peeled and cut into 2-inch pieces
directions: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
In a large mixing bowl, toss the carrots with the butter, garlic, honey, salt, and pepper. Transfer to a baking sheet and roast for 35–40 minutes.
Garnish with fresh parsley if desired. Split into 4 portions and serve.

recipes.title: Honey Roasted Delicata Squash
ingredients: 2 delicata squash, seeds removed, cut into crescent moons
directions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Place the squash on a baking sheet, drizzle with the olive oil and honey, and season with salt. Roast 20–25 minutes, until fork-tender.
Drizzle with hot honey, sprinkle with walnuts, and season with dried basil.
One serving is ¼ of the squash.

recipes.title: Italian Roasted Vegetables
directions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Scrub the potatoes clean and dry them with a paper towel.
Use a "crinkle cutter" to cut the vegetables as follows:
Cut the potatoes in half lengthwise, then each half lengthwise into wedges about 1 inch wide.
Cut the carrots diagonally into 2-inch lengths.
Cut the yellow squash and zucchini into ½-inch pieces.
Cut the mushrooms in half.
Place all the vegetables in a 4-quart bowl and toss with olive oil.
Press the garlic over the vegetables using a garlic press, then sprinkle with the Italian seasoning mix, salt, and pepper.
Spread the vegetables in a single layer on a baking pan.
Bake for 40-45 minutes or until golden brown and crisp-tender, stirring after 20 minutes to ensure even cooking.

recipes.title: Marinated Tomatoes
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chopped basil or 1 tsp dried basil
directions: Arrange the tomato slices in a large, shallow dish
Combine the remaining ingredients in a jar
Cover the jar tightly and shake well
Pour the contents over the tomato slices
Cover and refrigerate for several hours

recipes.title: Parmesan Roasted Green Beans
directions: Preheat oven to 400°F
Trim off the ends of the green beans. In a medium bowl, toss the green beans with enough olive oil to coat them lightly. Arrange the beans on a cookie sheet in a single layer
Sprinkle garlic salt, pepper blend, and grated Parmesan cheese over the green beans, then add a bit of shredded Parmesan on top
Bake for 15-20 minutes

recipes.title: Roasted Butternut Squash (air fryer)
ingredients: 1 small butternut squash, peeled, deseeded, and cut into thumb-sized pieces
A large pinch of black pepper
directions: Add olive oil to the air fryer
Add squash pieces and spices, then jiggle the pan to coat the squash evenly
Roast in the air fryer for 20-25 minutes, depending on the size of the pieces

recipes.title: Roasted Vegetables with Lemon Tahini
ingredients: 1 tsp turmeric, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp salt and pepper
½ tsp salt, ¼ tsp paprika, ¼ tsp garlic powder, ¼ tsp oregano
directions: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet with foil.
In a large mixing bowl, toss together the vegetable ingredients. Transfer to the baking sheet and roast for about 45 minutes.
While the veggies cook, whisk together the dressing ingredients.
When the veggies are fork-tender, drizzle the dressing evenly over them. Split into 4 portions and serve.

recipes.title: Sesame Green Beans
ingredients: 2 cups of fresh or frozen green beans
directions: Wash the green beans and snip the ends
Cut them into 1/4 to 1/2 inch lengths
In a skillet, melt butter over medium-high heat
Stir in the soy sauce and salt, cooking and stirring frequently until the sauce is hot
Pour the sauce over the cooked green beans
Sprinkle the toasted sesame seeds on top and serve hot

recipes.title: Spicy Balsamic Broccoli
ingredients: 1 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 1 tsp salt
directions: Steam the broccoli using your preferred method.
While the broccoli cooks, melt the butter.
Toss the broccoli in the melted butter, red pepper flakes, and salt.
Drizzle with the creamy balsamic glaze. Serving size is 1 c.

recipes.title: String Beans
directions: Preheat your oven to 350°F
In a medium saucepan, cook the string beans and cream of mushroom soup together over medium heat, stirring occasionally until well combined and heated through.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Pour the bean and soup mixture into a baking dish.
Top with the French onion rings and bake in the preheated oven for about 10 minutes, or until the onion rings are crispy and golden brown.
Serve hot and enjoy!

recipes.title: Sweet and Sour Cauliflower
ingredients: ½ c Kikkoman Sweet and Sour Sauce
directions: Preheat the air fryer or oven to 400°F.
In a large mixing bowl, toss the cauliflower with the sweet and sour sauce until well coated.
Air fry 12–15 minutes, or roast in the oven 30–35 minutes.
Sprinkle with green onions and sesame seeds. Serving size is 1 c.

recipes.title: Autumn Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper, 2 tbsp Italian seasoning, 1 tbsp parsley, 1 tsp rubbed sage, 1 tsp coriander
directions: In a large stockpot (preferably cast iron), heat the olive oil over medium-high heat. Add the butternut squash, carrots, bell peppers, onion, cauliflower, and garlic and sauté about 5 minutes.
Add the seasonings and tomato paste and mix until well combined. Add the bone broth and bouillon. Bring to a boil, cover, and boil 15–20 minutes, until the vegetables are completely cooked.
Blend with an immersion blender (or in batches in a regular blender) to your desired texture.
One serving is about ⅙ of the soup.

recipes.title: Best Ever Chili
ingredients: 1 cup black beans, drained and rinsed
1 cup kidney beans, drained and rinsed
directions: In a skillet, brown ground beef until no longer pink. Transfer to a crockpot.

Spray the skillet with cooking spray and add the onions, bell peppers, garlic, parsley and jalapeno peppers. Cook over medium heat for about five minutes or until veggies are tender and fragrant. Remove from heat and add all the seasonings.
Add all ingredients, except for the toppings, to the crockpot. Cook on low for 3-4 hours (or simmer in a pot on the stovetop for 1 hour).
Weigh the entire recipe and divide the weight by four to get the amount needed for one serving. Serve warm topped with cheese, Greek yogurt and avocado.

recipes.title: Butternut Squash Soup with Sourdough Grilled Cheese
directions: In a large stockpot (cast iron is great), melt the butter over medium-high heat. Add the onion, carrot, garlic, and butternut squash and sauté 4–5 minutes. Add the sage, salt, and pepper.
Add the bone broth, water, and bouillon. Bring to a boil, cover, and boil 15–18 minutes. Turn off the heat.
Blend with an immersion blender until creamy and smooth (or blend in batches in a regular blender). Add more salt, pepper, and sage to taste.
In a large skillet, make the grilled cheese sandwiches with the sourdough, mozzarella, and turkey: butter the outside of the bread and cook until golden brown and melty.

recipes.title: Chicken Fajita Tortilla Soup
directions: Sauté Onion and Garlic: In a large pot, sauté the onion and garlic in butter until softened.
Add Flour and Seasonings: Stir in flour, cumin, and fajita seasoning. Cook for about 1 minute.
Add Liquids and Bring to Boil: Pour in the chicken broth and half & half. Bring the mixture to a boil.
Add Remaining Ingredients: Add the cream of chicken soup, salsa, creamed corn, and chicken chunks. Stir to combine and let the soup heat through for about 15 minutes.
Serve: Ladle the soup into bowls and top with lime tortilla chips and shredded cheese. Garnish with fresh cilantro if desired.

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 whole chicken (or 1 pkg chicken thighs & breasts)
6-8 carrots, sliced (partially cooked, reserve cooking liquid)
Noodles (to add during the last 8 minutes of cooking)
directions: Cook the Chicken: Place the whole chicken or chicken thighs and breasts in a large pot, and cover with water. Add basil, the peeled carrot, a celery stalk with leaves, the onion, and chicken bouillon cubes. Cook until the meat is tender.
Strain the Broth: Pour the broth through a strainer to remove flavorings, creating a clear broth. Let the chicken cool, then remove meat from the bones and set aside.
Prepare Vegetables: Partially cook the cubed potatoes and sliced carrots in separate water, then reserve the liquid from the carrots.
Sauté Vegetables: In a separate skillet, heat a combination of olive oil and butter. Sauté the finely chopped celery and chopped onion until softened.
Combine Ingredients: Add the shredded chicken, sautéed vegetables, and partially cooked potatoes and carrots to the strained broth. Cook until the vegetables are just barely tender.
Add Noodles: During the last 8 minutes of cooking, add the noodles to the soup. Continue to cook until the noodles are tender.

recipes.title: Chili Lime Cod
ingredients: 2 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp oregano, ½ tsp salt and pepper
2 tsp chili powder, ½ tsp salt and pepper
directions: In a large mixing bowl or gallon-size zip-top bag, combine all the fish ingredients. Marinate for at least an hour or up to overnight.
Preheat the oven to 400°F. Line two baking sheets with foil or parchment paper.
Make the rice according to the package instructions.
Place the asparagus on one baking sheet, drizzle with olive oil, and season with the chili powder, salt, and pepper. Roast 25–30 minutes.
Place the fish on the other baking sheet and bake 22–25 minutes, until the internal temperature reaches 145°F.
Each serving is 6 oz cod with lime wedges, ½ c rice, and 4 oz asparagus.

recipes.title: Chili-Lime Junkyard Fries
directions: Add chicken and onions to a crockpot. Combine all marinade ingredients together in a bowl and then pour over the chicken and onions. Cook on low for 4 hours.

Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Slice sweet potatoes into fries. Spread fries out in a single layer onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Spray tops with cooking spray and sprinkle with sea salt. Bake for 20 minutes. Flip and return to the oven to bake for another 15 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Chop bacon and cook in a greased frying pan over medium/high heat. Cook until crispy. Remove from heat and set aside.

Top sweet potato fries with Chili-Lime Chicken and cheese. Return to the oven and cook 5 minutes until the cheese is melted. Split into 4 equal portions and top each serving with ½ slice bacon crumbles, jalapenos, fry sauce and chives. Enjoy warm with a fork. PB

recipes.title: Cincinnati Style Chili
ingredients: 2 cups kidney beans, drained and rinsed
¼ ounce of unsweetened baking chocolate
½ cup low-fat, shredded cheddar cheese
directions: Place all the chili ingredients into a crockpot except for the spaghetti squash and cheese. Cook on low for 6-8 hours or on high for 3-4 hours. Weigh the chili and divide by four.
Cook the spaghetti squash according to the directions in the Food Prep Guide. Rake the cooked spaghetti squash into a bowl and sprinkle with salt and pepper; set aside.
Serve by placing one serving of chili over 1 cup of spaghetti squash. Top each portion with two tablespoons of cheddar cheese.

recipes.title: Cowboy Stew
ingredients: 1 large russet potato (450 g), peeled and chopped
1 can pinto beans, drained and rinsed
2 tsp dried parsley, 1 tbsp cumin, 2 tsp chili powder, salt and pepper to taste
directions: Spray a large stockpot (cast iron is great) with oil and heat over medium. Sauté the onion 2–3 minutes. Add the ground beef and cook 6–8 minutes, until cooked through; drain any extra liquid.
Add the garlic, sausage, tomatoes, chilies, potatoes, pinto beans, and frozen veggies. Season with the parsley, cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper.
Add the broth and bouillon. Bring to a boil, stirring until the bouillon dissolves. Turn the heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer 35–45 minutes.
Split into 6 servings and serve.

recipes.title: Cream of Broccoli Soup
ingredients: 1 lb broccoli, stems cut into ¼-inch thick pieces, florets sectioned (about 6 cups)
3 cups chicken broth, reduced to 1½ cups
directions: Bring 1 quart of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the broccoli and cook until tender, about 7-10 minutes. Drain and set aside.
In a large non-stick skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the onion and cook until soft, about 3-5 minutes. Stir in the garlic and flour, mixing well.
Pour in the reduced chicken broth and 1 cup of milk. Add the tarragon, oregano, and thyme, and continue stirring over heat until the mixture thickens slightly, about 2 minutes.
Transfer the mixture and cooked broccoli to a blender or food processor. Blend until smooth.
Return the puree to the skillet, add the remaining milk, lemon juice, and salt and pepper to taste. Stir until well combined and heated through.
Add plenty of grated cheddar cheese to taste, stirring until melted and incorporated.

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients: ¼ cup canned, lite coconut milk
½ of a lemon, juice of
directions: Add olive oil and diced onion to a large pot over medium heat. Sauté for about three minutes or until fragrant and tender. Stir in the chicken broth and water. Add the bay leaf, minced garlic, thyme and sea salt. Bring to a boil and then reduce heat and let simmer for 20 minutes.
Add in the carrots, celery and kale. Let cook until about five minutes and then add the dry egg noodles. Cook the noodles al dente according to the directions on the package.

While the noodles are cooking, add the butter to a large frying pan over low heat. Once melted, stir in the Kodiak Cakes. Add one cup of broth from the soup to the pan, then slowly whisk it in alond with the coconut milk. Bring to a boil; stirring constantly. Remove from heat and add to the pot of soup once the noodles are done.

Add the shredded chicken last and simmer until the chicken is warm. Squeeze lemon juice over the soup and it is ready to serve! Garnish each bowl with fresh parsley. Weigh the entire soup and divide the weight by four to get the amount needed for one serving.

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken Vegetable Soup
ingredients: 1 lb baby carrots, cut into equal-sized pieces
¼ to ½ cup margarine, melted
directions: Boil the chicken breasts in water for 1 to 1½ hours until fully cooked. Remove from water, let cool, and then cut into cubes.
In a separate pot, add the diced potatoes and baby carrots. Boil until tender, then drain.
In a large saucepan, bring 4-5 cups of water to a rapid boil. Add the chicken bouillon, salt, pepper, and a sprinkle of dried onion flakes. Stir well.
Prepare the roux: In a separate pan, melt the margarine and stir in the flour, cooking until well combined.
Gradually add the roux to the boiling broth, whisking vigorously to thicken the soup base.
Add the frozen peas, cooked chicken cubes, and additional bouillon or seasoning if desired. Reduce heat to low.
Finally, add the cooked potatoes and carrots. Stir well and let the soup warm through on low heat.

recipes.title: Crockpot Marry Me Chicken Soup
ingredients: 4 cups chicken broth, plus more as needed
½ cup grated Parmesan cheese, plus more to serve
directions: Add the chicken, broth, heavy cream, sun-dried tomatoes, basil, garlic powder, red pepper flakes, salt and pepper to the crock pot.
Cover and cook on high for 3 hours or on low for 6 hours, until the chicken is cooked through and tender.
Shred the chicken, then stir in the Parmesan and the ditalini.
Keep cooking, stirring now and then, until the pasta is tender. Add more broth to get the consistency you want.
Top with extra Parmesan and serve.

recipes.title: La Madeline’s Tomato-Basil Soup
ingredients: 4 cups fresh tomatoes (8 to 10), peeled, cored, and chopped, or 4 cups canned tomatoes, crushed
½ cup sweet, unsalted butter, softened
directions: Simmer Tomatoes and Juice: In a saucepan, combine tomatoes and tomato juice. Simmer for 30 minutes over medium-low heat.
Blend with Basil: Allow the mixture to cool slightly, then transfer in batches to a blender or food processor. Add chopped basil and puree until smooth.
Combine Ingredients: Return the pureed mixture to the saucepan. Stir in the cream and butter over low heat until both are fully incorporated. Season with salt and cracked black pepper to taste.
Simmer: Let the soup simmer on low for 1½ hours, stirring occasionally.
Serve: Garnish with additional fresh basil and serve with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Lasagna Soup
ingredients: 1 large can Italian-style stewed tomatoes, chopped
1 cup provolone cheese or fresh mozzarella, diced
directions: Brown the Sausage: In a large pot, brown the Italian sausage over medium heat.
Sauté Vegetables: Add the onions and carrots to the sausage and sauté for about 3 minutes. Add mushrooms and garlic, and continue to sauté for an additional 3 minutes.
Add Broth and Tomatoes: Pour in the chicken broth, chopped stewed tomatoes, and tomato sauce. Bring the mixture to a boil.
Cook the Pasta: Add the pasta and simmer until it is cooked, about 10 minutes.
Add Spinach: Stir in the chopped spinach and cook until it wilts.
Serve: Place ¼ cup of provolone or mozzarella cheese into each serving bowl, then ladle the hot soup over the cheese. Garnish with Parmesan cheese and fresh basil.

recipes.title: Mulligatawny Soup
ingredients: 3 tsp curry powder, ½ tsp paprika, ¼ tsp cinnamon, ¼ tsp cardamom, ¼ tsp turmeric
2 tbsp + 2 tsp Better Than Bouillon, roasted chicken
1 lb rotisserie chicken, cubed or shredded
Splash of heavy cream, for serving
directions: Melt the butter in a large pot over medium to medium-high heat. Add the carrots, celery, onion, salt, and pepper, and sauté 4–5 minutes.
Add the zucchini and garlic and sauté another 4 minutes. Add the apple, flour, and spices and toss to coat. Cook 2–3 minutes.
Add the water and Better Than Bouillon, stirring until completely dissolved. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer for 20 minutes, uncovered.
Turn off the heat and add the rice and chicken. Cover for 5 minutes, or until the rice is cooked. Season with the dried thyme.
Stir in the heavy cream before serving. Serving size is 16 oz of soup.

recipes.title: New England Clam Chowder
ingredients: 1 pint shucked clams or 2 (6-oz) cans minced clams
directions: Prepare the Clams: Chop clams, reserving the juice. Strain the clam juice to remove any shell bits. (If using canned clams, drain and reserve the juice.) If needed, add water to the reserved clam juice to make 1 cup. Set aside.
Cook the Bacon: In a large saucepan, cook the bacon until crisp. Remove bacon, leaving 1 tablespoon of drippings in the pan. Drain the bacon on paper towels, crumble, and set aside.

Cook Vegetables: To the saucepan with drippings, add the reserved clam juice mixture, potatoes, onions, bouillon granules, Worcestershire sauce, thyme, and pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat. Cover and simmer for about 10 minutes, or until potatoes are tender. Mash the potatoes slightly against the side of the pan with the back of a fork.

Add Milk Mixture: In a separate bowl, whisk together the milk, half-and-half (or cream), and flour. Stir this mixture into the potato mixture in the saucepan. Cook and stir until the chowder is slightly thickened and bubbly.
Finish with Clams: Stir in the clams. Bring the chowder back to a boil, then reduce heat and cook for an additional 1 to 2 minutes.
Serve: Ladle the chowder into bowls, and sprinkle each serving with the crumbled bacon.

recipes.title: Roasted Cauliflower Soup
ingredients: ⅔ cup low-fat, shredded mozzarella cheese
Sea salt and pepper, to taste
directions: Make the Homemade, Honey-Wheat Bread in advance.
Preheat oven to 400 degrees.
Add the cauliflower florets, onion, garlic and olive oil to a large Ziploc bag. Massage until well coated. Spread out onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast for 20 minutes.
Spray a frying pan and place over medium heat. Add chopped bacon to the pan and cook until crispy. Remove from pan and set aside.

Add roasted cauliflower and onions, chicken broth, mozzarella cheese, Greek yogurt, salt and pepper to a blender. Blend on high until smooth. Weigh the soup and divide the weight by four to get the amount needed for one serving.
Top each serving of soup with one slice crumbled bacon and chives. Enjoy with homemade bread on the side.

recipes.title: Taco Soup
directions: Cook the Hamburger: In a skillet, fry the hamburger with onions until the meat is browned and the onions are tender. Drain any excess fat.
Combine Ingredients: In a large pot, mix together the vegetable soup, whole tomatoes (with juice), tomato soup, cooked hamburger and onions, kidney beans, taco seasoning mix, and salsa.
Simmer: Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat, stirring occasionally. Allow it to simmer until heated through and flavors are well combined.

recipes.title: Thai Red Curry Coconut Soup
ingredients: ½ tsp salt and pepper, ½ tsp dried basil
3 tbsp coconut aminos or low-sodium soy sauce
8 oz brown rice pad thai noodles
directions: In a medium mixing bowl, mix together all the meatball ingredients except the olive oil. Drizzle the olive oil onto your hands and roll the meat into 16 1-oz meatballs.
In a large stockpot (cast iron is great), heat the 1 tbsp olive oil over medium-high heat. When hot, sear the meatballs on all sides, about 4–5 minutes. Add the shallot and sauté 1–2 minutes.
Add the bone broth, coconut milk, curry paste, water, bouillon, honey, and coconut aminos. Bring to a low rolling boil for 2–5 minutes.
Add the bok choy and return to a boil. Add the noodles and boil until cooked through. Turn the heat to low, add the basil, and simmer about 5 minutes.
Each serving is 1.3 oz noodles, 2 c broth and bok choy, 1 lime wedge, a thin slice of shallot, and basil leaves as desired.

recipes.title: White Bean Taco Soup
ingredients: 4 cans Northern white beans, drained and rinsed
directions: Combine Ingredients: Place the chicken breasts, white corn, Northern white beans, black beans, chicken broth, cilantro, salsa, cumin, and red pepper flakes in a crock pot.
Cook: Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours until the chicken is cooked through and tender. Remove the chicken, shred it, and return it to the pot.
Serve: Ladle into bowls and add toppings such as a dollop of sour cream, grated cheese, extra salsa, and crushed lime chips.

recipes.title: White Chicken Chili (Slow Cooker)
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless skinless chicken breasts, trimmed
2 cans (15 oz. each) Great Northern beans, rinsed and drained
1 can (15 oz.) whole kernel corn, drained
2 cans (4 oz. each) diced green chiles, one hot and one mild
Avocado, shredded Monterey Jack, tortilla strips, sour cream, sliced jalapeños, cilantro
directions: Lay the chicken in the bottom of the slow cooker and season it with the cumin, oregano, salt, pepper, chili powder and cayenne.
Add the onion, garlic, beans, green chiles, corn, broth and cilantro. Stir gently to combine.
Cover and cook on low for 8 hours, or on high for 3 to 4 hours.
Lift out the chicken, shred it, and return it to the pot.
Whisk the cream cheese together with a few ladles of the hot chili until smooth, then stir it back in along with the half and half. This keeps it from going lumpy.
Cook on high for another 15 minutes, until thick and creamy. Stir well and serve with toppings.

recipes.title: Parmesan Chicken Bake
ingredients: 1 cup light mayo or Greek yogurt
½ cup parmesan cheese, plus extra for topping
directions: Preheat oven to 375°F and spray the inside of a 9x13 glass baking pan. Lay the chicken inside the pan.
Mix together the remaining ingredients and spread evenly over each piece of chicken, making sure to cover all the exposed raw chicken so it doesn't dry out. Cover with extra parmesan.
Bake uncovered for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: 3-Ingredient Chicken
ingredients: Chicken (any kind — we use bone-in thigh)
1 can cranberry sauce with whole berries
directions: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Place chicken in a 9x13 pan.
Bake chicken halfway (time depends on the type of chicken you use — for bone-in thighs, about 30 minutes).
While the chicken bakes, make the sauce by mixing the French dressing, onion soup mix, and cranberry sauce together in a bowl.
Once the chicken is halfway baked, pour the sauce mixture on top and bake for the remaining time.

recipes.title: Mac n Cheese
ingredients: 1 (8 oz) package Kraft singles, cut in strips
2 sleeves Ritz crackers, smashed in the package
directions: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Melt 2 tbsp butter in a saucepan over medium heat.
Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the milk, salt, mustard, and pepper, and cook, stirring frequently, until the mixture boils and thickens.
Meanwhile, cook the noodles.
Add both cheeses to the milk mixture and stir until melted.
Combine the noodles and cheese sauce in a baking dish.
Melt ¼ cup butter in a saucepan and mix with the crushed Ritz crackers.
Top the pasta with the Ritz cracker mixture.
Bake for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Pesto Pull-Apart Sliders
ingredients: 1 tsp dried parsley (or substitute those 3 for garlic butter!)
directions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Slice the dinner rolls hamburger-style and lay the bottoms in a greased pan.
Spread pesto on the bottoms of the rolls.
Layer the chicken and mozzarella on top.
Cover with the tops and spread the butter mixture on top.
Cover with foil and bake for 10–15 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken Bacon Ranch Baked Penne
directions: Heat oven to 350°F. Grease or spray a 13x9-inch pan.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked penne pasta, shredded chicken, Alfredo sauce, and ranch dressing. Stir to combine.
Pour the mixture into the pan and spread evenly.
Sprinkle the chopped bacon evenly over the top, then sprinkle with the shredded mozzarella cheese.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Crockpot Chicken Tacos
ingredients: 1 can Rotel or a small jar of salsa
directions: Put the seasoning over the chicken and top it with the Rotel or salsa.
Cook on low for 6 hours, or on high for 4 hours.
Shred the chicken in the pot.
Add the cream cheese 20–30 minutes before serving.
Mix together and serve with tortillas and your favorite taco toppings.

recipes.title: Fiesta Lasagna
directions: For the chicken:
Put chicken in the crockpot.
Pour in taco seasoning and salsa.
Cook on low for 6 hours, or high for 4 hours.
When fully cooked, shred the chicken.
Add cream cheese and mix well.
For the lasagna:
Spray a baking dish and add ⅓ of the shredded chicken mixture, then layer tortillas, beans, corn, and cheese.
Repeat the layers, then top with cheese.
Cover with foil and bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.
Uncover and bake for 5–10 minutes.
Serve and enjoy!

recipes.title: Cheesy Taco Hashbrown Casserole
ingredients: ½ cup pico de gallo or Rotel
About 265 calories and 24 g protein per serving.
Serve as a casserole with lettuce, sour cream, and pico, or roll into a low-cal tortilla for a burrito.
directions: Preheat the oven to 375°F.
Brown the ground beef and season with the taco seasoning.
In a 9x13 baking dish, combine the taco meat, hashbrowns, cream of chicken soup, Greek yogurt, Laughing Cow wedges, and pico or Rotel. Stir until mixed and spread evenly.
Top with shredded Mexican cheese.
Bake 40 to 45 minutes, until hot and the cheese is golden.

recipes.title: Balsamic Brussels Sprouts
directions: Spray or coat a fry pan with oil.
Pour the Brussels sprouts into the pan.
Cook until browned, even a little burnt.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Pour balsamic glaze and honey over top, to taste.

recipes.title: Baked Rigatoni
directions: Cook the noodles and pour them into the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish.
Take the casing off the sausage, crumble it, and cook in a fry pan.
Add the pepperoni to the pan and fry a bit.
Mix the sausage and pepperoni into the baking dish with the noodles.
Pour in spaghetti sauce to taste, so it's a little saucy.
Take the ricotta and drop it in randomly, mixing slightly but not thoroughly.
Top with shredded mozzarella as desired.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: High-Protein Taco Mac
ingredients: Salt, pepper, and garlic powder, to taste
directions: Brown the ground beef with the peppers, onion, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and part of the taco seasoning.
Cook the pasta according to the package directions. Drain.
Add the pasta, beef mixture, and cheese to a large bowl.
In a small bowl, mix the Greek yogurt, lime juice, taco sauce, and remaining taco seasoning.
Stir the sauce into the pasta until fully coated.
Divide evenly into 8 meal prep containers.

recipes.title: Dad's Beef Bowls
ingredients: 1 lb shaved beef (can sub strip-cut flank steak)
¾ cup sweet chili sauce (Trader Joe's)
directions: Start cooking the white rice in a rice cooker.
Heat olive oil in a pan on medium heat.
Add the beef and cook through.
Reduce heat to low; add the sweet chili sauce, sriracha, and soy sauce.
Stir until the sauce is combined and the beef is coated.
In a separate pan, add the broccoli florets with 2 tbsp of water and cover. Steam on low heat for about 5 minutes.
Remove the cover and add the shredded carrots.
Stir to combine and cook until the carrots soften.
As the veggies continue to cook, chop the peanuts.
Assemble your bowl by plating the rice first, then the beef and veggies on top. Top with chopped peanuts.

recipes.title: Steak & Queso Street Corn Bowl
ingredients: 1½ lbs sirloin steak, cut into bite-size pieces
800 g (about 1¾ lbs) russet or Yukon gold potatoes, diced
Optional glaze: after removing the steak, add a little honey and broth to the pan, simmer, then toss the steak back in until glossy.
directions: Toss the diced potatoes with the oil, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Air fry at 400°F for 18 to 20 minutes, shaking halfway, until crispy.
While the potatoes cook, toss the steak with the oil, chili powder, garlic powder, smoked paprika, cumin, salt, pepper, and lime juice. Let it marinate a few minutes.
Mix all the street corn ingredients in a bowl until combined.
Sear the steak in a very hot skillet until browned and cooked to your liking.
Blend all the queso ingredients until smooth. Warm it in the microwave if you like it hot.
Divide the potatoes, steak, and street corn into 4 bowls. Top with queso and cilantro.

recipes.title: 10 Minute Turkey Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 bottle Trader Joe's General Tso's sauce
directions: Brown the ground turkey (a Mix n Chop tool makes quick work of it).
In a separate pan, sauté the broccoli slaw until crispy.
Add the bottle of General Tso's sauce to the cooked ground turkey.
Serve all over the rice.

recipes.title: Zach's Sticky Chicken
ingredients: ¼ cup apricot preserves (peach works too)
Rice or mashed potatoes, for serving
directions: Cook the diced chicken in a skillet over medium-high heat. Sprinkle in the French onion soup mix as it cooks.
When the chicken is almost cooked through, stir in the BBQ sauce and apricot preserves.
Reduce the heat and simmer until the sauce thickens and turns sticky.
Serve over rice or mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Nutella Candies
directions: Open the crescents and lay each one flat as a triangle.
Spread a very generous layer of Nutella on each one — don't be skimpy!
Roll up and bake per the instructions on the package of rolls.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Roll Crescents
directions: Spread a layer of marshmallow cream on each crescent.
Sprinkle cinnamon sugar on each.
Roll up each crescent and sprinkle the top with more cinnamon sugar.
Bake for about 9 minutes, until golden brown.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Ice Cream
ingredients: Swap the honey for maple syrup, or the peanut butter for any nut butter.
Low-fat cottage cheese works but turns out less creamy.
Keeps in the freezer up to 2 weeks. Press plastic wrap on the surface to stop ice crystals.
Flavor ideas: cocoa powder, frozen fruit, chopped nuts, cinnamon, espresso powder, or strawberries with crushed graham crackers.
directions: Blend the cottage cheese, honey, and peanut butter in a food processor or high-speed blender until smooth and creamy.
Stir in the chocolate chips.
Pour into the empty cottage cheese container or a loaf pan. Freeze about 4 hours, until firm.
Let it sit out 5 to 10 minutes to soften, then scoop and serve.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Protein Yogurt Bark
ingredients: ½ scoop (15 g) vanilla protein powder
¼ cup almond milk, plus more as needed
directions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix the yogurt, honey, protein powder, peanut butter powder, and milk. Add a splash more milk if it's too thick.
Spread the mixture evenly on the parchment.
Top with the banana, then drizzle with the melted chocolate and peanut butter.
Freeze 3 to 4 hours, until completely firm.
Break or cut into pieces. Store in an airtight container in the freezer.

recipes.title: Strawberry Fluff
directions: Mix together the marshmallow creme and strawberry cream cheese with a spoon.
Serve with fresh strawberries.

recipes.title: Caramel Apple Dip
directions: In a bowl, mix the cream cheese and powdered sugar with a hand mixer.
Crush the Heath bar (use a blender).
Spread a thin layer of the cream cheese mixture on a platter and top with a thin layer of caramel dip.
Top with crushed Heath bar and serve with cut apples.
